on('ready', function () {
    'use strict';

    var SCRIPT = 'GM1E';
    var VERSION = '0.3.32';

    function esc(s) {
        if (s === undefined || s === null) {
            return '';
        }

        s = String(s);
        s = s.split('&').join('&amp;');
        s = s.split('<').join('&lt;');
        s = s.split('>').join('&gt;');
        s = s.split('"').join('&quot;');

        return s;
    }

    function deferRoll20(s) {
        return String(s || '')
            .split('@').join('&#64;')
            .split('{').join('&#123;')
            .split('}').join('&#125;')
            .split('|').join('&#124;');
    }

    function playDiceSound() {
        sendChat(SCRIPT, '!splay diceri');
    }

    function box(c) {
        return '<div style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#fff;border:1px solid #aa2222;padding:6px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.25;display:block;">' + c + '</div>';
    }

    function title(t) {
        return '<div style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#fff;font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #aa2222;margin-bottom:4px;padding-bottom:3px;">' + esc(t) + '</div>';
    }

    function row(c) {
        return '<div style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#fff;margin:2px 0;">' + c + '</div>';
    }

    function indentBlock(c) {
        return '<div style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#fff;margin-left:14px;padding-left:6px;border-left:1px solid #333;">' + c + '</div>';
    }

    function indentedRow(c) {
        return indentBlock(row(c));
    }

    function hr() {
        return '<div style="background:#000;background-color:#000;border-top:1px solid #aa2222;margin:4px 0;height:0;"></div>';
    }

    function section(label) {
        return '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border-left:3px solid #aa2222;padding:2px 4px;margin:5px 0 2px 0;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;">' + esc(label) + '</div>';
    }

    function sectionWithButtons(label, buttonsHtml) {
        return '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border-left:3px solid #aa2222;padding:2px 4px;margin:5px 0 2px 0;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;">' +
            '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;">' + esc(label) + '</span>' +
            '<span style="display:inline-block;text-transform:none;vertical-align:middle;">' + buttonsHtml + '</span>' +
            '</div>';
    }

    function btn(label, href, tip) {
        tip = tip || '';
        return '<a href="' + esc(href) + '" title="' + esc(tip) + '" style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border:1px solid #aa2222;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 4px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</a>';
    }

    function btnYellow(label, href, tip) {
        tip = tip || '';
        return '<a href="' + esc(href) + '" title="' + esc(tip) + '" style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border:2px solid #f4d36a;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 5px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</a>';
    }

    function macroBtn(label, href, tip) {
        tip = tip || '';
        return '<a href="' + deferRoll20(href) + '" title="' + esc(tip) + '" style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border:1px solid #aa2222;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 4px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</a>';
    }

    function btnOn(label, href, tip) {
        tip = tip || '';
        return '<a href="' + esc(href) + '" title="' + esc(tip) + '" style="background:#1f6f1f;background-color:#1f6f1f;color:#fff;border:1px solid #aa2222;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 5px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</a>';
    }

    function btnOff(label, href, tip) {
        tip = tip || '';
        return '<a href="' + esc(href) + '" title="' + esc(tip) + '" style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border:1px solid #aa2222;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 5px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</a>';
    }

    function btnColor(label, href, border, tip) {
        tip = tip || '';
        return '<a href="' + esc(href) + '" title="' + esc(tip) + '" style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border:2px solid ' + border + ';border-radius:3px;padding:1px 5px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</a>';
    }

    function btnColorOn(label, href, border, tip) {
        tip = tip || '';
        return '<a href="' + esc(href) + '" title="' + esc(tip) + '" style="background:#1f6f1f;background-color:#1f6f1f;color:#fff;border:2px solid ' + border + ';border-radius:3px;padding:1px 5px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</a>';
    }

    function btnBlue(label, href, tip) {
        return btnColor(label, href, '#2f80ff', tip);
    }

    function btnBlueOn(label, href, tip) {
        return btnColorOn(label, href, '#2f80ff', tip);
    }

    function btnOrange(label, href, tip) {
        return btnColor(label, href, '#ff9f1a', tip);
    }

    function btnOrangeOn(label, href, tip) {
        return btnColorOn(label, href, '#ff9f1a', tip);
    }

    function btnGreen(label, href, tip) {
        return btnColor(label, href, '#51d66b', tip);
    }

    function btnGreenOn(label, href, tip) {
        return btnColorOn(label, href, '#51d66b', tip);
    }

    function pill(label) {
        return '<span style="background:#7a1f1f;background-color:#7a1f1f;color:#fff;border:1px solid #aa2222;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 5px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</span>';
    }

    function resultPill(label, isHit) {
        var bg = isHit ? '#1f6f1f' : '#7a1111';
        var border = isHit ? '#51d66b' : '#ff4444';

        return '<span style="background:' + bg + ';background-color:' + bg + ';color:#fff;border:1px solid ' + border + ';border-radius:3px;padding:1px 6px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</span>';
    }

    function diePill(label) {
        return '<span style="background:#d8a11d;background-color:#d8a11d;color:#000;border:1px solid #f4d36a;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 6px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</span>';
    }

    function dmgPill(label) {
        return '<span style="background:#7a1111;background-color:#7a1111;color:#fff;border:1px solid #ff4444;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 6px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</span>';
    }

    function infoPill(label) {
        return '<span style="background:#222;background-color:#222;color:#ddd;border:1px solid #555;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 5px;margin:1px;display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</span>';
    }

    function good(s) {
        return '<span style="color:#51d66b;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(s) + '</span>';
    }

    function bad(s) {
        return '<span style="color:#ff5555;font-weight:bold;">' + esc(s) + '</span>';
    }

    function neutral(s) {
        return '<span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(s) + '</span>';
    }

    function signed(n) {
        n = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
        return (n >= 0 ? '+' : '') + n;
    }

    function parseNumber(v) {
        var m;

        if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') {
            return NaN;
        }

        m = String(v).match(/-?\d+/);

        if (!m) {
            return NaN;
        }

        return parseInt(m[0], 10);
    }

    function toInt(v, fallback) {
        var n = parseNumber(v);
        return isNaN(n) ? fallback : n;
    }

    function initState() {
        state[SCRIPT] = state[SCRIPT] || {};
        state[SCRIPT].modifiers = state[SCRIPT].modifiers || {};
        state[SCRIPT].mainResults = state[SCRIPT].mainResults || {};
        state[SCRIPT].fireIntoMelee = state[SCRIPT].fireIntoMelee || {};
        state[SCRIPT].exhaustion = state[SCRIPT].exhaustion || {};
        state[SCRIPT].exhaustionBaseMove = state[SCRIPT].exhaustionBaseMove || {};
        state[SCRIPT].modSections = state[SCRIPT].modSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].spellSections = state[SCRIPT].spellSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].spellRows = state[SCRIPT].spellRows || {};
        state[SCRIPT].attackSections = state[SCRIPT].attackSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions = state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions || {};
        state[SCRIPT].initiativeModifierSections = state[SCRIPT].initiativeModifierSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].initiativeSubSections = state[SCRIPT].initiativeSubSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].actionSections = state[SCRIPT].actionSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].saveSections = state[SCRIPT].saveSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].exhaustionSections = state[SCRIPT].exhaustionSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].thiefSections = state[SCRIPT].thiefSections || {};
        state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb = state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb || {};
    }

    function getAttr(cid, name) {
        var a = findObjs({
            _type: 'attribute',
            _characterid: cid,
            name: name
        }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];

        if (!a) {
            return '';
        }

        return a.get('current') || '';
    }

    function getAttrNumber(cid, names, fallback) {
        var i, raw, n;

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            raw = getAttr(cid, names[i]);
            n = parseNumber(raw);

            if (!isNaN(n)) {
                return n;
            }
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    function getAttrsForChar(cid) {
        return findObjs({
            _type: 'attribute',
            _characterid: cid
        }) || [];
    }

    function tokenById(id) {
        return getObj('graphic', id);
    }

    function charByToken(token) {
        var cid;

        if (!token) {
            return null;
        }

        cid = token.get('represents');

        if (!cid) {
            return null;
        }

        return getObj('character', cid);
    }

    function tokenName(token) {
        if (!token) {
            return 'Unknown';
        }

        return token.get('name') || 'Token';
    }

    function setMainResult(tokenId, lines) {
        initState();
        state[SCRIPT].mainResults[tokenId] = lines || [];
    }

    function getMainResult(tokenId) {
        initState();
        return state[SCRIPT].mainResults[tokenId] || [];
    }

    function clearMainResult(tokenId) {
        initState();
        delete state[SCRIPT].mainResults[tokenId];
    }

    function getExhaustionLevel(cid) {
        initState();

        if (!cid) {
            return 0;
        }

        return toInt(state[SCRIPT].exhaustion[cid], 0);
    }

    function setExhaustionLevel(cid, level) {
        initState();

        level = toInt(level, 0);

        if (level < 0) {
            level = 0;
        }

        if (level > 6) {
            level = 6;
        }

        if (!cid) {
            return;
        }

        if (level === 0) {
            delete state[SCRIPT].exhaustion[cid];
        } else {
            state[SCRIPT].exhaustion[cid] = level;
        }
    }

    function exhaustionColor(level) {
        level = toInt(level, 0);

        if (level <= 0) {
            return '#51d66b';
        }

        if (level <= 2) {
            return '#f4d36a';
        }

        if (level <= 4) {
            return '#ff9d3c';
        }

        return '#ff5555';
    }

    function exhaustionLabel(level) {
        level = toInt(level, 0);

        if (level <= 0) {
            return 'None';
        }

        return String(level > 6 ? 6 : level);
    }

    function exhaustionPenalty(level) {
        level = toInt(level, 0);

        if (level <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (level > 6) {
            level = 6;
        }

        return -level;
    }

    function exhaustionInfo(level) {
        level = toInt(level, 0);

        if (level === 1) {
            return 'Level 1: Base movement; -1 to attack rolls, ability checks, and saves.';
        }

        if (level === 2) {
            return 'Level 2: One encumbrance level up; -2 to attack rolls, ability checks, and saves.';
        }

        if (level === 3) {
            return 'Level 3: One encumbrance level up; -3 to attack rolls, ability checks, and saves.';
        }

        if (level === 4) {
            return 'Level 4: Two encumbrance levels up; -4 to attack rolls, ability checks, and saves.';
        }

        if (level === 5) {
            return 'Level 5: Two movement steps down, minimum movement 3 until level 6; -5 to attack rolls, ability checks, and saves.';
        }

        if (level >= 6) {
            return 'Level 6: No movement; unconscious. Applies unconscious marker.';
        }

        return 'No exhaustion.';
    }

    function exhaustionPill(level) {
        return '<span title="' + esc(exhaustionInfo(level)) + '" style="color:' + exhaustionColor(level) + ';font-weight:bold;">' + esc(exhaustionLabel(level)) + '</span>';
    }

    function exhaustionDisplay(level) {
        level = toInt(level, 0);

        if (level <= 0) {
            return '<span style="color:#51d66b;font-weight:bold;">none</span>';
        }

        return exhaustionPill(level);
    }

    function encumbranceTier(label) {
        label = String(label || '').toLowerCase();

        if (label.indexOf('very') !== -1 && label.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 2;
        }

        if (label.indexOf('encumbered') !== -1 && label.indexOf('unencumbered') === -1) {
            return 3;
        }

        if (label.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 1;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    function normalizeArmorBulkTier(value) {
        var text = String(value || '').toLowerCase().replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');

        if (!text) {
            return -1;
        }

        if (text.indexOf('not') !== -1 && text.indexOf('bulky') !== -1) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (text.indexOf('none') !== -1 || text.indexOf('normal') !== -1) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (text.indexOf('bulky') !== -1 && text.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 2;
        }

        if (text.indexOf('very') !== -1 && text.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 2;
        }

        if (text.indexOf('encumbered') !== -1 && text.indexOf('unencumbered') === -1) {
            return 3;
        }

        if (text.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 1;
        }

        if (text.indexOf('bulky') !== -1) {
            return 1;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    function getArmorBulkTier(cid) {
        var attrs = getAttrsForChar(cid);
        var preferredNames = [
            'current_armor_bulk',
            'armor_bulk_current',
            'armor_bulk',
            'current_armor_bulk_label',
            'armor_bulk_label',
            'speed_current_armor_bulk',
            'movement_current_armor_bulk'
        ];
        var i;
        var value;
        var tier;
        var a;
        var name;

        for (i = 0; i < preferredNames.length; i++) {
            value = getAttr(cid, preferredNames[i]);
            tier = normalizeArmorBulkTier(value);

            if (tier >= 0) {
                return tier;
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) {
            a = attrs[i];
            name = String(a.get('name') || '').toLowerCase();

            if (name.indexOf('armor') !== -1 && name.indexOf('bulk') !== -1) {
                tier = normalizeArmorBulkTier(a.get('current'));

                if (tier >= 0) {
                    return tier;
                }
            }
        }

        return -1;
    }

    function readSpeedAndMovementMove(cid) {
        var armorTier = getArmorBulkTier(cid);
        var encTier = encumbranceTier(deriveEncumbranceFromSpeedAndMovementText(cid));
        var tier;

        if (armorTier < 0 && encTier <= 0) {
            return NaN;
        }

        if (armorTier < 0) {
            armorTier = 0;
        }

        tier = Math.max(armorTier, encTier);

        if (tier > 3) {
            tier = 3;
        }

        return movementForTrackIndex(tier);
    }

    function movementTrackIndex(moveValue) {
        var track = [12, 9, 6, 3, 0];
        var mv = parseNumber(moveValue);
        var bestIndex = 0;
        var bestDistance = 9999;
        var i;
        var d;

        if (isNaN(mv)) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < track.length; i++) {
            d = Math.abs(track[i] - mv);

            if (d < bestDistance) {
                bestDistance = d;
                bestIndex = i;
            }
        }

        return bestIndex;
    }

    function movementForTrackIndex(index) {
        var track = [12, 9, 6, 3, 0];

        index = toInt(index, 0);

        if (index < 0) {
            index = 0;
        }

        if (index > 4) {
            index = 4;
        }

        return track[index];
    }

    function exhaustionMovementStep(level) {
        level = toInt(level, 0);

        if (level === 2 || level === 3) {
            return 1;
        }

        if (level === 4 || level === 5) {
            return 2;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    function getStoredExhaustionBaseMove(cid) {
        initState();

        if (!cid) {
            return NaN;
        }

        return parseNumber(state[SCRIPT].exhaustionBaseMove[cid]);
    }

    function setStoredExhaustionBaseMove(cid, moveValue) {
        initState();

        if (!cid) {
            return;
        }

        state[SCRIPT].exhaustionBaseMove[cid] = String(moveValue);
    }

    function clearStoredExhaustionBaseMove(cid) {
        initState();

        if (!cid) {
            return;
        }

        delete state[SCRIPT].exhaustionBaseMove[cid];
    }

    function nearestMovementTrackValue(value, allowZero) {
        var track = allowZero ? [12, 9, 6, 3, 0] : [12, 9, 6, 3];
        var n = parseNumber(value);
        var best = track[0];
        var bestDistance = 9999;
        var i;
        var d;

        if (isNaN(n)) {
            return allowZero ? 0 : 12;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < track.length; i++) {
            d = Math.abs(track[i] - n);

            if (d < bestDistance) {
                bestDistance = d;
                best = track[i];
            }
        }

        return best;
    }

    function readCurrentSheetMove(cid) {
        var speedMove = readSpeedAndMovementMove(cid);
        var names = [
            'move_round',
            'move_per_round',
            'movement_round',
            'movement_per_round',
            'current_speed',
            'selected_speed',
            'active_speed',
            'speed_current',
            'adjusted_speed',
            'movement_adjusted',
            'explore_map_movement',
            'explore_movement',
            'movement_current',
            'current_movement',
            'move_current',
            'current_move',
            'movement_rate',
            'move_rate',
            'encumbrance_move',
            'current_encumbrance_move'
        ];
        var i;
        var raw;
        var n;
        var fallback;

        /*
         * Main-card Move should match the visible Speed and Movement result.
         * On this sheet, current_encumbrance_move can remain at the Encumbered
         * track value even when Current Encumbrance says Unencumbered, so first
         * derive the active movement from Current Armor Bulk + Current Encumbrance.
         */
        if (!isNaN(speedMove) && speedMove > 0) {
            return nearestMovementTrackValue(speedMove, false);
        }

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            raw = getAttr(cid, names[i]);
            n = parseNumber(raw);

            if (!isNaN(n) && n > 0) {
                return nearestMovementTrackValue(n, false);
            }
        }

        fallback = getAttrNumber(cid, ['movement_normal', 'movement', 'move', 'base_move', 'base_movement'], 12);

        if (isNaN(fallback) || fallback <= 0) {
            return 12;
        }

        return nearestMovementTrackValue(fallback, false);
    }

    function effectiveExhaustionMovement(cid) {
        var level = getExhaustionLevel(cid);
        var baseMove = getStoredExhaustionBaseMove(cid);
        var baseIndex;
        var targetIndex;

        if (level >= 6) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (isNaN(baseMove) || baseMove <= 0) {
            baseMove = readCurrentSheetMove(cid);
        }

        baseMove = nearestMovementTrackValue(baseMove, false);
        baseIndex = movementTrackIndex(baseMove);

        /*
         * Valid movement track is exactly: 12, 9, 6, 3, 0.
         * Level 6 is the only condition that sets movement to 0.
         * Before level 6, movement bottoms at 3.
         */
        targetIndex = baseIndex + exhaustionMovementStep(level);

        if (targetIndex > 3) {
            targetIndex = 3;
        }

        return movementForTrackIndex(targetIndex);
    }

    function setCurrentEncumbranceMove(cid, moveValue) {
        var names = [
            'current_encumbrance_move',
            'movement_current',
            'current_movement',
            'move_current',
            'current_move',
            'movement_rate',
            'move_rate',
            'explore_map_movement',
            'explore_movement',
            'movement_adjusted',
            'adjusted_speed',
            'encumbrance_move'
        ];
        var i;
        var attr;
        var wrote = false;
        var safeMove = nearestMovementTrackValue(moveValue, true);

        /*
         * Write all matching current/adjusted movement fields.
         * Valid values are 12, 9, 6, 3, 0.
         */
        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            attr = findObjs({
                _type: 'attribute',
                _characterid: cid,
                name: names[i]
            }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];

            if (attr) {
                attr.set('current', String(safeMove));
                wrote = true;
            }
        }

        return wrote;
    }

    function applyExhaustionTokenMarker(tokenId, level) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);

        if (!token) {
            return;
        }

        if (level >= 6) {
            token.set('status_sleepy', true);
            sendChat(SCRIPT, '!token-mod --ids ' + tokenId + ' --set statusmarkers|sleepy');
        } else {
            token.set('status_sleepy', false);
            sendChat(SCRIPT, '!token-mod --ids ' + tokenId + ' --set statusmarkers|-sleepy');
        }
    }

    function applyExhaustionSheetEffects(tokenId, cid) {
        var level = getExhaustionLevel(cid);
        var storedBaseMove = getStoredExhaustionBaseMove(cid);
        var currentMove = readCurrentSheetMove(cid);
        var moveValue;

        /*
         * Preserve the sheet's current movement as the baseline the first time
         * exhaustion is applied. This prevents repeated changes from stacking
         * downward every time the exhaustion button is clicked.
         */
        if (level > 0 && isNaN(storedBaseMove)) {
            setStoredExhaustionBaseMove(cid, nearestMovementTrackValue(currentMove, false));
        }

        if (level <= 0) {
            if (!isNaN(storedBaseMove)) {
                setCurrentEncumbranceMove(cid, storedBaseMove);
            }

            clearStoredExhaustionBaseMove(cid);
            applyExhaustionTokenMarker(tokenId, level);
            return;
        }

        moveValue = effectiveExhaustionMovement(cid);

        setCurrentEncumbranceMove(cid, moveValue);
        applyExhaustionTokenMarker(tokenId, level);
    }

    function modSectionKey(tokenId, key) {
        return String(tokenId || '') + '|' + String(key || '');
    }

    function isModSectionOpen(tokenId, key) {
        initState();
        return !!state[SCRIPT].modSections[modSectionKey(tokenId, key)];
    }

    function toggleModSection(tokenId, key) {
        initState();

        key = modSectionKey(tokenId, key);

        if (state[SCRIPT].modSections[key]) {
            delete state[SCRIPT].modSections[key];
        } else {
            state[SCRIPT].modSections[key] = true;
        }
    }

    function modSectionHeader(tokenId, key, label, summary) {
        var open = isModSectionOpen(tokenId, key);
        var symbol = open ? '-' : '+';

        return '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border-left:3px solid #aa2222;padding:2px 4px;margin:5px 0 2px 0;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;">' +
            btn(symbol, '!gm1e-modsection|' + tokenId + '|' + key, open ? 'Collapse section.' : 'Expand section.') +
            '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:4px;">' + esc(label) + '</span>' +
            (summary ? '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;text-transform:none;color:#ddd;">' + summary + '</span>' : '') +
            '</div>';
    }

    function renderCollapsedSection(tokenId, key, label, summary, content) {
        var out = '';

        out += modSectionHeader(tokenId, key, label, summary);

        if (isModSectionOpen(tokenId, key)) {
            out += row(content);
        }

        return out;
    }
