    function findMod(key) {
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < ATTACK_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (ATTACK_MODS[i].key === key) {
                return ATTACK_MODS[i];
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i < SPELL_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (SPELL_MODS[i].key === key) {
                return SPELL_MODS[i];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    function findCover(key) {
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < COVER_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (COVER_MODS[i].key === key) {
                return COVER_MODS[i];
            }
        }

        return COVER_MODS[0];
    }

    function findConcealment(key) {
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < CONCEALMENT_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (CONCEALMENT_MODS[i].key === key) {
                return CONCEALMENT_MODS[i];
            }
        }

        return CONCEALMENT_MODS[0];
    }

    function getModifierSession(tokenId) {
        initState();

        if (!state[SCRIPT].modifiers[tokenId]) {
            state[SCRIPT].modifiers[tokenId] = {
                tokenId: tokenId,
                mods: {},
                cover: 'none',
                concealment: 'none',
                manualAttackBonus: 0,
                useManualAttackBonus: false
            };
        }

        if (!state[SCRIPT].modifiers[tokenId].concealment) {
            state[SCRIPT].modifiers[tokenId].concealment = 'none';
        }

        return state[SCRIPT].modifiers[tokenId];
    }

    function setModifierSession(session) {
        initState();
        state[SCRIPT].modifiers[session.tokenId] = session;
    }

    function clearModifierSession(tokenId) {
        initState();
        delete state[SCRIPT].modifiers[tokenId];
    }

    function collectWeapons(cid) {
        var attrs = getAttrsForChar(cid);
        var rows = {};
        var order = [];
        var i, n, rest, p, rowId, field, cur;

        for (i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) {
            n = attrs[i].get('name');

            if (n.indexOf('repeating_weapon_') !== 0) {
                continue;
            }

            rest = n.substring(17);
            p = rest.indexOf('_');

            if (p === -1) {
                continue;
            }

            rowId = rest.substring(0, p);
            field = rest.substring(p + 1);
            cur = attrs[i].get('current') || '';

            if (!rows[rowId]) {
                rows[rowId] = {
                    rowId: rowId,
                    name: '',
                    fields: {}
                };
                order.push(rowId);
            }

            rows[rowId].fields[field] = cur;

            if (field === 'weapon_name') {
                rows[rowId].name = cur;
            }
        }

        return {
            rows: rows,
            order: order
        };
    }

    function getWeapon(cid, rowId) {
        var data = collectWeapons(cid);
        var weapon = data.rows[rowId] || null;

        if (weapon) {
            weapon.characterId = cid;
        }

        return weapon;
    }

    function fieldNumber(weapon, names, fallback) {
        var i, v, n;

        if (!weapon || !weapon.fields) {
            return fallback;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            v = weapon.fields[names[i]];

            if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') !== '') {
                n = parseNumber(v);

                if (!isNaN(n)) {
                    return n;
                }
            }
        }

        return fallback;
    }

    function fieldText(weapon, names, fallback) {
        var i, v;

        if (!weapon || !weapon.fields) {
            return fallback || '';
        }

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            v = weapon.fields[names[i]];

            if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') !== '') {
                return String(v);
            }
        }

        return fallback || '';
    }

    function weaponMagicBonus(weapon) {
        return fieldNumber(weapon, ['weapon_magicbonus', 'magicbonus', 'weapon_magic', 'magic'], 0);
    }

    function weaponToHitBonus(weapon) {
        return fieldNumber(weapon, [
            'weapon_tohit',
            'weapon_to_hit',
            'weapon_attack_bonus',
            'weapon_hit_bonus',
            'attack_bonus',
            'tohit',
            'hit_bonus'
        ], 0);
    }

    function weaponAttackBonus(weapon) {
        return weaponToHitBonus(weapon) + weaponMagicBonus(weapon);
    }

    function weaponDamageAdjustment(weapon) {
        return fieldNumber(weapon, [
            'weapon_attackdmgbonus',
            'weapon_damage_bonus',
            'weapon_damagebonus',
            'weapon_dmgbonus',
            'weapon_dmg_adj',
            'weapon_damage_adj',
            'damage_bonus',
            'dmgbonus'
        ], 0);
    }

    function weaponDamageBonus(weapon) {
        return weaponDamageAdjustment(weapon) + weaponMagicBonus(weapon);
    }

    function weaponDamageText(weapon, sizeKey) {
        var fields, keys, i, v;

        if (!weapon) {
            return '';
        }

        fields = weapon.fields || {};

        if (sizeKey === 'lg') {
            keys = [
                'weapon_damagelarge',
                'weapon_damage_large',
                'damagelarge',
                'damage_large',
                'large_damage',
                'damage_lg'
            ];
        } else {
            keys = [
                'weapon_damagesmallmedium',
                'weapon_damage_smallmedium',
                'damagesmallmedium',
                'damage_smallmedium',
                'smallmedium_damage',
                'damage_sm',
                'damage'
            ];
        }

        for (i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
            v = fields[keys[i]];

            if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') !== '') {
                return String(v);
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function normalizeAttackTypeValue(value, fieldName) {
        var lower = String(value || '').toLowerCase().replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        var fname = String(fieldName || '').toLowerCase();

        if (lower === 'melee' || lower === 'ranged' || lower === 'missile' || lower === 'thrown') {
            return lower;
        }

        /*
         * Sheet dropdown compatibility:
         * Some Roll20 sheets store the Attack Type select as a numeric value.
         * On this sheet the visible choices are Melee/Ranged. Treat 0 as Melee
         * and 1 as Ranged only when the field name is clearly the attack type field.
         */
        if (fname.indexOf('attack') !== -1 && fname.indexOf('type') !== -1) {
            if (lower === '0') {
                return 'melee';
            }

            if (lower === '1') {
                return 'ranged';
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function weaponAttackType(weapon) {
        var fields;
        var keys;
        var i;
        var v;
        var normalized;

        if (!weapon || !weapon.fields) {
            return '';
        }

        fields = weapon.fields;

        keys = [
            'weapon_attack_type',
            'weapon_attacktype',
            'weapon_attacktype_select',
            'weapon_attack_type_select',
            'attack_type',
            'attacktype',
            'weapon_type',
            'weapon_category'
        ];

        for (i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
            v = fields[keys[i]];

            if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') !== '') {
                normalized = normalizeAttackTypeValue(v, keys[i]);

                if (normalized) {
                    return normalized;
                }
            }
        }

        /*
         * Compatibility fallback:
         * scan field names for Attack Type and normalize only those values.
         */
        for (i in fields) {
            if (fields.hasOwnProperty(i) && i.toLowerCase().indexOf('attack') !== -1 && i.toLowerCase().indexOf('type') !== -1) {
                normalized = normalizeAttackTypeValue(fields[i], i);

                if (normalized) {
                    return normalized;
                }
            }
        }

        /*
         * Final fallback: scan exact textual values only.
         */
        for (i in fields) {
            if (fields.hasOwnProperty(i)) {
                normalized = normalizeAttackTypeValue(fields[i], '');

                if (normalized) {
                    return normalized;
                }
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function weaponAmmoCurrent(weapon) {
        var n = fieldNumber(weapon, ['weapon_ammo', 'ammo'], NaN);
        var attr;
        var names;
        var i;

        if (!isNaN(n)) {
            return n;
        }

        if (weapon && weapon.characterId && weapon.rowId) {
            names = [
                'repeating_weapon_' + weapon.rowId + '_weapon_ammo',
                'repeating_weapon_' + weapon.rowId + '_ammo'
            ];

            for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
                attr = findObjs({
                    _type: 'attribute',
                    _characterid: weapon.characterId,
                    name: names[i]
                }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];

                if (attr) {
                    n = parseNumber(attr.get('current'));

                    if (!isNaN(n)) {
                        return n;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return NaN;
    }

    function weaponAmmoMax(weapon) {
        var n = fieldNumber(weapon, ['weapon_ammo_max', 'ammo_max', 'weapon_maxammo'], NaN);
        var attr;
        var attrs;
        var i;
        var name;
        var exactNames;

        if (!isNaN(n)) {
            return n;
        }

        /*
         * Exact sheet fields. The visible sheet tooltip is:
         * @{repeating_weapon_$X_weapon_ammo_max}
         */
        if (weapon && weapon.characterId && weapon.rowId) {
            exactNames = [
                'repeating_weapon_' + weapon.rowId + '_weapon_ammo_max',
                'repeating_weapon_' + weapon.rowId + '_ammo_max',
                'repeating_weapon_' + weapon.rowId + '_weapon_maxammo'
            ];

            for (i = 0; i < exactNames.length; i++) {
                attr = findObjs({
                    _type: 'attribute',
                    _characterid: weapon.characterId,
                    name: exactNames[i]
                }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];

                if (attr) {
                    n = parseNumber(attr.get('current'));

                    if (!isNaN(n)) {
                        return n;
                    }

                    n = parseNumber(attr.get('max'));

                    if (!isNaN(n)) {
                        return n;
                    }
                }
            }

            /*
             * Row-specific fallback: scan the row for an attribute ending in ammo max.
             */
            attrs = getAttrsForChar(weapon.characterId);

            for (i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) {
                name = String(attrs[i].get('name') || '').toLowerCase();

                if (name.indexOf('repeating_weapon_' + String(weapon.rowId).toLowerCase() + '_') === 0 &&
                    name.indexOf('ammo') !== -1 &&
                    name.indexOf('max') !== -1) {
                    n = parseNumber(attrs[i].get('current'));

                    if (!isNaN(n)) {
                        return n;
                    }

                    n = parseNumber(attrs[i].get('max'));

                    if (!isNaN(n)) {
                        return n;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        /*
         * Compatibility fallback:
         * Some sheets store max ammo under generated or slightly different field names.
         */
        if (weapon && weapon.fields) {
            for (var k in weapon.fields) {
                if (weapon.fields.hasOwnProperty(k) && k.toLowerCase().indexOf('ammo') !== -1 && k.toLowerCase().indexOf('max') !== -1) {
                    n = parseNumber(weapon.fields[k]);

                    if (!isNaN(n)) {
                        return n;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return NaN;
    }

    function setWeaponAmmoCurrent(cid, rowId, value) {
        var names = [
            'repeating_weapon_' + rowId + '_weapon_ammo',
            'repeating_weapon_' + rowId + '_ammo'
        ];
        var i;
        var attr;

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            attr = findObjs({
                _type: 'attribute',
                _characterid: cid,
                name: names[i]
            }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];

            if (attr) {
                attr.set('current', String(value));
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    function weaponRangeText(weapon) {
        return fieldText(weapon, ['weapon_range', 'range', 'weapon_rng'], '');
    }

    function isRangedWeapon(weapon) {
        var t;

        if (!weapon) {
            return false;
        }

        /*
         * Only the sheet's Attack Type determines ranged/melee classification.
         * Do not infer ranged from range/ammo fields because this sheet can retain
         * quantity/resource fields on melee rows.
         */
        t = weaponAttackType(weapon);

        if (t === 'ranged' || t === 'missile' || t === 'thrown') {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    function setWeaponField(cid, rowId, field, value) {
        var attrName = 'repeating_weapon_' + rowId + '_' + field;
        var attr = findObjs({
            _type: 'attribute',
            _characterid: cid,
            name: attrName
        }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];

        if (attr) {
            attr.set('current', String(value));
        }
    }

    function parseRangeBands(weapon) {
        var raw = weaponRangeText(weapon);
        var parts = String(raw || '').split('/');
        var nums = [];
        var i;
        var n;

        for (i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            n = parseNumber(parts[i]);

            if (!isNaN(n)) {
                nums.push(n * 10);
            }
        }

        if (!nums.length) {
            nums = [10, 20, 30];
        }

        if (nums.length === 1) {
            nums = [nums[0], nums[0], nums[0]];
        } else if (nums.length === 2) {
            nums = [nums[0], nums[1], nums[1]];
        }

        return {
            shortFt: nums[0],
            mediumFt: nums[1],
            longFt: nums[2],
            raw: raw || (nums[0] / 10) + '/' + (nums[1] / 10) + '/' + (nums[2] / 10)
        };
    }

    function rangePenaltyForChoice(choice) {
        choice = String(choice || 'short').toLowerCase();

        if (choice === 'medium') {
            return -2;
        }

        if (choice === 'long') {
            return -5;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    function rangeLabelForChoice(weapon, choice) {
        var r = parseRangeBands(weapon);

        choice = String(choice || 'short').toLowerCase();

        if (choice === 'medium') {
            return 'Medium range, ' + (r.shortFt + 1) + '-' + r.mediumFt + ' ft';
        }

        if (choice === 'long') {
            return 'Long range, ' + (r.mediumFt + 1) + '-' + r.longFt + ' ft';
        }

        if (choice === 'beyond') {
            return 'Beyond long range, beyond ' + r.longFt + ' ft';
        }

        return 'Short range, 1-' + r.shortFt + ' ft';
    }

    function rangeButtonLabel(weapon, choice) {
        return rangeLabelForChoice(weapon, choice).replace('Short range, ', 'Attack Short ').replace('Medium range, ', 'Attack Medium ').replace('Long range, ', 'Attack Long ').replace('Beyond long range, ', 'Beyond ');
    }

    function ammoLineHtml(ammoBefore, ammoAfter, ammoMax) {
        return '<b>Ammo:</b> ' +
            esc(String(ammoBefore)) +
            ' before attack; ' +
            esc(String(ammoAfter)) +
            ' available after attack.';
    }

    function rangedInfoLineHtml(data) {
        var out = '';

        if (!data.isRanged) {
            return '';
        }

        out += '<b>Ranged Attack:</b> ' + esc(data.rangeLabel);

        if (data.rangeChoice === 'beyond') {
            out += '; ' + bad('beyond maximum range, no attack possible.');
        } else if (data.rangePenalty !== 0) {
            out += '; range modifier ' + esc(signed(data.rangePenalty)) + '.';
        } else {
            out += '; range modifier +0.';
        }

        return out;
    }

    function rollDamageExpression(expr) {
        var s = String(expr || '').toLowerCase();
        var total = 0;
        var detail = [];
        var m, count, sides, mod, i, r, low, high;

        s = s.replace(/\s+/g, '');
        s = s.replace(/–/g, '-');
        s = s.replace(/—/g, '-');

        if (!s) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                total: 0,
                detail: 'No damage expression found.',
                baseTotal: 0,
                exprMod: 0
            };
        }

        if (s.indexOf('/') !== -1) {
            s = s.split('/')[0];
        }

        m = s.match(/^(\d*)d(\d+)([+-]\d+)?$/);
        if (m) {
            playDiceSound();

            count = m[1] ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 1;
            sides = parseInt(m[2], 10);
            mod = m[3] ? parseInt(m[3], 10) : 0;

            for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                r = randomInteger(sides);
                total += r;
                detail.push(String(r));
            }

            total += mod;

            return {
                ok: true,
                total: total,
                detail: count + 'd' + sides + ' [' + detail.join(', ') + ']' + (mod ? ' ' + signed(mod) : ''),
                baseTotal: total - mod,
                exprMod: mod
            };
        }

        m = s.match(/^(\d+)-(\d+)$/);
        if (m) {
            playDiceSound();

            low = parseInt(m[1], 10);
            high = parseInt(m[2], 10);

            if (high < low) {
                high = low;
            }

            r = low + randomInteger(high - low + 1) - 1;

            return {
                ok: true,
                total: r,
                detail: s + ' range roll',
                baseTotal: r,
                exprMod: 0
            };
        }

        m = s.match(/^(\d+)([+-]\d+)?$/);
        if (m) {
            total = parseInt(m[1], 10);
            mod = m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 0;
            total += mod;

            return {
                ok: true,
                total: total,
                detail: s,
                baseTotal: total - mod,
                exprMod: mod
            };
        }

        return {
            ok: false,
            total: 0,
            detail: 'Could not parse damage expression: ' + expr,
            baseTotal: 0,
            exprMod: 0
        };
    }

    function selectedModTotal(modSession) {
        var total = 0;
        var key, def;

        for (key in modSession.mods) {
            if (modSession.mods.hasOwnProperty(key) && modSession.mods[key]) {
                def = findMod(key);
                if (def) {
                    total += def.mod || 0;
                }
            }
        }

        return total;
    }

    function hasAutomaticHit(modSession) {
        var key, def;

        for (key in modSession.mods) {
            if (modSession.mods.hasOwnProperty(key) && modSession.mods[key]) {
                def = findMod(key);
                if (def && def.automatic) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    function subdualDamageActive(modSession) {
        return !!(modSession && modSession.mods && modSession.mods.subdual);
    }

    function backstabDamageActive(modSession) {
        return !!(modSession && modSession.mods && modSession.mods.backstab);
    }

    function backstabDamageMultiplier(data) {
        var cid = data && data.aChar ? data.aChar.id : '';
        var multiplier;

        if (!backstabDamageActive(data ? data.modSession : null)) {
            return 1;
        }

        multiplier = getAttrNumber(cid, ['backstab'], 2);

        if (multiplier < 2) {
            multiplier = 2;
        }

        return multiplier;
    }

    function selectedModSummary(modSession) {
        var out = '';
        var key, def;
        var found = false;

        for (key in modSession.mods) {
            if (modSession.mods.hasOwnProperty(key) && modSession.mods[key]) {
                def = findMod(key);

                if (def && (def.automatic || def.mod !== 0 || def.noteOnly)) {
                    found = true;
                    out += infoPill(def.label + (def.automatic ? ': automatic' : (def.noteOnly ? '' : ' ' + signed(def.mod))));
                }
            }
        }

        if (!found) {
            return '<span style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#ddd;font-size:11px;">No non-zero attack/spell modifiers selected.</span>';
        }

        return out;
    }

    function groupHasActiveMods(modSession, defs) {
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < defs.length; i++) {
            if (modSession.mods && modSession.mods[defs[i].key]) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    function clearModGroup(modSession, defs) {
        var i;

        modSession.mods = modSession.mods || {};

        for (i = 0; i < defs.length; i++) {
            delete modSession.mods[defs[i].key];
        }
    }

    function groupModSummary(modSession, defs) {
        var total = 0;
        var i;
        var def;
        var count = 0;

        for (i = 0; i < defs.length; i++) {
            def = defs[i];

            if (modSession.mods && modSession.mods[def.key]) {
                count++;
                total += def.mod || 0;
            }
        }

        if (!count) {
            return '<span style="color:#51d66b;">None</span>';
        }

        return '<span style="color:' + (total < 0 ? '#ff5555' : '#51d66b') + ';">' + esc(signed(total)) + '</span>';
    }

    function renderModButtonsWithNone(modSession, defs, groupKey) {
        var out = '';
        var activeAny = groupHasActiveMods(modSession, defs);

        if (activeAny) {
            out += btnOff('None', '!gm1e-modgroupclear|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + groupKey, 'Clear this modifier group.');
        } else {
            out += btnOn('None', '!gm1e-modgroupclear|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + groupKey, 'No modifiers selected in this group.');
        }

        out += renderModButtons(modSession, defs);

        return out;
    }

    function activeModifierTotalForToken(tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var modSession = getModifierSession(tokenId);
        var cover = findCover(modSession.cover);
        var concealment = findConcealment(modSession.concealment);
        var manualBonus = toInt(modSession.manualAttackBonus, 0);
        var exPenalty = cid ? exhaustionPenalty(getExhaustionLevel(cid)) : 0;

        return selectedModTotal(modSession) + manualBonus - (cover.penalty || 0) - (concealment.penalty || 0) + exPenalty;
    }

    function activeModifierDisplay(tokenId) {
        var total = activeModifierTotalForToken(tokenId);
        var color = total < 0 ? '#ff5555' : '#51d66b';
        var label = signed(total);

        return '<div style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#fff;margin:2px 0 3px 0;font-size:12px;">' +
            '<b>Active Modifiers:</b> ' +
            '<span style="color:' + color + ';font-weight:bold;">' + esc(label) + '</span>' +
            '</div>';
    }

    function weaponAmmoDisplay(weapon) {
        var ammo = weaponAmmoCurrent(weapon);

        if (isNaN(ammo)) {
            return '';
        }

        return ' <span style="color:#51d66b;font-weight:bold;">Ammo: ' + esc(String(ammo)) + '</span>';
    }

    function resultHasOwnClear(lines) {
        var i;

        if (!lines || !lines.length) {
            return false;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            if (lines[i] && lines[i].type === 'clearfooter') {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    function removeClearFooter(lines) {
        var out = [];
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < (lines || []).length; i++) {
            if (lines[i] && lines[i].type !== 'clearfooter') {
                out.push(lines[i]);
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function removeExistingDamage(lines) {
        var out = [];
        var i;
        var skippingDamage = false;

        for (i = 0; i < (lines || []).length; i++) {
            if (lines[i] && lines[i].type === 'section' && String(lines[i].text || '').indexOf('Damage') === 0) {
                skippingDamage = true;
                continue;
            }

            if (skippingDamage && lines[i] && lines[i].type === 'section') {
                skippingDamage = false;
            }

            if (!skippingDamage) {
                out.push(lines[i]);
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderResultBlock(lines) {
        var out = '';
        var i, l;

        if (!lines || !lines.length) {
            return '';
        }

        out += hr();
        out += section('Last Result');

        for (i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            l = lines[i];

            if (l.type === 'section') {
                out += section(l.text);
            } else if (l.type === 'good') {
                out += row(good(l.text));
            } else if (l.type === 'bad') {
                out += row(bad(l.text));
            } else if (l.type === 'html' || l.type === 'clearfooter') {
                out += row(l.text);
            } else {
                out += row(neutral(l.text));
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderPublicResultBlock(lines) {
        var out = '';
        var i, l;

        if (!lines || !lines.length) {
            return '';
        }

        for (i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            l = lines[i];

            if (l.type === 'section') {
                out += section(l.text);
            } else if (l.type === 'good') {
                out += row(good(l.text));
            } else if (l.type === 'bad') {
                out += row(bad(l.text));
            } else if (l.type === 'html') {
                out += row(l.text);
            } else if (l.type === 'clearfooter') {
                /*
                 * Clear Result is a GM-menu control. Do not show it in public attack/damage output.
                 */
            } else {
                out += row(neutral(l.text));
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function sendPublicCombatResult(lines) {
        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(renderPublicResultBlock(lines)));
    }

    function renderModButtons(modSession, defs) {
        var out = '';
        var i, def, active, label;

        for (i = 0; i < defs.length; i++) {
            def = defs[i];
            active = !!modSession.mods[def.key];

            label = def.label;

            if (def.automatic) {
                label += ' AUTO';
            } else if (def.mod !== 0) {
                label += ' ' + signed(def.mod);
            }

            if (active) {
                out += btnOn(label, '!gm1e-modtoggle|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + def.key, def.note || '');
            } else {
                out += btnOff(label, '!gm1e-modtoggle|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + def.key, def.note || '');
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderCoverButtons(modSession) {
        var out = '';
        var i, def, active, label;

        for (i = 0; i < COVER_MODS.length; i++) {
            def = COVER_MODS[i];
            active = modSession.cover === def.key;

            label = def.label;

            if (def.penalty) {
                label += ' -' + def.penalty + ' to attack';
            }

            if (active) {
                out += btnOn(label, '!gm1e-modcover|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + def.key);
            } else {
                out += btnOff(label, '!gm1e-modcover|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + def.key);
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderConcealmentButtons(modSession) {
        var out = '';
        var i, def, active, label;

        for (i = 0; i < CONCEALMENT_MODS.length; i++) {
            def = CONCEALMENT_MODS[i];
            active = modSession.concealment === def.key;

            label = def.label;

            if (def.penalty) {
                label += ' -' + def.penalty + ' to attack';
            }

            if (active) {
                out += btnOn(label, '!gm1e-modconceal|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + def.key);
            } else {
                out += btnOff(label, '!gm1e-modconceal|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + def.key);
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function coverConcealmentSummary(modSession) {
        var cover = findCover(modSession.cover);
        var concealment = findConcealment(modSession.concealment);
        var parts = [];

        if (cover.penalty) {
            parts.push('Cover -' + cover.penalty);
        }

        if (concealment.penalty) {
            parts.push('Concealment -' + concealment.penalty);
        }

        if (!parts.length) {
            return '<span style="color:#51d66b;">None</span>';
        }

        return pill(parts.join('; '));
    }

    function renderCoverConcealmentButtons(modSession) {
        var out = '';

        out += '<div style="margin:2px 0;"><b>Cover:</b></div>';
        out += renderCoverButtons(modSession);
        out += '<div style="margin:6px 0 2px 0;"><b>Concealment:</b></div>';
        out += renderConcealmentButtons(modSession);

        return out;
    }

    function renderManualBonusButtons(modSession) {
        var out = '';
        var i;
        var current = toInt(modSession.manualAttackBonus, 0);
        var label;
        var href;

        for (i = -10; i <= 10; i++) {
            label = signed(i);
            href = '!gm1e-modmanual|' + modSession.tokenId + '|' + i;

            if (current === i) {
                out += btnOn(label, href, 'Manual attack modifier selected. Click +0 to clear.');
            } else {
                out += btnOff(label, href, 'Set custom modifier to ' + label + '.');
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderCombatAttackModifierContent(modSession) {
        var out = '';
        var manualBonus = toInt(modSession.manualAttackBonus, 0);

        out += renderModButtonsWithNone(modSession, ATTACK_MODS, 'attack');
        out += '<div style="margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #333;padding-top:4px;"><b>Custom Modifier:</b> ' +
            (manualBonus !== 0 ? pill(signed(manualBonus)) : '<span style="color:#51d66b;">+0</span>') +
            '</div>';
        out += '<div style="margin-left:8px;">' + renderManualBonusButtons(modSession) + '</div>';
        out += '<div style="margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #333;padding-top:4px;"><b>Cover / Concealment</b></div>';
        out += '<div style="margin-left:8px;">' + renderCoverConcealmentButtons(modSession) + '</div>';

        return out;
    }

    function renderExhaustionButtons(tokenId, cid) {
        var out = '';
        var current = getExhaustionLevel(cid);
        var i;
        var label;
        var href;

        if (current === 0) {
            out += btnOn('None', '!gm1e-exhaustion|' + tokenId + '|0', 'No exhaustion.');
        } else {
            out += btnOff('None', '!gm1e-exhaustion|' + tokenId + '|0', 'Clear exhaustion.');
        }

        for (i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            label = 'Level ' + i;
            href = '!gm1e-exhaustion|' + tokenId + '|' + i;

            if (current === i) {
                out += btnOn(label, href, exhaustionInfo(i));
            } else {
                out += btnOff(label, href, exhaustionInfo(i));
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function getFirstNonZeroAttrNumber(cid, names) {
        var i;
        var n;

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            n = getAttrNumber(cid, [names[i]], NaN);

            if (!isNaN(n) && n !== 0) {
                return Math.abs(n);
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    function getDefenderShieldAdjustment(cid) {
        if (!cid) {
            return 0;
        }

        return getFirstNonZeroAttrNumber(cid, [
            'shield_bonus',
            'shieldbonus',
            'shield_ac_bonus',
            'shieldacbonus',
            'shield_ac',
            'shieldac',
            'ac_shield',
            'armorclass_shield',
            'shield_adjustment',
            'shieldadj'
        ]);
    }

    function getDefenderDexAdjustment(cid) {
        if (!cid) {
            return 0;
        }

        return getFirstNonZeroAttrNumber(cid, [
            'dex_ac_bonus',
            'dexacbonus',
            'dex_ac',
            'dexac',
            'ac_dex',
            'armorclass_dex',
            'dexterity_ac_bonus',
            'dexterity_ac_adjustment',
            'dex_defense_adjustment',
            'defensive_adjustment',
            'reaction_defensive_adjustment'
        ]);
    }

    function getDefenderShieldlessAC(cid) {
        var n;

        if (!cid) {
            return NaN;
        }

        n = getAttrNumber(cid, [
            'armorclass_shieldless',
            'armorclassshieldless',
            'shieldless_ac',
            'ac_shieldless',
            'armor_class_shieldless',
            'ac_no_shield',
            'noshield_ac',
            'no_shield_ac',
            'without_shield_ac',
            'armorclass_no_shield',
            'armorclassnoshield',
            'shieldless'
        ], NaN);

        return n;
    }

    function getDefenderRearAC(cid) {
        var n;

        if (!cid) {
            return NaN;
        }

        n = getAttrNumber(cid, [
            'armorclass_rear',
            'armorclassrear',
            'rear_ac',
            'ac_rear',
            'armor_class_rear',
            'reararmorclass',
            'rear_armorclass',
            'rear'
        ], NaN);

        return n;
    }

    function frontFlankActive(modSession) {
        return !!(modSession && modSession.mods && modSession.mods.flank);
    }

    function rearAttackActive(modSession) {
        return !!(modSession && modSession.mods && modSession.mods.rear);
    }

    function weaponDualLabel(weapon) {
        var label = fieldText(weapon, ['weapon_dual', 'dual', 'weapon_dual_wield', 'dual_wield'], 'Normal');

        label = String(label || 'Normal').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');

        if (!label) {
            label = 'Normal';
        }

        return label;
    }

    function weaponDualPenalty(weapon) {
        var label = weaponDualLabel(weapon).toLowerCase();
        var n;

        if (label === 'normal' || label === 'none') {
            return 0;
        }

        n = fieldNumber(weapon, ['weapon_dual_pen', 'dual_pen', 'weapon_dual_penalty', 'dual_penalty'], 0);

        if (isNaN(n)) {
            return 0;
        }

        return n;
    }

    function getCombatData(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, rangeChoice) {
        var attacker = tokenById(attackerTokenId);
        var defender = tokenById(targetTokenId);
        var modSession = getModifierSession(attackerTokenId);
        var aChar = charByToken(attacker);
        var dChar = charByToken(defender);
        var weapon = aChar ? getWeapon(aChar.id, rowId) : null;
        var thac0 = aChar ? getAttrNumber(aChar.id, ['thac0', 'thaco', 'THAC0', 'npc_thac0', 'npc_thaco'], 20) : 20;
        var meleeBonus = aChar ? getAttrNumber(aChar.id, ['meleebonus', 'attackbonus', 'tohitbonus', 'hitbonus'], 0) : 0;
        var wToHit = weaponToHitBonus(weapon);
        var wMagic = weaponMagicBonus(weapon);
        var wAttackBonus = weaponAttackBonus(weapon);
        var wDualLabel = weaponDualLabel(weapon);
        var wDualPenalty = weaponDualPenalty(weapon);
        var wDamageAdj = weaponDamageAdjustment(weapon);
        var wDamageBonus = weaponDamageBonus(weapon);
        var manualBonus = toInt(modSession.manualAttackBonus, 0);
        var defenderBaseAC = dChar ? getAttrNumber(dChar.id, ['armorclass', 'ac', 'AC'], 10) : 10;
        var shieldIgnored = 0;
        var dexIgnored = 0;
        var defenderAC;
        var cover = findCover(modSession.cover);
        var concealment = findConcealment(modSession.concealment);
        var modTotal = selectedModTotal(modSession);
        var coverPenalty = cover.penalty || 0;
        var concealmentPenalty = concealment.penalty || 0;
        var ranged = isRangedWeapon(weapon);
        var rangeChoiceClean = String(rangeChoice || 'short').toLowerCase();
        var rangePenalty = ranged ? rangePenaltyForChoice(rangeChoiceClean) : 0;
        var exhaustionLevel = aChar ? getExhaustionLevel(aChar.id) : 0;
        var exhaustionAttackPenalty = exhaustionPenalty(exhaustionLevel);
        var totalAttackBonus;
        var needed;

        /*
         * Front Flank: no to-hit bonus, but defender shield AC bonus is ignored.
         * Rear Attack: +2 to hit from the modifier button, and defender shield
         * and Dexterity AC bonuses are ignored.
         *
         * Prefer the sheet's explicit Shieldless and Rear AC fields when present.
         * This sheet displays those directly in Armor Details, so they are more
         * reliable than trying to reconstruct shield/Dex bonuses from component
         * attributes.
         */
        defenderAC = defenderBaseAC;

        if (dChar && frontFlankActive(modSession) && !rearAttackActive(modSession)) {
            var shieldlessAC = getDefenderShieldlessAC(dChar.id);

            if (!isNaN(shieldlessAC)) {
                defenderAC = shieldlessAC;
                shieldIgnored = shieldlessAC - defenderBaseAC;
            } else {
                shieldIgnored = getDefenderShieldAdjustment(dChar.id);
                defenderAC = defenderBaseAC + shieldIgnored;
            }
        }

        if (dChar && rearAttackActive(modSession)) {
            var rearAC = getDefenderRearAC(dChar.id);

            if (!isNaN(rearAC)) {
                defenderAC = rearAC;
                shieldIgnored = Math.max(0, rearAC - defenderBaseAC);
                dexIgnored = 0;
            } else {
                shieldIgnored = getDefenderShieldAdjustment(dChar.id);
                dexIgnored = getDefenderDexAdjustment(dChar.id);
                defenderAC = defenderBaseAC + shieldIgnored + dexIgnored;
            }
        }

        totalAttackBonus = meleeBonus + wAttackBonus + wDualPenalty + manualBonus + modTotal - coverPenalty - concealmentPenalty + rangePenalty + exhaustionAttackPenalty;
        needed = thac0 - defenderAC;

        return {
            attacker: attacker,
            defender: defender,
            attackerTokenId: attackerTokenId,
            targetTokenId: targetTokenId,
            rowId: rowId,
            modSession: modSession,
            aChar: aChar,
            dChar: dChar,
            weapon: weapon,
            weaponName: weapon ? (weapon.name || 'Unnamed Weapon') : 'Unknown Weapon',
            thac0: thac0,
            meleeBonus: meleeBonus,
            weaponToHitBonus: wToHit,
            weaponMagicBonus: wMagic,
            weaponBonus: wAttackBonus,
            weaponDualLabel: wDualLabel,
            weaponDualPenalty: wDualPenalty,
            weaponDamageAdjustment: wDamageAdj,
            damageBonus: wDamageBonus,
            manualBonus: manualBonus,
            defenderBaseAC: defenderBaseAC,
            defenderAC: defenderAC,
            shieldIgnored: shieldIgnored,
            dexIgnored: dexIgnored,
            cover: cover,
            concealment: concealment,
            modTotal: modTotal,
            coverPenalty: coverPenalty,
            concealmentPenalty: concealmentPenalty,
            exhaustionLevel: exhaustionLevel,
            exhaustionAttackPenalty: exhaustionAttackPenalty,
            isRanged: ranged,
            rangeChoice: rangeChoiceClean,
            rangePenalty: rangePenalty,
            rangeLabel: ranged ? rangeLabelForChoice(weapon, rangeChoiceClean) : '',
            totalAttackBonus: totalAttackBonus,
            needed: needed
        };
    }

    function modifierSummaryHtml(data) {
        var parts = [];

        if (data.meleeBonus !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.meleeBonus) + ' melee');
        }

        if (data.weaponToHitBonus !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.weaponToHitBonus) + ' weapon to-hit');
        }

        if (data.weaponMagicBonus !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.weaponMagicBonus) + ' weapon magic');
        }

        if (data.weaponDualPenalty !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.weaponDualPenalty) + ' ' + data.weaponDualLabel + ' dual-wield weapon row');
        }

        if (data.manualBonus !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.manualBonus) + ' custom');
        }

        if (data.modTotal !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.modTotal) + ' selected modifiers');
        }

        if (data.coverPenalty !== 0) {
            parts.push('-' + data.coverPenalty + ' cover');
        }

        if (data.concealmentPenalty !== 0) {
            parts.push('-' + data.concealmentPenalty + ' concealment');
        }

        if (data.isRanged && data.rangePenalty !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.rangePenalty) + ' range');
        }

        if (data.exhaustionLevel > 0 && data.exhaustionLevel < 6 && data.exhaustionAttackPenalty !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.exhaustionAttackPenalty) + ' exhaustion');
        }

        if (data.defenderBaseAC !== data.defenderAC && frontFlankActive(data.modSession) && !rearAttackActive(data.modSession)) {
            parts.push('side attack AC used: ' + data.defenderAC);
        } else if (data.defenderBaseAC !== data.defenderAC && rearAttackActive(data.modSession)) {
            parts.push('rear AC used: ' + data.defenderAC);
        } else if (data.shieldIgnored !== 0) {
            parts.push('defender shield ignored: AC +' + data.shieldIgnored);
        }

        if (data.dexIgnored !== 0) {
            parts.push('defender Dexterity ignored: AC +' + data.dexIgnored);
        }

        if (!parts.length) {
            parts.push('none');
        }

        return parts.join('; ');
    }

    function modifiedNumberNeeded(data) {
        /*
         * Attacks succeed when d20 plus modifiers is equal to or greater than
         * the matrix number. For display, convert the modifiers into the
         * natural d20 number needed.
         */
        return data.needed - data.totalAttackBonus;
    }

    function setupModifierSummary(data) {
        var out = '';
        var modifiedNeeded = modifiedNumberNeeded(data);

        out += row('<b>THAC0:</b> ' + esc(String(data.thac0)) + ' vs <b>AC:</b> ' + esc(String(data.defenderAC)) + (data.defenderBaseAC !== data.defenderAC ? ' <span style="color:#ddd;">(base AC ' + esc(String(data.defenderBaseAC)) + ')</span>' : '') + '; <b>Matrix Number:</b> ' + pill(String(data.needed)));
        out += row('<b>Current Attack Modifiers:</b> ' + esc(modifierSummaryHtml(data)));
        out += row('<b>Modified Number Needed:</b> ' + pill(String(modifiedNeeded)) + ' or greater on d20.');

        return out;
    }

    function attackRollHtml(d20, data, total, isHit) {
        var out = '';
        var modifiedNeeded = modifiedNumberNeeded(data);

        out += '<div style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;">';
        out += '<div><b>Attack Roll:</b> d20 = ' + diePill(String(d20)) + '</div>';
        out += '<div><b>Modifiers:</b> ' + esc(modifierSummaryHtml(data)) + '</div>';
        out += '<div><b>Modified Number Needed:</b> ' + pill(String(modifiedNeeded)) + ' or greater</div>';
        out += '<div style="display:block;margin:4px 0;min-height:20px;">';
        out += '<span style="display:inline-block;width:42%;text-align:left;"><b>Modified Roll:</b></span>';
        out += '<span style="display:inline-block;width:18%;text-align:center;">' + resultPill(String(total), isHit) + '</span>';
        out += '<span style="display:inline-block;width:40%;">&nbsp;</span>';
        out += '</div>';
        out += '</div>';

        return out;
    }

    function resultWordHtml(text, color) {
        return '<div style="font-size:14px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:bold;color:' + color + ';">' + esc(text) + '</div>';
    }

    function resultClearFooterHtml(tokenId, text, color) {
        return '<div style="display:block;margin-top:8px;min-height:24px;">' +
            '<span style="display:inline-block;width:50%;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;font-size:14px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:bold;color:' + color + ';">' + esc(text) + '</span>' +
            '<span style="display:inline-block;width:50%;text-align:right;vertical-align:middle;">' + btn('Clear Result', '!gm1e-clearresult|' + tokenId) + '</span>' +
            '</div>';
    }

    function damageModSummary(data) {
        var parts = [];

        if (data.weaponDamageAdjustment !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.weaponDamageAdjustment) + ' weapon DMG Adj.');
        }

        if (data.weaponMagicBonus !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(data.weaponMagicBonus) + ' weapon magic');
        }

        if (data.backstabMultiplier && data.backstabMultiplier > 1) {
            parts.push('x' + data.backstabMultiplier + ' backstab');
        }

        if (!parts.length) {
            return 'none';
        }

        return parts.join('; ');
    }

    function damageRollHtml(detail, data, totalDamage) {
        var out = '';
        var realDamage;
        var tempDamage;

        out += '<div style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:bold;color:#ff4444;">';
        out += '<div>Damage Roll: ' + dmgPill(detail) + '</div>';
        out += '<div>Damage Modifiers: ' + esc(damageModSummary(data)) + '</div>';

        if (data.backstabMultiplier && data.backstabMultiplier > 1) {
            out += '<div title="Multiplier damage applied on a hit." style="color:#ddd;font-weight:normal;"><b style="color:#f4d36a;">Backstab:</b> ' +
                esc(String(data.preBackstabDamage)) + ' x ' + esc(String(data.backstabMultiplier)) + ' = ' + dmgPill(String(totalDamage)) +
                '</div>';
        }

        out += '<div style="text-align:center;margin:8px 0 2px 0;font-size:13px;"><b>Total Damage:</b> ' + dmgPill(String(totalDamage)) + '</div>';

        if (subdualDamageActive(data.modSession)) {
            realDamage = Math.floor(totalDamage / 4);
            tempDamage = totalDamage - realDamage;
            out += '<div title="' + esc(SUBDUAL_NOTE) + '" style="margin-top:6px;color:#ddd;font-weight:normal;">' +
                '<b style="color:#51d66b;">Subdual Damage:</b> ' +
                esc(String(realDamage)) + ' real, ' + esc(String(tempDamage)) + ' temporary. ' +
                esc('25% real damage, 75% temporary.') +
                '</div>';
        }

        out += '</div>';
        return out;
    }

    function damageButtons(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId) {
        return btn('Roll Damage S/M', '!gm1e-rolldamage|' + attackerTokenId + '|' + rowId + '|' + targetTokenId + '|sm') +
            btn('Roll Damage Large', '!gm1e-rolldamage|' + attackerTokenId + '|' + rowId + '|' + targetTokenId + '|lg');
    }

    function renderModifierMenu(playerId, tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var modSession = getModifierSession(tokenId);
        var html = '';
        var modTotal = selectedModTotal(modSession);
        var cover = findCover(modSession.cover);
        var concealment = findConcealment(modSession.concealment);
        var manualBonus = toInt(modSession.manualAttackBonus, 0);
        var exLevel = cid ? getExhaustionLevel(cid) : 0;
        var exPenalty = exhaustionPenalty(exLevel);
        var total = modTotal + manualBonus - (cover.penalty || 0) - (concealment.penalty || 0) + exPenalty;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Modifier Setup Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        html += title('Attack Modifiers');
        html += row('<b>' + esc(tokenName(token)) + '</b>');
        html += row('<b>All Modifiers Total:</b> ' + pill(signed(total)));

        html += hr();

        html += renderCollapsedSection(
            tokenId,
            'attack',
            'Combat Attack Modifiers',
            groupModSummary(modSession, ATTACK_MODS) +
                (manualBonus !== 0 ? ' Custom ' + pill(signed(manualBonus)) : '') +
                ' Cover/Conceal ' + coverConcealmentSummary(modSession),
            renderCombatAttackModifierContent(modSession)
        );

        html += renderCollapsedSection(
            tokenId,
            'spell',
            'Spell Modifiers',
            groupModSummary(modSession, SPELL_MODS),
            renderModButtonsWithNone(modSession, SPELL_MODS, 'spell')
        );

        html += hr();
        html += row(btn('Back', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId) + btn('Clear Modifiers', '!gm1e-modclear|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(html));
    }

    function fireIntoMeleeKey(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId) {
        return String(attackerTokenId || '') + '|' + String(rowId || '') + '|' + String(targetTokenId || '');
    }

    function isFireIntoMeleeOn(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId) {
        initState();
        return !!state[SCRIPT].fireIntoMelee[fireIntoMeleeKey(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId)];
    }

    function setFireIntoMelee(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, value) {
        initState();

        if (value) {
            state[SCRIPT].fireIntoMelee[fireIntoMeleeKey(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId)] = true;
        } else {
            delete state[SCRIPT].fireIntoMelee[fireIntoMeleeKey(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId)];
        }
    }

    function fireIntoMeleeAttackHref(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, rangeChoice) {
        if (isFireIntoMeleeOn(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId)) {
            return '!gm1e-quickattack|' + attackerTokenId + '|' + rowId + '|' + targetTokenId + '|' + rangeChoice + '|?{How many creatures are in the melee?|2}';
        }

        return '!gm1e-quickattack|' + attackerTokenId + '|' + rowId + '|' + targetTokenId + '|' + rangeChoice;
    }

    function otherTargetAttackHref(attackerTokenId, rowId, rangeChoice) {
        return '!gm1e-quickattack|' + attackerTokenId + '|' + rowId + '|@{target|Choose actual fire-into-melee target|token_id}|' + rangeChoice + '|0';
    }

    function attackSetupMenu(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, playerId) {
        var attacker = tokenById(attackerTokenId);
        var defender = tokenById(targetTokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(attacker);
        var weapon = ch ? getWeapon(ch.id, rowId) : null;
        var ranges = parseRangeBands(weapon);
        var ammo = weaponAmmoCurrent(weapon);
        var ammoText;
        var html = '';
        var ranged;
        var dataShort;
        var dataMedium;
        var dataLong;

        if (!attacker || !defender || !ch || !weapon) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(title('Attack Setup Error') + row(bad('Missing attacker, defender, or weapon.'))));
            return;
        }

        ranged = isRangedWeapon(weapon);
        dataShort = getCombatData(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, 'short');
        dataMedium = getCombatData(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, 'medium', '0');
        dataLong = getCombatData(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, 'long', '0');

        html += title(ranged ? 'Ranged Attack Setup' : 'Melee Attack Setup');
        html += row('<b>Attacker:</b> ' + esc(tokenName(attacker)));
        html += row('<b>Defender:</b> ' + esc(tokenName(defender)));
        html += row('<b>Weapon:</b> ' + esc(weapon.name || 'Unnamed Weapon') + ' ' + infoPill(ranged ? 'Ranged' : 'Melee'));
        html += section('Attack Matrix');
        html += setupModifierSummary(dataShort);

        if (ranged) {
            ammoText = isNaN(ammo) ? 'not tracked' : String(ammo);

            html += row('<b>Ammo:</b> ' + esc(ammoText));
            html += row('<b>Range:</b> ' + esc(ranges.raw) + ' = ' + esc('Short 1-' + ranges.shortFt + ' ft; Medium ' + (ranges.shortFt + 1) + '-' + ranges.mediumFt + ' ft; Long ' + (ranges.mediumFt + 1) + '-' + ranges.longFt + ' ft'));
            html += row('<b>Range Adjustments:</b> Short +0; Medium -2; Long -5. Beyond long range is not eligible.');
            html += row('<b>Short Modifiers:</b> ' + esc(modifierSummaryHtml(dataShort)));
            html += row('<b>Medium Modifiers:</b> ' + esc(modifierSummaryHtml(dataMedium)));
            html += row('<b>Long Modifiers:</b> ' + esc(modifierSummaryHtml(dataLong)));
            html += hr();
            html += section('Choose Range and Attack');
            html += row('<b>Fire Into Melee:</b> ' +
                (isFireIntoMeleeOn(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId)
                    ? btnOn('ON', '!gm1e-firetoggle|' + attackerTokenId + '|' + rowId + '|' + targetTokenId + '|0', 'Fire into melee is active. Click to turn off.')
                    : btnOff('OFF', '!gm1e-firetoggle|' + attackerTokenId + '|' + rowId + '|' + targetTokenId + '|1', 'Click to turn on random target selection for firing into melee.')));

            html += row('<span style="color:#ddd;">When ON, the attack randomly selects from nearby melee participants. No fire-into-melee attack penalty is applied.</span>');

            html += row(btn(rangeButtonLabel(weapon, 'short') + ' +0', fireIntoMeleeAttackHref(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, 'short'), 'Default range band; no range adjustment.'));
            html += row(btn(rangeButtonLabel(weapon, 'medium') + ' -2', fireIntoMeleeAttackHref(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, 'medium'), '-2 at all medium ranges.'));
            html += row(btn(rangeButtonLabel(weapon, 'long') + ' -5', fireIntoMeleeAttackHref(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, 'long'), '-5 at all long ranges.'));
            html += row('<span style="color:#ff5555;font-weight:bold;">Beyond ' + esc(String(ranges.longFt)) + ' ft is not eligible</span>');
        } else {
            html += hr();
            html += section('Confirm Attack');
            html += row(btn('Roll Melee Attack', '!gm1e-quickattack|' + attackerTokenId + '|' + rowId + '|' + targetTokenId + '|short'));
        }

        html += hr();
        html += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + attackerTokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(html));
    }

    function rollAttack(playerId, attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, rangeChoice, meleeParticipantCount) {
        var originalTargetTokenId = targetTokenId;
        var fireInfo = '';
        var preliminaryData = getCombatData(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, rangeChoice);
        var data;
        var d20, total, hit, lines, autoHit;
        var ammoBefore, ammoAfter, ammoMax;
        var participants;
        var fireRoll;

        lines = [];

        if (preliminaryData.isRanged &&
            isFireIntoMeleeOn(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId) &&
            String(rangeChoice || 'short').toLowerCase() !== 'beyond') {
            participants = toInt(meleeParticipantCount, 2);

            if (participants < 2) {
                participants = 2;
            }

            playDiceSound();
            fireRoll = randomInteger(participants);

            if (fireRoll === 1) {
                fireInfo = 'Firing into melee; ' + participants + ' possible targets; rolled ' + fireRoll + ' of ' + participants + '. Intended target is selected.';
            } else {
                fireInfo = 'Firing into melee; ' + participants + ' possible targets; rolled ' + fireRoll + ' of ' + participants + '. DM chooses the actual target.';

                lines.push({
                    type: 'section',
                    text: 'Fire Into Melee'
                });

                lines.push({
                    type: 'neutral',
                    text: 'Attacker: ' + (preliminaryData.attacker ? tokenName(preliminaryData.attacker) : 'Unknown') +
                        '; Intended defender: ' + (preliminaryData.defender ? tokenName(preliminaryData.defender) : 'Unknown') +
                        '; Weapon: ' + preliminaryData.weaponName + '.'
                });

                lines.push({
                    type: 'html',
                    text: '<b>Possible Targets:</b> ' + esc(String(participants)) +
                        '<br><b>Random Target Roll:</b> ' + diePill(String(fireRoll)) +
                        '<br>' + bad('The intended target was not selected. DM chooses the actual target.')
                });

                lines.push({
                    type: 'html',
                    text: macroBtn('Roll Attack vs Other Target', otherTargetAttackHref(attackerTokenId, rowId, rangeChoice), 'Choose the actual target selected by the DM and roll the attack.')
                });

                lines.push({
                    type: 'clearfooter',
                    text: resultClearFooterHtml(attackerTokenId, 'Fire Into Melee.', '#ff5555')
                });

                setMainResult(attackerTokenId, lines);
                sendPublicCombatResult(lines);
                showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, playerId);
                return;
            }
        }

        data = getCombatData(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, rangeChoice);
        autoHit = hasAutomaticHit(data.modSession);

        if (!data.attacker || !data.defender) {
            setMainResult(attackerTokenId, [
                { type: 'section', text: 'Attack Error' },
                { type: 'html', text: resultWordHtml('Missing attacker or defender token.', '#ff5555') }
            ]);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, playerId);
            return;
        }

        lines.push({
            type: 'section',
            text: 'Weapon Attack'
        });

        lines.push({
            type: 'neutral',
            text: 'Attacker: ' + tokenName(data.attacker) +
                '; Defender: ' + tokenName(data.defender) +
                '; Weapon: ' + data.weaponName + '.'
        });

        lines.push({
            type: 'neutral',
            text: 'THAC0 ' + data.thac0 + ' vs AC ' + data.defenderAC + (data.defenderBaseAC !== data.defenderAC ? ' (base AC ' + data.defenderBaseAC + ')' : '') + '; matrix number ' + data.needed + '.'
        });

        if (data.isRanged) {
            lines.push({
                type: 'html',
                text: rangedInfoLineHtml(data)
            });

            if (fireInfo) {
                lines.push({
                    type: 'html',
                    text: '<b>Fire Into Melee:</b> ' + esc(fireInfo)
                });
            }

            if (data.rangeChoice === 'beyond') {
                lines.push({
                    type: 'clearfooter',
                    text: resultClearFooterHtml(attackerTokenId, 'No Attack: Beyond Range.', '#ff5555')
                });

                setMainResult(attackerTokenId, lines);
                sendPublicCombatResult(lines);
                showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, playerId);
                return;
            }

            ammoBefore = weaponAmmoCurrent(data.weapon);
            ammoMax = weaponAmmoMax(data.weapon);

            if (!isNaN(ammoBefore)) {
                if (ammoBefore <= 0) {
                    lines.push({
                        type: 'clearfooter',
                        text: resultClearFooterHtml(attackerTokenId, 'No Attack: Out of Ammo.', '#ff5555')
                    });

                    setMainResult(attackerTokenId, lines);
                    showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, playerId);
                    return;
                }

                ammoAfter = ammoBefore - 1;
                setWeaponAmmoCurrent(data.aChar.id, rowId, ammoAfter);

                lines.push({
                    type: 'html',
                    text: ammoLineHtml(ammoBefore, ammoAfter, ammoMax)
                });
            }
        }

        if (data.exhaustionLevel >= 6) {
            lines.push({
                type: 'clearfooter',
                text: resultClearFooterHtml(attackerTokenId, 'No Attack: Unconscious.', '#ff5555')
            });

            setMainResult(attackerTokenId, lines);
            sendPublicCombatResult(lines);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, playerId);
            return;
        }

        if (autoHit) {
            lines.push({
                type: 'html',
                text: damageButtons(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId)
            });

            lines.push({
                type: 'clearfooter',
                text: resultClearFooterHtml(attackerTokenId, 'Automatic Hit.', '#51d66b')
            });

            setMainResult(attackerTokenId, lines);
            sendPublicCombatResult(lines);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, playerId);
            return;
        }

        playDiceSound();

        d20 = randomInteger(20);
        total = d20 + data.totalAttackBonus;
        hit = d20 >= modifiedNumberNeeded(data);

        lines.push({
            type: 'html',
            text: attackRollHtml(d20, data, total, hit)
        });

        if (hit) {
            lines.push({
                type: 'html',
                text: damageButtons(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId)
            });

            lines.push({
                type: 'clearfooter',
                text: resultClearFooterHtml(attackerTokenId, 'Hit.', '#51d66b')
            });
        } else {
            lines.push({
                type: 'clearfooter',
                text: resultClearFooterHtml(attackerTokenId, 'Miss.', '#ff5555')
            });
        }

        if (data.cover && data.cover.key === 'cover90') {
            lines.push({
                type: 'neutral',
                text: '90% cover note: hard cover may also affect saving throws and may allow no damage on a successful applicable save.'
            });
        }

        setMainResult(attackerTokenId, lines);
        sendPublicCombatResult(lines);
        showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, playerId);
    }

    function rollDamage(playerId, attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, sizeKey) {
        var data = getCombatData(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, 'short');
        var expr = weaponDamageText(data.weapon, sizeKey);
        var rolled = rollDamageExpression(expr);
        var baseDamage = rolled.total + data.damageBonus;
        var multiplier = backstabDamageMultiplier(data);
        var totalDamage = baseDamage * multiplier;
        var lines = removeClearFooter(removeExistingDamage(getMainResult(attackerTokenId)));

        data.backstabMultiplier = multiplier;
        data.preBackstabDamage = baseDamage;

        if (!lines.length || !data.attacker || !data.defender) {
            lines = [];

            lines.push({
                type: 'section',
                text: 'Weapon Attack'
            });

            lines.push({
                type: 'neutral',
                text: 'Attacker: ' + (data.attacker ? tokenName(data.attacker) : 'Unknown') + '; Defender: ' + (data.defender ? tokenName(data.defender) : 'Unknown') + '; Weapon: ' + data.weaponName + '.'
            });
        }

        lines.push({
            type: 'section',
            text: sizeKey === 'lg' ? 'Damage vs Large' : 'Damage vs Small/Medium'
        });

        lines.push({
            type: 'neutral',
            text: 'Weapon: ' + data.weaponName + '; damage expression: ' + (expr || 'missing') + '.'
        });

        if (!rolled.ok) {
            lines.push({
                type: 'html',
                text: resultWordHtml(rolled.detail, '#ff5555')
            });
        } else {
            lines.push({
                type: 'html',
                text: damageRollHtml(rolled.detail, data, totalDamage)
            });
        }

        lines.push({
            type: 'clearfooter',
            text: '<div style="display:block;margin-top:8px;min-height:24px;text-align:right;">' +
                btn('Clear Result', '!gm1e-clearresult|' + attackerTokenId) +
                '</div>'
        });

        setMainResult(attackerTokenId, lines);
        sendPublicCombatResult(lines);
        showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, playerId);
    }

    function weaponInitiativeSpeed(weapon) {
        return fieldNumber(weapon, [
            'weapon_speed',
            'weapon_speed_factor',
            'weapon_rate',
            'weapon_rate_of_fire',
            'weapon_rof',
            'weapon_init',
            'weapon_initiative',
            'rate',
            'speed'
        ], 0);
    }

    function simpleSectionKey(tokenId, name) {
        return String(tokenId || '') + '|' + String(name || '');
    }

    function isActionSectionOpen(tokenId) {
        initState();

        if (state[SCRIPT].actionSections[simpleSectionKey(tokenId, 'actions')] === undefined) {
            return true;
        }

        return !!state[SCRIPT].actionSections[simpleSectionKey(tokenId, 'actions')];
    }

    function toggleActionSection(tokenId) {
        var key;

        initState();

        key = simpleSectionKey(tokenId, 'actions');

        if (state[SCRIPT].actionSections[key] === undefined) {
            state[SCRIPT].actionSections[key] = false;
        } else {
            state[SCRIPT].actionSections[key] = !state[SCRIPT].actionSections[key];
        }
    }

    function buildWeapons(token, cid) {
        var data = collectWeapons(cid);
        var out = '';
        var i, rowId, w, tokenId, attackHref, label, ranged;

        tokenId = token && token.id ? token.id : '';

        if (!data.order.length) {
            return row('<span style="color:#bbbbbb;">No weapon rows found.</span>');
        }

        for (i = 0; i < data.order.length; i++) {
            rowId = data.order[i];
            w = data.rows[rowId];
            ranged = isRangedWeapon(w);
            label = (w.name || 'Unnamed Weapon') + (ranged ? ' (Ranged)' : ' (Melee)');

            out += '<div style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#fff;margin:0 0 1px 0;padding:1px 0;">';

            if (tokenId) {
                attackHref = '!gm1e-attacksetup|' + tokenId + '|' + rowId + '|@{target|Choose defender|token_id}';
                out += row(macroBtn(label, attackHref, ranged ? 'Open ranged attack setup, choose range, and track ammo.' : 'Open melee attack setup.') + (ranged ? weaponAmmoDisplay(w) : ''));
            } else {
                out += row('<b>' + esc(label) + '</b>');
                out += row('<span style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#ddd;font-size:11px;">Weapon attack requires a token on the tabletop.</span>');
            }

            out += '</div>';
        }

        return out;
    }

The spell does not leave behind a magical aura, though in some cases an aura of good or evil may be present and detectable. The specific ceremonies vary by religion, but usually include: 1st-level cleric: coming of age, burial, marriage; 3rd-level cleric: dedication, investiture, consecrate item; 5th-level cleric: ordination, special vows; 7th-level cleric: consecrate ground; 9th-level cleric: anathematize. Each ceremony requires a cleric of the indicated level or higher. Except for anathematize, no saving throw is required because the recipient is either inanimate or presumed willing; if the recipient is unwilling, the ceremony simply fails. Coming of age is a limited bless cast upon a young person, often around age 12. The recipient gains a +1 bonus to any single saving throw, usable at any time after the ceremony. In some cultures, this rite has symbolic importance and grants the rights and privileges of adulthood. Burial magically protects a corpse and grants it the blessing of the religious organization. The body is protected for one week as if by protection from evil, and anyone trying to disinter it during that time must save versus spell or stop and flee in fear for 1 turn. Marriage has no tangible magical after-effect and does not guarantee happiness or harmony, but usually has moral or legal significance. Dedication admits the recipient into the casting cleric’s religion, making them a sanctioned worshiper of the cleric’s deity. The dedication is permanent unless the worshiper changes allegiance to another deity. A previous dedication can be overridden by a new dedication cast by a cleric of higher level than the one who performed the earlier rite. Investiture must be performed on an aspiring cleric before the character can become a 1st-level cleric. Consecrate item must be performed on any object placed on an altar or within a religious edifice. Holy or unholy water must be kept in a properly consecrated container to prevent loss of potency. Ordination must be performed on a cleric before the character can become priest of a congregation, assume similar duties, gain followers, or establish a following. The cleric performing the ordination must be higher level than the recipient. Special vows may be received by a would-be cavalier or paladin before beginning that profession. The effects last until the character gains enough experience to reach the upper limit of their current level. The vows may then be renewed during training between levels or while advancing through the next level. A cavalier or paladin under special vows is immune to bestow curse spells, though not cursed items, while the vows remain in effect. The subject is also more susceptible to any quest spell cast by a cleric of the same alignment as the caster of the vows, suffering a -4 saving throw penalty. Consecrate ground should be performed before any holy or unholy structure is built on a site. A religious edifice built on unconsecrated ground slowly and irrevocably falls into disrepair and has a cumulative 1% chance per year of collapsing. The spell must be cast before the area is altered or construction materials are brought to the site; it has no effect if done afterward. Consecrated ground may also be used for a graveyard, in which case the graveyard automatically turns undead each round as a 3rd-level cleric. If performed by an evil cleric, undead in the area are treated as protected and controlled by an evil 3rd-level cleric. Anathematize is excommunication that brands the offender on the cheek, forehead, arm, or hand with a symbol, sigil, or sign identifying the subject as someone who has committed a serious offense against their deity. An unwilling subject may save versus spell at -4 to avoid the effect. If the recipient is not truly deserving, the spell fails. A successful atonement causes the brand to fade and possibly vanish. If the offense was caused magically or by an external force, the brand disappears completely. If the actions were natural, the brand cannot be fully removed. Material Component: The cleric’s holy symbol is always involved, though other components vary by religion. The spell does not leave behind a magical aura, though know alignment or similar magic might reveal the force of true neutrality involved. Druidic ceremonies include: 1st-level druid: coming of age, rest eternal, marriage; 3rd-level druid: dedication, investiture; 7th-level druid: initiation, special vows; 9th-level druid: hallowed ground; 12th-level druid: cast out. Coming of age is performed upon young people in druidic societies, usually at age 14, and symbolizes entry into adulthood. Its effects are the same as the clerical version, granting a +1 bonus to one saving throw. Rest eternal is cast upon a deceased being’s body, hastening the soul or spirit to its final resting place. Raise dead and resurrection cannot restore life to a creature affected by this spell, though wish can. Marriage is essentially identical to the clerical ceremony of the same name. Dedication admits the recipient into the ranks of the druid’s followers or worshipers, provided the recipient is true neutral. The recipient is charged with preserving and protecting nature and the balance of forces in the world. Otherwise, it is similar to the clerical ceremony. Investiture must be performed before a character can become an Aspirant, or 1st-level druid. It grants no other benefit. Initiation grants the druid the shape-changing and immunity to woodland charm powers gained at 7th level. It must be performed immediately after the druid begins advancing through 7th level. If cast earlier, it fails, and the druid does not gain those powers until properly initiated. Usually, a druid must seek another druid of 7th level or higher to perform the rite, though in unusual cases a druid may cast it upon themselves. Special vows functions like the clerical rite of the same name. It does not work on paladins, but works on cavaliers of any alignment. Hallowed ground is cast on the druid’s permanent grove. It enchants the grove’s trees so they are never affected by disease or natural disasters. The ground remains hallowed as long as the druid maintains the grove as a permanent base. Cast out is a form of excommunication or punishment used against someone who has committed sacrilege against nature or violated druidic principles. Its effects may later be lessened by a reversed version of the ceremony cast by the same druid or another druid of at least equal level, but it can only be completely neutralized by a Hierophant Druid. A cast-out character exudes a powerful negative aura, causing natural creatures to react negatively, including normal animals, woodland monsters, domesticated beasts, druids, and druidic followers. This punishment requires permission from the druid’s Archdruid; an Archdruid needs permission from the Great Druid, and the Great Druid from the Grand Druid. The Grand Druid needs no permission, but a Hierophant Druid may reverse the action at any time. A druid who wrongly seeks or performs this punishment may themselves be punished by higher-ranking druids. An unwilling recipient saves versus spell at -4 to negate the effect. The staff is then charged with magic that lasts through many transformations. The staff/treant begins as a largest-size treant with 12 Hit Dice and 96 hit points. Every 8 points of accumulated damage reduces it by 1 Hit Die: 11 HD and 88 hp, 10 HD and 80 hp, 9 HD and 72 hp, and so on. As it loses Hit Dice, it becomes smaller and loses attack power. If reduced below 7 Hit Dice, it crumbles into sawdust and is lost. It cannot regain Hit Dice or hit points except by wish, which restores it fully. A new staff may be prepared to begin again. When the druid plants the staff in the ground and speaks a special command prayer and invocation, it becomes a treant. It defends and obeys the druid, but is not a true treant and cannot converse with real treants. The transformation lasts for 1 turn per caster level, until the druid commands it to return to staff form, or until destroyed. The spell does not leave behind a magical aura, though in some cases an aura of good or evil may be present and detectable. The specific ceremonies vary by religion, but usually include: 1st-level cleric: coming of age, burial, marriage; 3rd-level cleric: dedication, investiture, consecrate item; 5th-level cleric: ordination, special vows; 7th-level cleric: consecrate ground; 9th-level cleric: anathematize. Each ceremony requires a cleric of the indicated level or higher. Except for anathematize, no saving throw is required because the recipient is either inanimate or presumed willing; if the recipient is unwilling, the ceremony simply fails. Coming of age is a limited bless cast upon a young person, often around age 12. The recipient gains a +1 bonus to any single saving throw, usable at any time after the ceremony. In some cultures, this rite has symbolic importance and grants the rights and privileges of adulthood. Burial magically protects a corpse and grants it the blessing of the religious organization. The body is protected for one week as if by protection from evil, and anyone trying to disinter it during that time must save versus spell or stop and flee in fear for 1 turn. Marriage has no tangible magical after-effect and does not guarantee happiness or harmony, but usually has moral or legal significance. Dedication admits the recipient into the casting cleric’s religion, making them a sanctioned worshiper of the cleric’s deity. The dedication is permanent unless the worshiper changes allegiance to another deity. A previous dedication can be overridden by a new dedication cast by a cleric of higher level than the one who performed the earlier rite. Investiture must be performed on an aspiring cleric before the character can become a 1st-level cleric. Consecrate item must be performed on any object placed on an altar or within a religious edifice. Holy or unholy water must be kept in a properly consecrated container to prevent loss of potency. Ordination must be performed on a cleric before the character can become priest of a congregation, assume similar duties, gain followers, or establish a following. The cleric performing the ordination must be higher level than the recipient. Special vows may be received by a would-be cavalier or paladin before beginning that profession. The effects last until the character gains enough experience to reach the upper limit of their current level. The vows may then be renewed during training between levels or while advancing through the next level. A cavalier or paladin under special vows is immune to bestow curse spells, though not cursed items, while the vows remain in effect. The subject is also more susceptible to any quest spell cast by a cleric of the same alignment as the caster of the vows, suffering a -4 saving throw penalty. Consecrate ground should be performed before any holy or unholy structure is built on a site. A religious edifice built on unconsecrated ground slowly and irrevocably falls into disrepair and has a cumulative 1% chance per year of collapsing. The spell must be cast before the area is altered or construction materials are brought to the site; it has no effect if done afterward. Consecrated ground may also be used for a graveyard, in which case the graveyard automatically turns undead each round as a 3rd-level cleric. If performed by an evil cleric, undead in the area are treated as protected and controlled by an evil 3rd-level cleric.
