The spell does not leave behind a magical aura, though know alignment or similar magic might reveal the force of true neutrality involved. Druidic ceremonies include: 1st-level druid: coming of age, rest eternal, marriage; 3rd-level druid: dedication, investiture; 7th-level druid: initiation, special vows; 9th-level druid: hallowed ground; 12th-level druid: cast out. Coming of age is performed upon young people in druidic societies, usually at age 14, and symbolizes entry into adulthood. Its effects are the same as the clerical version, granting a +1 bonus to one saving throw. Rest eternal is cast upon a deceased being’s body, hastening the soul or spirit to its final resting place. Raise dead and resurrection cannot restore life to a creature affected by this spell, though wish can. Marriage is essentially identical to the clerical ceremony of the same name. Dedication admits the recipient into the ranks of the druid’s followers or worshipers, provided the recipient is true neutral. The recipient is charged with preserving and protecting nature and the balance of forces in the world. Otherwise, it is similar to the clerical ceremony. Investiture must be performed before a character can become an Aspirant, or 1st-level druid. It grants no other benefit. Initiation grants the druid the shape-changing and immunity to woodland charm powers gained at 7th level. It must be performed immediately after the druid begins advancing through 7th level. If cast earlier, it fails, and the druid does not gain those powers until properly initiated. Usually, a druid must seek another druid of 7th level or higher to perform the rite, though in unusual cases a druid may cast it upon themselves. Special vows functions like the clerical rite of the same name. It does not work on paladins, but works on cavaliers of any alignment. Hallowed ground is cast on the druid’s permanent grove. It enchants the grove’s trees so they are never affected by disease or natural disasters. The ground remains hallowed as long as the druid maintains the grove as a permanent base. Cast out is a form of excommunication or punishment used against someone who has committed sacrilege against nature or violated druidic principles. Its effects may later be lessened by a reversed version of the ceremony cast by the same druid or another druid of at least equal level, but it can only be completely neutralized by a Hierophant Druid. A cast-out character exudes a powerful negative aura, causing natural creatures to react negatively, including normal animals, woodland monsters, domesticated beasts, druids, and druidic followers. This punishment requires permission from the druid’s Archdruid; an Archdruid needs permission from the Great Druid, and the Great Druid from the Grand Druid. The Grand Druid needs no permission, but a Hierophant Druid may reverse the action at any time. A druid who wrongly seeks or performs this punishment may themselves be punished by higher-ranking druids. An unwilling recipient saves versus spell at -4 to negate the effect. The illusionist must find a comfortable place to rest, lie prone, compose their thoughts on the desired result, and then go to sleep. If the illusionist sleeps undisturbed for at least 8 hours, the dream magic takes effect 1d12 hours later. Possible effects include recovery of lost hit points, restoration of a body member such as a hand or foot, success in locating an object not heavily protected by magical wards, discovery of a means of entrance or escape, location of a safe wilderness path, improvement of chances to gain rich treasure, or an estimate of enemy strength. If a creature scried by the spell has 7 or more Hit Dice, it may save versus spell. If successful, it is undetected by the dream and may sense the illusionist as if detecting invisible. A dream is not an ultra-powerful spell, and its results must be strictly limited. The examples above represent the spell’s maximum capability. Results never exceed those limits permanently.     function attackSectionStateKey(tokenId) {
        return String(tokenId || '') + '|attacks';
    }

    function isAttackSectionOpen(tokenId) {
        initState();

        if (state[SCRIPT].attackSections[attackSectionStateKey(tokenId)] === undefined) {
            return true;
        }

        return !!state[SCRIPT].attackSections[attackSectionStateKey(tokenId)];
    }

    function toggleAttackSection(tokenId) {
        var k;

        initState();

        k = attackSectionStateKey(tokenId);

        if (state[SCRIPT].attackSections[k] === undefined) {
            state[SCRIPT].attackSections[k] = false;
        } else {
            state[SCRIPT].attackSections[k] = !state[SCRIPT].attackSections[k];
        }
    }

    function spellLevelLabel(level) {
        level = toInt(level, 0);

        if (level < 0) {
            level = 0;
        }

        if (level > 9) {
            level = 9;
        }

        return SPELL_LEVEL_LABELS[level];
    }

    function spellSectionStateKey(tokenId, key) {
        return String(tokenId || '') + '|spell|' + String(key || '');
    }

    function isSpellSectionOpen(tokenId, key) {
        initState();
        return !!state[SCRIPT].spellSections[spellSectionStateKey(tokenId, key)];
    }

    function toggleSpellSection(tokenId, key) {
        var k;

        initState();

        k = spellSectionStateKey(tokenId, key);

        if (state[SCRIPT].spellSections[k]) {
            delete state[SCRIPT].spellSections[k];
        } else {
            state[SCRIPT].spellSections[k] = true;
        }
    }

    function spellRowStateKey(tokenId, sectionName, rowId) {
        return String(tokenId || '') + '|spellrow|' + String(sectionName || '') + '|' + String(rowId || '');
    }

    function isSpellRowOpen(tokenId, sectionName, rowId) {
        initState();
        return !!state[SCRIPT].spellRows[spellRowStateKey(tokenId, sectionName, rowId)];
    }

    function toggleSpellRow(tokenId, sectionName, rowId) {
        var k;

        initState();

        k = spellRowStateKey(tokenId, sectionName, rowId);

        if (state[SCRIPT].spellRows[k]) {
            delete state[SCRIPT].spellRows[k];
        } else {
            state[SCRIPT].spellRows[k] = true;
        }
    }

    function spellLevelSortName(spell) {
        return String(spell.name || '').toLowerCase();
    }

    function spellMemorizedValue(spell) {
        return toInt(spell.memorized, 0);
    }

    function spellMemorizedIndicator(spell) {
        var n = spellMemorizedValue(spell);

        if (n > 0) {
            return '<span style="color:#51d66b;font-weight:bold;margin-left:4px;">Mem: ' + esc(String(n)) + '</span>';
        }

        return '<span style="color:#ff5555;font-weight:bold;margin-left:4px;">Not memorized</span>';
    }

    function spellKeyFromAttrName(name) {
        var m;

        name = String(name || '');

        m = name.match(/^repeating_spelllvl([0-9])_([^_]+)_(spell_.+)$/);

        if (m) {
            return {
                section: 'spelllvl' + m[1],
                rowId: m[2],
                field: m[3],
                level: toInt(m[1], 0)
            };
        }

        return null;
    }

    function spellAttrName(spell, field) {
        return 'repeating_' + spell.section + '_' + spell.rowId + '_' + field;
    }

    function spellAttrObject(cid, spell, field) {
        return findObjs({
            _type: 'attribute',
            _characterid: cid,
            name: spellAttrName(spell, field)
        }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];
    }

    function normalizeSpellLookupKey(value) {
        value = String(value || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '').toLowerCase();

        if (value.indexOf(':') !== -1) {
            value = value.substring(value.indexOf(':') + 1).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        }

        return value.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
    }

    function fallbackSpellByName(name) {
        var key = normalizeSpellLookupKey(name);

        if (SPELL_FALLBACK_LIBRARY[key]) {
            return SPELL_FALLBACK_LIBRARY[key];
        }

        return null;
    }

    function spellTextHtml(text) {
        return esc(String(text || '')).replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    }

    function cleanSpellDescriptionBody(spell, text) {
        var lines = String(text || '').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n').split('\n');
        var cleaned = [];
        var i;
        var line;
        var trimmed;
        var lower;
        var name = normalizeSpellTextForCompare(spell && spell.name ? spell.name : '');
        var inHeader = true;

        for (i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            line = lines[i];
            trimmed = String(line || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
            lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();

            if (inHeader) {
                if (!trimmed) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (name && normalizeSpellTextForCompare(trimmed) === name) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (
                    lower.indexOf('school:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('reversible:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('level:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('components:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('range:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('casting time:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('duration:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('saving throw:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('save type:') === 0 ||
                    lower.indexOf('area of effect:') === 0
                ) {
                    continue;
                }

                inHeader = false;
            }

            cleaned.push(line);
        }

        return cleaned.join('\n').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
    }

    function firstMeaningfulSpellText(spell, fallback) {
        var desc = String(spell && spell.description ? spell.description : '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        var notes = String(spell && spell.notes ? spell.notes : '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        var fallbackDesc = fallback && fallback.description ? String(fallback.description || '') : '';
        var fallbackNotes = fallback && fallback.notes ? String(fallback.notes || '') : '';
        var cleaned;

        if (desc && !isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, desc)) {
            cleaned = cleanSpellDescriptionBody(spell, desc);

            if (cleaned && !isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, cleaned)) {
                return cleaned;
            }
        }

        if (notes && !isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, notes)) {
            cleaned = cleanSpellDescriptionBody(spell, notes);

            if (cleaned && !isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, cleaned)) {
                return cleaned;
            }
        }

        if (fallbackDesc) {
            cleaned = cleanSpellDescriptionBody(spell, fallbackDesc);

            if (cleaned && !isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, cleaned)) {
                return cleaned;
            }
        }

        if (fallbackNotes) {
            cleaned = cleanSpellDescriptionBody(spell, fallbackNotes);

            if (cleaned && !isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, cleaned)) {
                return cleaned;
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function normalizeSpellName(row) {
        var name = row.spell_name_select || row.spell_name_select_cleric || row.spell_name_select_magic_user || row.spell_name || '';

        name = String(name || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');

        if (name.indexOf(':') !== -1) {
            name = name.substring(name.indexOf(':') + 1).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        }

        return name;
    }

    function spellRowHasActualSelection(row) {
        var selected = String(row.spell_name_select || row.spell_name_select_cleric || row.spell_name_select_magic_user || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        var named = String(row.spell_name || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');

        /*
         * Use only current spell-level repeating rows with an actual selected/name
         * value. This prevents old migration rows and hidden/default sheet data
         * from appearing in the API list.
         */
        return !!(selected || named);
    }

    function collectSpells(cid) {
        var attrs = getAttrsForChar(cid);
        var rows = {};
        var order = [];
        var i;
        var attr;
        var parsed;
        var k;
        var field;
        var row;
        var level;

        for (i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) {
            attr = attrs[i];
            parsed = spellKeyFromAttrName(attr.get('name'));

            if (!parsed) {
                continue;
            }

            k = parsed.section + '|' + parsed.rowId;

            if (!rows[k]) {
                rows[k] = {
                    key: k,
                    section: parsed.section,
                    rowId: parsed.rowId,
                    level: parsed.level,
                    fields: {}
                };

                order.push(k);
            }

            field = parsed.field;
            rows[k].fields[field] = attr.get('current') || '';
        }

        for (i = order.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            row = rows[order[i]];
            row.name = normalizeSpellName(row.fields);
            row.memorized = row.fields.spell_memorized || '0';
            row.school = row.fields.spell_school || '';
            row.components = row.fields.spell_components || '';
            row.range = row.fields.spell_range || '';
            row.castingTime = row.fields.spell_ct || '';
            row.duration = row.fields.spell_duration || '';
            row.save = row.fields.spell_save || '';
            row.saveType = row.fields.spell_save_type || '';
            row.aoe = row.fields.spell_aoe || '';
            row.description = row.fields.spell_description || '';
            row.notes = row.fields.spell_notes || '';
            row.macroText = '';
            row.link = row.fields.spell_link || '';
            row.fallback =
                fallbackSpellByName(row.fields.spell_name_select) ||
                fallbackSpellByName(row.fields.spell_name_select_cleric) ||
                fallbackSpellByName(row.fields.spell_name_select_magic_user) ||
                fallbackSpellByName(row.fields.spell_name) ||
                fallbackSpellByName(row.name);

            if (isPlaceholderSpellDescription(row, row.description)) {
                row.description = '';
            }

            if (isPlaceholderSpellDescription(row, row.notes)) {
                row.notes = '';
            }

            level = toInt(row.fields.spell_level || row.fields.spell_level_display, row.level);

            if (level < 0) {
                level = 0;
            }

            if (level > 9) {
                level = 9;
            }

            row.level = level;

            if (!row.name || !spellRowHasActualSelection(row.fields)) {
                delete rows[order[i]];
                order.splice(i, 1);
            }
        }

        order.sort(function (a, b) {
            var sa = rows[a];
            var sb = rows[b];

            if (sa.level !== sb.level) {
                return sa.level - sb.level;
            }

            if (spellLevelSortName(sa) < spellLevelSortName(sb)) {
                return -1;
            }

            if (spellLevelSortName(sa) > spellLevelSortName(sb)) {
                return 1;
            }

            return 0;
        });

        return {
            rows: rows,
            order: order
        };
    }

    function findSpell(cid, section, rowId) {
        var data = collectSpells(cid);
        var key = String(section || '') + '|' + String(rowId || '');

        return data.rows[key] || null;
    }

    function normalizeSpellTextForCompare(text) {
        return String(text || '')
            .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
            .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
            .replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '')
            .toLowerCase();
    }

    function isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, text) {
        var t = normalizeSpellTextForCompare(text);
        var n = normalizeSpellTextForCompare(spell && spell.name ? spell.name : '');

        if (!t) {
            return true;
        }

        if (t === n) {
            return true;
        }

        /*
         * Some sheet rows temporarily store only the selected spell name or a
         * class-prefixed selected value in spell_description. Suppress that so
         * the expanded API row does not show "Description: Magic Missile".
         */
        if (n && t.length <= n.length + 20 && (t.indexOf(n) !== -1 || n.indexOf(t) !== -1)) {
            return true;
        }

        if (t.indexOf('magic-user:') === 0 || t.indexOf('cleric:') === 0 || t.indexOf('illusionist:') === 0 || t.indexOf('druid:') === 0) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    function bestSpellDescription(spell) {
        return firstMeaningfulSpellText(spell, spell ? spell.fallback : null);
    }

    function bestSpellNotes(spell) {
        var desc = bestSpellDescription(spell);
        var notes = String(spell && spell.notes ? spell.notes : '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        var cleaned = '';

        if (!notes || isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, notes)) {
            return '';
        }

        cleaned = cleanSpellDescriptionBody(spell, notes);

        if (!cleaned || isPlaceholderSpellDescription(spell, cleaned)) {
            return '';
        }

        if (normalizeSpellTextForCompare(cleaned) === normalizeSpellTextForCompare(desc)) {
            return '';
        }

        return cleaned;
    }

    function spellInlineDetailHtml(spell) {
        var out = '';
        var desc;
        var notes;
        var detailRows = '';

        desc = bestSpellDescription(spell);
        notes = bestSpellNotes(spell);

        if (spell.school) {
            detailRows += row('<b>School:</b> ' + esc(spell.school));
        }
        if (spell.components) {
            detailRows += row('<b>Components:</b> ' + esc(spell.components));
        }
        if (spell.range) {
            detailRows += row('<b>Range:</b> ' + esc(spell.range));
        }
        if (spell.castingTime) {
            detailRows += row('<b>Casting Time:</b> ' + esc(spell.castingTime));
        }
        if (spell.duration) {
            detailRows += row('<b>Duration:</b> ' + esc(spell.duration));
        }
        if (spell.aoe) {
            detailRows += row('<b>Area of Effect:</b> ' + esc(spell.aoe));
        }
        if (spell.save) {
            detailRows += row('<b>Saving Throw:</b> ' + esc(spell.save));
        }
        if (spell.saveType) {
            detailRows += row('<b>Save Type:</b> ' + esc(spell.saveType));
        }

        if (detailRows) {
            out += section('Spell Information');
            out += detailRows;
        }

        if (desc) {
            out += section('Description');
            out += row('<div style="white-space:normal;">' + spellTextHtml(desc) + '</div>');
        }

        out = out || row('<span style="color:#bbbbbb;">No description found on this spell row.</span>');
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Custom Roll', '!gm1e-customroll ' + (spell.tokenId || 'none') + ' ?{Enter dice formula|1d20}', 'Make a custom dice roll for this spell.'));

        return out;
    }

    function spellDetailHtml(ch, spell, includeCastButton, tokenId, privateView) {
        var out = '';
        var desc;
        var notes;

        out += title(spell.name || 'Spell');
        out += section(privateView ? 'Spell Detail' : 'Spell Cast');
        out += row('<b>Caster:</b> ' + esc(ch ? ch.get('name') : 'Unknown'));
        out += row('<b>Memorized:</b> ' + esc(String(spellMemorizedValue(spell))));
        spell.tokenId = spell.tokenId || '';
        out += spellInlineDetailHtml(spell);

        desc = '';
        notes = '';

        if (includeCastButton) {
            out += hr();
            out += row(
                btn('Cast Spell', '!gm1e-spellcast ' + tokenId + ' ' + spell.section + ' ' + spell.rowId, 'Cast this spell and deduct one memorized use if available.') +
                btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId)
            );
        }

        return box(out);
    }

    function playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) {
        var p = getObj('player', playerId);
        var who;

        if (typeof playerIsGM === 'function' && playerIsGM(playerId)) {
            return '/w gm ';
        }

        if (!p) {
            return '/w gm ';
        }

        who = p.get('displayname') || p.get('_displayname') || 'gm';
        who = String(who || 'gm').replace(/\s+\(GM\)$/i, '');

        if (!who || who.toLowerCase() === 'gm') {
            return '/w gm ';
        }

        return '/w "' + who + '" ';
    }

    function showSpellToPlayer(playerId, tokenId, sectionName, rowId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var spell;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Spell Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        spell = findSpell(ch.id, sectionName, rowId);

        if (!spell) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Spell Error') + row(bad('Spell row not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + spellDetailHtml(ch, spell, true, tokenId, true));
    }

    function spellCastPublicHtml(ch, spell, remaining, tokenId) {
        var out = '';

        spell.tokenId = tokenId || spell.tokenId || '';

        out += title(spell.name || 'Spell');
        out += section('Spell Cast');
        out += row('<b>Caster:</b> ' + esc(ch ? ch.get('name') : 'Unknown'));
        out += row('<b>Memorized Uses Remaining:</b> ' + esc(String(remaining)));
        out += spellInlineDetailHtml(spell);

        if (spell.tokenId && tokenById(spell.tokenId)) {
            out += hr();
            out += row(btn('Back to Character Sheet', '!gm1e-token|' + spell.tokenId));
        }

        return box(out);
    }

    function castSpellFromApi(playerId, tokenId, sectionName, rowId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var spell;
        var attr;
        var memorized;
        var remaining;
        var html;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Spell Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        spell = findSpell(ch.id, sectionName, rowId);

        if (!spell) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Spell Error') + row(bad('Spell row not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        memorized = spellMemorizedValue(spell);

        if (memorized <= 0) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Spell Cast Error') + row(bad(spell.name + ' is not memorized or has no available uses.')) + row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId))));
            return;
        }

        remaining = memorized - 1;
        attr = spellAttrObject(ch.id, spell, 'spell_memorized');

        if (attr) {
            attr.set('current', String(remaining));
        }

        spell.memorized = String(remaining);

        html = spellCastPublicHtml(ch, spell, remaining, tokenId);

        sendChat(SCRIPT, html);
    }

    function buildSpells(token, cid) {
        var tokenId = token && token.id ? token.id : '';
        var data = collectSpells(cid);
        var out = '';
        var level;
        var key;
        var levelSpells;
        var i;
        var spell;
        var open;
        var count;
        var symbol;

        if (!tokenId) {
            return row('<span style="color:#bbbbbb;">Spell display requires a token on the tabletop.</span>');
        }

        if (!data.order.length) {
            return row('<span style="color:#bbbbbb;">No spell rows found.</span>');
        }

        for (level = 0; level <= 9; level++) {
            levelSpells = [];

            for (i = 0; i < data.order.length; i++) {
                spell = data.rows[data.order[i]];

                if (spell.level === level) {
                    levelSpells.push(spell);
                }
            }

            count = levelSpells.length;
            key = 'level' + level;
            open = isSpellSectionOpen(tokenId, key);
            symbol = open ? '-' : '+';

            out += '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border-left:3px solid #aa2222;padding:2px 4px;margin:4px 0 2px 0;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;">' +
                btn(symbol, '!gm1e-spellsection|' + tokenId + '|' + key, open ? 'Collapse ' + spellLevelLabel(level) + '.' : 'Expand ' + spellLevelLabel(level) + '.') +
                '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:4px;">' + esc(spellLevelLabel(level)) + '</span>' +
                '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;color:#ddd;text-transform:none;">' + esc(String(count)) + '</span>' +
                '</div>';

            if (open) {
                if (!count) {
                    out += row('<span style="color:#bbbbbb;">No spells at this level.</span>');
                } else {
                    for (i = 0; i < levelSpells.length; i++) {
                        spell = levelSpells[i];

                        out += '<div style="background:#000;background-color:#000;color:#fff;margin:1px 0 2px 18px;border:1px solid #333;padding:2px;">';
                        out += row(
                            btn(isSpellRowOpen(tokenId, spell.section, spell.rowId) ? '-' : '+', '!gm1e-spellrow|' + tokenId + '|' + spell.section + '|' + spell.rowId, isSpellRowOpen(tokenId, spell.section, spell.rowId) ? 'Collapse spell information.' : 'Expand spell information.') +
                            btn(spell.name, '!gm1e-spellrow|' + tokenId + '|' + spell.section + '|' + spell.rowId, isSpellRowOpen(tokenId, spell.section, spell.rowId) ? 'Collapse spell information.' : 'Expand spell information.') +
                            spellMemorizedIndicator(spell) +
                            '<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;"></span>' +
                            btn('Cast', '!gm1e-spellcast ' + tokenId + ' ' + spell.section + ' ' + spell.rowId, 'Cast this spell and deduct one memorized use if available.')
                        );

                        if (isSpellRowOpen(tokenId, spell.section, spell.rowId)) {
                            out += '<div style="border-top:1px solid #333;margin-top:2px;padding-top:2px;">';
                            spell.tokenId = tokenId;
                            out += spellInlineDetailHtml(spell);
                            out += '</div>';
                        }

                        out += '</div>';
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return out;
    }


    function isUnencumbered(cid) {
        var currentMove = parseNumber(getAttr(cid, 'current_encumbrance_move'));
        var maxMove = getMaxMovementValue(cid);

        if (isNaN(currentMove) || isNaN(maxMove)) {
            return false;
        }

        return currentMove === maxMove;
    }

    function initDisplayValue(def) {
        if (!def) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (def.display !== undefined && def.display !== null) {
            return toInt(def.display, 0);
        }

        return -toInt(def.mod, 0);
    }

    function initButtonLabel(def) {
        var display = initDisplayValue(def);

        if (!def || def.key === 'none') {
            return 'None';
        }

        if (def.key && def.key.indexOf('spell_ct_') === 0) {
            return 'Spell/Scroll CT ' + String(display);
        }

        return def.label + ' ' + String(display);
    }

    function initiativeModifierSectionKey(tokenId) {
        return String(tokenId || '') + '|initmods';
    }

    function isInitiativeModifierSectionOpen(tokenId) {
        initState();
        return !!state[SCRIPT].initiativeModifierSections[initiativeModifierSectionKey(tokenId)];
    }

    function toggleInitiativeModifierSection(tokenId) {
        var key;

        initState();

        key = initiativeModifierSectionKey(tokenId);

        if (state[SCRIPT].initiativeModifierSections[key]) {
            delete state[SCRIPT].initiativeModifierSections[key];
        } else {
            state[SCRIPT].initiativeModifierSections[key] = true;
        }
    }

    function initSubSectionKey(tokenId, name) {
        return String(tokenId || '') + '|initsub|' + String(name || '');
    }

    function isInitSubSectionOpen(tokenId, name) {
        initState();
        return !!state[SCRIPT].initiativeSubSections[initSubSectionKey(tokenId, name)];
    }

    function toggleInitSubSection(tokenId, name) {
        var key;

        initState();

        key = initSubSectionKey(tokenId, name);

        if (state[SCRIPT].initiativeSubSections[key]) {
            delete state[SCRIPT].initiativeSubSections[key];
        } else {
            state[SCRIPT].initiativeSubSections[key] = true;
        }
    }

    function initSubHeader(tokenId, key, label, summary) {
        return '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;padding:2px 4px;margin:5px 0 2px 14px;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;border-left:1px solid #333;">' +
            btn(isInitSubSectionOpen(tokenId, key) ? '-' : '+', '!gm1e-initsub|' + tokenId + '|' + key, isInitSubSectionOpen(tokenId, key) ? 'Collapse ' + label + '.' : 'Expand ' + label + '.') +
            '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;">' + esc(label) + '</span>' +
            (summary ? '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;color:#ddd;text-transform:none;">' + esc(summary) + '</span>' : '') +
            '</div>';
    }

    function initiativeConditionStateKey(tokenId) {
        return String(tokenId || '') + '|initiative';
    }

    function getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId) {
        var key;

        initState();

        key = initiativeConditionStateKey(tokenId);

        if (!state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key]) {
            state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key] = {
                tokenId: tokenId,
                selected: {},
                weaponSpeed: '',
                custom: 0
            };
        }

        state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key].tokenId = tokenId;
        state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key].selected = state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key].selected || {};
        state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key].weaponSpeed = state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key].weaponSpeed || '';
        state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key].custom = toInt(state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key].custom, 0);

        return state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[key];
    }

    function setInitiativeConditionSession(session) {
        initState();
        state[SCRIPT].initiativeConditions[initiativeConditionStateKey(session.tokenId)] = session;
    }

    function getInitConditionDef(key) {
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < INIT_CONDITIONS.length; i++) {
            if (INIT_CONDITIONS[i].key === key) {
                return INIT_CONDITIONS[i];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    function initiativeWeaponSpeedParts(session) {
        var value = String(session.weaponSpeed || '');
        var p;

        if (!value) {
            return null;
        }

        p = value.split('::');

        return {
            name: p[0] || 'Weapon',
            speed: toInt(p[1] || '0', 0)
        };
    }

    function initiativeConditionTotal(tokenId) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var total = toInt(session.custom, 0);
        var weaponParts = initiativeWeaponSpeedParts(session);
        var i;
        var def;

        for (i = 0; i < INIT_CONDITIONS.length; i++) {
            def = INIT_CONDITIONS[i];

            if (def.key !== 'none' && session.selected[def.key]) {
                total += def.mod;
            }
        }

        if (weaponParts) {
            total += weaponParts.speed;
        }

        return total;
    }

    function initiativeConditionSummary(tokenId) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var parts = [];
        var weaponParts = initiativeWeaponSpeedParts(session);
        var i;
        var def;

        for (i = 0; i < INIT_CONDITIONS.length; i++) {
            def = INIT_CONDITIONS[i];

            if (def.key !== 'none' && session.selected[def.key]) {
                parts.push(initButtonLabel(def));
            }
        }

        if (weaponParts) {
            parts.push(weaponParts.name);
        }

        if (toInt(session.custom, 0) !== 0) {
            parts.push(signed(toInt(session.custom, 0)));
        }

        if (!parts.length) {
            return 'None';
        }

        return parts.join('; ');
    }

    function toggleInitiativeCondition(tokenId, key) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var def = getInitConditionDef(key);

        if (!def) {
            return;
        }

        if (key === 'none') {
            session.selected = {};
            session.weaponSpeed = '';
            session.custom = 0;
            setInitiativeConditionSession(session);
            return;
        }

        if (session.selected[key]) {
            delete session.selected[key];
        } else {
            session.selected[key] = true;
        }

        setInitiativeConditionSession(session);
    }

    function setInitiativeCustom(tokenId, value) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);

        session.custom = toInt(value, 0);
        setInitiativeConditionSession(session);
    }

    function setInitiativeWeaponSpeed(tokenId, name, speed) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var current = String(session.weaponSpeed || '');
        var next = String(name || 'Weapon') + '::' + String(toInt(speed, 0));

        if (current === next) {
            session.weaponSpeed = '';
        } else {
            session.weaponSpeed = next;
        }

        setInitiativeConditionSession(session);
    }

    function renderInitGroup(tokenId, group, heading) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var out = '';
        var i;
        var def;

        if (heading) {
            out += '<div style="margin-top:4px;"><b>' + esc(heading) + ':</b></div>';
            out += '<div style="margin-left:8px;">';
        } else {
            out += '<div style="margin-top:2px;">';
        }

        for (i = 0; i < INIT_CONDITIONS.length; i++) {
            def = INIT_CONDITIONS[i];

            if (def.key === 'none' || def.group !== group) {
                continue;
            }

            if (session.selected[def.key]) {
                out += btnOn(initButtonLabel(def), '!gm1e-initcond|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key, '');
            } else {
                out += btnOff(initButtonLabel(def), '!gm1e-initcond|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key, '');
            }
        }

        out += '</div>';

        return out;
    }

    function renderSpellCastingTimeButtons(tokenId) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var out = '';
        var i;
        var key;
        var active;

        out += '<div style="margin-top:2px;"><span style="color:#ddd;">Spells/Scrolls:</span> ';

        for (i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            key = 'spell_ct_' + i;
            active = !!session.selected[key];

            if (active) {
                out += btnOn(String(i), '!gm1e-initcond|' + tokenId + '|' + key, 'Spell/scroll casting time ' + i + '.');
            } else {
                out += btnOff(String(i), '!gm1e-initcond|' + tokenId + '|' + key, 'Spell/scroll casting time ' + i + '.');
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderMagicMissileCastingButtons(tokenId) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var out = '';
        var i;
        var def;

        for (i = 0; i < INIT_CONDITIONS.length; i++) {
            def = INIT_CONDITIONS[i];

            if (def.group !== 'speed' || def.key.indexOf('spell_ct_') === 0) {
                continue;
            }

            if (session.selected[def.key]) {
                out += btnOn(initButtonLabel(def), '!gm1e-initcond|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key, '');
            } else {
                out += btnOff(initButtonLabel(def), '!gm1e-initcond|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key, '');
            }
        }

        out += '</div>';

        return out;
    }

    function renderWeaponSpeedButtons(tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var data;
        var out = '';
        var counts = {};
        var i;
        var rowId;
        var w;
        var speed;
        var label;
        var baseName;
        var value;
        var ranged;

        out += '<div style="margin-top:2px;">';

        if (!ch) {
            out += '<span style="color:#bbbbbb;">No character.</span></div>';
            return out;
        }

        data = collectWeapons(ch.id);

        if (!data.order.length) {
            out += '<span style="color:#bbbbbb;">No weapons.</span></div>';
            return out;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < data.order.length; i++) {
            w = data.rows[data.order[i]];
            baseName = String(w.name || 'Weapon');
            counts[baseName] = (counts[baseName] || 0) + 1;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < data.order.length; i++) {
            rowId = data.order[i];
            w = data.rows[rowId];
            ranged = isRangedWeapon(w);
            speed = ranged ? 0 : weaponInitiativeSpeed(w);
            baseName = String(w.name || 'Weapon');
            label = baseName + (counts[baseName] > 1 ? (ranged ? ' (Ranged)' : ' (Melee)') : '') + ' [' + speed + ']';
            value = label + '::' + speed;

            if (String(session.weaponSpeed || '') === value) {
                out += btnOn(label, '!gm1e-initweapon|' + tokenId + '|' + encodeURIComponent(label) + '|' + speed, 'Use this weapon speed for initiative.');
            } else {
                out += btnOff(label, '!gm1e-initweapon|' + tokenId + '|' + encodeURIComponent(label) + '|' + speed, 'Use this weapon speed for initiative.');
            }
        }

        out += '</div>';

        return out;
    }

    function initiativeGroupSummary(tokenId, groups) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var parts = [];
        var weaponParts = initiativeWeaponSpeedParts(session);
        var i;
        var def;
        var g;

        for (i = 0; i < INIT_CONDITIONS.length; i++) {
            def = INIT_CONDITIONS[i];

            for (g = 0; g < groups.length; g++) {
                if (def.group === groups[g] && session.selected[def.key]) {
                    parts.push(initButtonLabel(def));
                }
            }
        }

        if (weaponParts && groups.indexOf('weapon') !== -1) {
            parts.push(weaponParts.name);
        }

        if (!parts.length) {
            return 'None';
        }

        return parts.join('; ');
    }

    function initiativeActualConditionSummary(tokenId) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var parts = [];
        var i;
        var def;

        for (i = 0; i < INIT_CONDITIONS.length; i++) {
            def = INIT_CONDITIONS[i];

            if (def.group === 'condition' && session.selected[def.key]) {
                parts.push(initButtonLabel(def));
            }
        }

        if (toInt(session.custom, 0) !== 0) {
            parts.push('Custom ' + signed(-toInt(session.custom, 0)));
        }

        if (!parts.length) {
            return 'None';
        }

        return parts.join('; ');
    }

    function renderCustomInitiativeButtons(tokenId) {
        var session = getInitiativeConditionSession(tokenId);
        var out = '';
        var custom;
        var label;
        var tip;

        for (custom = 0; custom <= 10; custom++) {
            label = signed(custom);
            tip = 'Custom ' + label + '; adds ' + signed(custom) + ' to initiative total.';

            if (toInt(session.custom, 0) === custom) {
                out += btnOn(label, '!gm1e-initcustom|' + tokenId + '|' + custom, tip);
            } else {
                out += btnOff(label, '!gm1e-initcustom|' + tokenId + '|' + custom, tip);
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderInitiativeConditions(tokenId) {
        var out = '';
        var any = initiativeActualConditionSummary(tokenId) !== 'None';

        if (any) {
            out += btnOff('None', '!gm1e-initcond|' + tokenId + '|none', 'Clear initiative conditions/custom condition modifier.');
        } else {
            out += btnOn('None', '!gm1e-initcond|' + tokenId + '|none', 'No initiative conditions selected.');
        }

        out += renderInitGroup(tokenId, 'condition', '');
        out += '<div style="margin-top:2px;"><span style="color:#ddd;">Custom:</span> ' + renderCustomInitiativeButtons(tokenId) + '</div>';
        out += '<div style="margin-top:4px;"><b>Conditions:</b> ' + esc(initiativeActualConditionSummary(tokenId)) + '</div>';

        return row(out);
    }

    function renderDeclareActions(tokenId) {
        var out = '';

        out += renderWeaponSpeedButtons(tokenId);
        out += renderInitGroup(tokenId, 'action', '');
        out += renderMagicMissileCastingButtons(tokenId);
        out += renderInitGroup(tokenId, 'special', '');
        out += renderSpellCastingTimeButtons(tokenId);
        out += '<div style="margin-top:2px;"><span style="color:#ddd;">Custom:</span> ' + renderCustomInitiativeButtons(tokenId) + '</div>';

        return row(out);
    }

    function initiativeButtonHref(tokenId, cid) {

    }


    var THIEF_SKILLS = [
        { key: 'pickpockets', label: 'Pick Pockets', attr: 'pickpockets', queryHd: true },
        { key: 'openlocks', label: 'Open Locks', attr: 'openlocks' },
        { key: 'findtraps', label: 'Find/Remove Traps', attr: 'findtraps' },
        { key: 'movequietly', label: 'Move Silently', attr: 'movequietly' },
        { key: 'hideinshadows', label: 'Hide In Shadows', attr: 'hideinshadows' },
        { key: 'hearnoise', label: 'Hear Noise', attr: 'hearnoise' },
        { key: 'climbwalls', label: 'Climb Walls', attr: 'climbwalls' },
        { key: 'readlanguages', label: 'Read Languages', attr: 'readlanguages' }
    ];

    function thiefSkillsVisible(cid) {
        /*
         * Character sheet setting: attr_toggle_thief_skills = 1 means
         * thief skills are hidden on the sheet.
         */
        return String(getAttr(cid, 'toggle_thief_skills') || '') !== '1';
    }

    function thiefSkillDef(key) {
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < THIEF_SKILLS.length; i++) {
            if (THIEF_SKILLS[i].key === key) {
                return THIEF_SKILLS[i];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    function thiefSkillTarget(cid, def, hdValue) {
        var base = getAttrNumber(cid, [def.attr], 0);
        var hd = toInt(hdValue, 1);
        var penalty = 0;
        var finalTarget = base;

        if (def.key === 'pickpockets') {
            if (hd > 3) {
                penalty = (hd - 3) * 5;
            }

            finalTarget = base - penalty;
        }

        if (finalTarget < 0) {
            finalTarget = 0;
        }

        if (finalTarget > 100) {
            finalTarget = 100;
        }

        return {
            base: base,
            hd: hd,
            penalty: penalty,
            finalTarget: finalTarget,
            noticeTarget: finalTarget + 21
        };
    }

    function renderThiefSkillsSection(tokenId, cid) {
        var out = '';
        var buttons = '';
        var i;
        var def;
        var target;
        var href;
        var open;

        if (!thiefSkillsVisible(cid)) {
            return '';
        }

        open = isThiefSectionOpen(tokenId);

        out += '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border-left:3px solid #aa2222;padding:2px 4px;margin:5px 0 2px 0;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;">' +
            btn(open ? '-' : '+', '!gm1e-thiefsection|' + tokenId, open ? 'Collapse thief skills.' : 'Expand thief skills.') +
            '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;">Thief Skills</span>' +
            '</div>';

        if (!open) {
            return out;
        }

        out += row(neutral('Most rolls from this section are whispered to the Game Master only. Thief Climb Walls result is public after the roll.'));

        for (i = 0; i < THIEF_SKILLS.length; i++) {
            def = THIEF_SKILLS[i];
            target = getAttrNumber(cid, [def.attr], 0);

            if (def.queryHd) {
                href = '!gm1e-thiefroll|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key + '|?{HD of target|1}';
            } else if (def.key === 'climbwalls') {
                href = '!gm1e-thiefclimb|' + tokenId;
            } else {
                href = '!gm1e-thiefroll|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key + '|0';
            }

            buttons += btn(def.label + ' [' + target + '%]', href, 'Roll ' + def.label + (def.key === 'climbwalls' ? ' with thief climbing modifiers.' : ' secretly to the GM.'));
        }

        out += indentedRow(buttons);
        return out;
    }


    var THIEF_CLIMB_MODS = [
        { key: 'handholds', label: 'Abundant handholds / ledges / brush / trees', mod: 40 },
        { key: 'toprope', label: 'Braced feet with anchored top rope', mod: 55 },
        { key: 'inwardSlope', label: 'Surface slopes inward', mod: 25 },
        { key: 'slickSlight', label: 'Slightly slippery / wet / crumbling', mod: -25, group: 'slickness' },
        { key: 'slickSevere', label: 'Slippery / icy / slimy', mod: -40, group: 'slickness' }
    ];

    function getThiefClimbSession(tokenId) {
        var root = state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb || {};
        var session = root[tokenId];

        if (!state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb) {
            state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb = {};
        }

        if (!session) {
            session = { tokenId: tokenId, mods: {} };
            state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb[tokenId] = session;
        }

        session.tokenId = tokenId;

        if (!session.mods) {
            session.mods = {};
        }

        return session;
    }

    function setThiefClimbMod(tokenId, key) {
        var session = getThiefClimbSession(tokenId);
        var def = THIEF_CLIMB_MODS.filter(function (m) { return m.key === key; })[0];
        var i;

        if (!def) {
            return;
        }

        if (def.group) {
            for (i = 0; i < THIEF_CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
                if (THIEF_CLIMB_MODS[i].group === def.group && THIEF_CLIMB_MODS[i].key !== key) {
                    session.mods[THIEF_CLIMB_MODS[i].key] = false;
                }
            }
        }

        session.mods[key] = !session.mods[key];
    }

    function clearThiefClimbMods(tokenId) {
        state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb = state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb || {};
        state[SCRIPT].thiefClimb[tokenId] = { tokenId: tokenId, mods: {} };
    }

    function thiefClimbArmorMod(cid) {
        var armor = detectedClimbArmor(cid);
        var src = armor && armor.source ? String(armor.source).toLowerCase() : '';
        var label = armor && armor.source ? armor.source : 'no Armor Details armor in use';

        if (src.indexOf('studded') !== -1 || src.indexOf('padded') !== -1) {
            return { label: 'Thief Armor: Studded or Padded Leather', mod: -5, source: label };
        }

        return { label: 'Thief Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: label };
    }

    function thiefClimbWoundedMod(token, cid) {
        var hp = getHpPairForClimb(token, cid);

        if (!isNaN(hp.current) && !isNaN(hp.max) && hp.max > 0) {
            if (hp.current < (hp.max / 2)) {
                return { label: 'Wounded below 1/2 maximum HP', mod: -10, source: hp.current + '/' + hp.max + ' ' + hp.source };
            }

            return { label: 'HP: Not below 1/2 maximum', mod: 0, source: hp.current + '/' + hp.max + ' ' + hp.source };
        }

        return { label: 'HP: not detected for wounded modifier', mod: 0, source: hp.source };
    }

    function thiefClimbAutoMods(tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';

        return [
            thiefClimbArmorMod(cid),
            thiefClimbWoundedMod(token, cid)
        ];
    }

    function thiefClimbTarget(tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var session = getThiefClimbSession(tokenId);
        var base = getAttrNumber(cid, ['climbwalls'], 0);
        var total = base;
        var parts = [];
        var autoMods = thiefClimbAutoMods(tokenId);
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < autoMods.length; i++) {
            total += autoMods[i].mod;
            if (autoMods[i].mod !== 0) {
                parts.push(autoMods[i].label + ' ' + signed(autoMods[i].mod));
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i < THIEF_CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (session.mods[THIEF_CLIMB_MODS[i].key]) {
                total += THIEF_CLIMB_MODS[i].mod;
                parts.push(THIEF_CLIMB_MODS[i].label + ' ' + signed(THIEF_CLIMB_MODS[i].mod));
            }
        }

        if (total < 0) {
            total = 0;
        }

        if (total > 100) {
            total = 100;
        }

        return {
            base: base,
            finalTarget: total,
            summary: parts.length ? parts.join('; ') : 'None'
        };
    }

    function renderThiefClimbToggle(tokenId, session, def) {
        var active = !!session.mods[def.key];
        var label = def.label + ' ' + signed(def.mod);

        if (active) {
            return btnOn(label, '!gm1e-thiefclimbtoggle|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key);
        }

        return btnOff(label, '!gm1e-thiefclimbtoggle|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key);
    }

    function thiefClimbAutoRows(tokenId) {
        var mods = thiefClimbAutoMods(tokenId);
        var out = '';
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < mods.length; i++) {
            out += row('<b>' + esc(mods[i].label) + ':</b> ' + pill(signed(mods[i].mod)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(mods[i].source || '') + '</span>');
        }

        return out;
    }

    function showThiefClimbMenu(playerId, tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var session = getThiefClimbSession(tokenId);
        var target = thiefClimbTarget(tokenId);
        var out = '';
        var i;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Thief Climb Walls Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        if (!thiefSkillsVisible(cid)) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Thief Climb Walls Error') + row(bad('Thief Skills are hidden on this character sheet.'))));
            return;
        }

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' attempts to Climb Walls');
        out += section('Thief Climb Walls');
        out += row('<b>Base Climb Walls:</b> ' + pill(String(target.base) + '%') + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">character sheet climbwalls</span>');
        out += row('<b>Current Target:</b> ' + pill(String(target.finalTarget) + '%'));
        out += row('<b>Active Modifiers:</b> ' + neutral(target.summary));

        out += section('Automatic Modifiers');
        out += thiefClimbAutoRows(tokenId);

        out += section('Surface Conditions');
        for (i = 0; i < THIEF_CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
            out += row(renderThiefClimbToggle(tokenId, session, THIEF_CLIMB_MODS[i]));
        }

        out += hr();
        out += row(
            macroBtn('Roll Climb Walls', '!gm1e-thiefclimbroll|' + tokenId + '|?{Height to climb in feet|10}', 'Roll thief climb walls publicly after setting modifiers.') +
            btn('Clear Climb Mods', '!gm1e-thiefclimbclear|' + tokenId) +
            btn('Back to Character Sheet', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId)
        );

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(out));
    }

    function rollThiefClimbWalls(playerId, tokenId, heightFt) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var data = thiefClimbTarget(tokenId);
        var height = toInt(heightFt, 10);
        var roll;
        var success;
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Thief Climb Walls Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        if (!thiefSkillsVisible(cid)) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Thief Climb Walls Error') + row(bad('Thief Skills are hidden on this character sheet.'))));
            return;
        }

        playDiceSound();
        roll = randomInteger(100);
        success = roll <= data.finalTarget;

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' attempts to Climb Walls');
        out += section('Thief Climb Walls Roll');
        out += row('<b>Height:</b> ' + pill(String(height) + ' ft'));
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> ' + diePill(String(roll)) + '%');
        out += row('<b>Target:</b> ' + pill(String(data.finalTarget) + '%') + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">base climbwalls ' + esc(String(data.base)) + '% plus modifiers</span>');
        out += row('<b>Modifiers:</b> ' + neutral(data.summary));
        out += row(success ? good('SUCCESS') : bad('FAILURE'));
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Climb Walls Menu', '!gm1e-thiefclimb|' + tokenId) + btn('Back to Character Sheet', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }

    function rollThiefSkill(playerId, tokenId, key, hdValue) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var def = thiefSkillDef(key);
        var data;
        var roll;
        var success;
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch || !def) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Thief Skill Error') + row(bad('Token, linked character, or thief skill not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        if (!thiefSkillsVisible(cid)) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Thief Skill Error') + row(bad('Thief Skills are hidden on this character sheet.'))));
            return;
        }

        if (def.key === 'climbwalls') {
            showThiefClimbMenu(playerId, tokenId);
            return;
        }

        data = thiefSkillTarget(cid, def, hdValue);

        playDiceSound();
        roll = randomInteger(100);
        success = roll <= data.finalTarget;

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' - Thief Skill');
        out += section(def.label);
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> ' + diePill(String(roll)) + '%');
        out += row('<b>Target:</b> ' + pill(String(data.finalTarget) + '%') + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">sheet ' + esc(def.attr) + ' ' + esc(String(data.base)) + '%</span>');

        if (def.key === 'pickpockets') {
            out += row('<b>Target HD:</b> ' + pill(String(data.hd)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">penalty ' + esc(signed(-data.penalty)) + '% for HD over 3</span>');
            out += row('<b>Detection / Notice Range:</b> ' + pill(String(data.noticeTarget) + '%') + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">sheet target +21</span>');
        }

        out += row(success ? good('SUCCESS') : bad('FAILURE'));
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Character Sheet', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(out));
    }

    function buildCard(token) {
        var cid = token.get('represents');
        var ch, charName, ac, hp, move, body, tokenId, mainResult, attackButtons;

        if (!cid) {
            return box(title('GM1E Error') + row(bad('Selected token has no linked character.')));
        }

        ch = getObj('character', cid);

        if (!ch) {
            return box(title('GM1E Error') + row(bad('Character not found.')));
        }

        tokenId = token.id || '';
        charName = ch.get('name') || token.get('name') || 'Unnamed';

        ac = getAttr(cid, 'armorclass') || '-';

        hp =
            getAttr(cid, 'hitpoints') ||
            getAttr(cid, 'hp') ||
            getAttr(cid, 'hp_current') ||
            token.get('bar1_value') ||
            '-';

        if (getExhaustionLevel(cid) >= 6) {
            move = '0';
        } else {
            move = String(readCurrentSheetMove(cid));
        }

        if (move === 'NaN' || move === '') {
            move = '12';
        }

        mainResult = getMainResult(tokenId);

        body = '';
        body += title(charName);
        body += row('<b>AC:</b> ' + esc(ac));
        body += row('<b>HP:</b> ' + esc(hp));
        body += row('<b>Move:</b> ' + esc(move));
        body += row('<b>Exhaustion:</b> ' + exhaustionDisplay(getExhaustionLevel(cid)));

        body += hr();

        if (tokenId) {
            body += '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border-left:3px solid #aa2222;padding:2px 4px;margin:5px 0 2px 0;font-weight:bold;font-size:11px;">' +
                btn(isActionSectionOpen(tokenId) ? '-' : '+', '!gm1e-actionsection|' + tokenId, isActionSectionOpen(tokenId) ? 'Collapse actions.' : 'Expand actions.') +
                '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;">ACTIONS</span>' +
                macroBtn('Initiative', initiativeButtonHref(tokenId, cid), 'Roll initiative and add it to the turn tracker.') +
                macroBtn('Surprise', '!gm1e-surprise|' + tokenId + '|normal|?{Surprise on-the-spot modifier?|0}', 'Roll surprise in the API.') +
                macroBtn('Surprise Others', '!gm1e-surprise|' + tokenId + '|others|?{Surprise Others on-the-spot modifier?|0}', 'Roll Surprise Others in the API.') +
                '</div>';

            if (isActionSectionOpen(tokenId)) {
                body += initSubHeader(tokenId, 'conditions', 'Condition Modifiers', initiativeActualConditionSummary(tokenId));
                if (isInitSubSectionOpen(tokenId, 'conditions')) {
                    body += indentBlock(renderInitiativeConditions(tokenId));
                }

                body += initSubHeader(tokenId, 'declare', 'Declare Actions', initiativeGroupSummary(tokenId, ['action', 'weapon', 'speed', 'special']));
                if (isInitSubSectionOpen(tokenId, 'declare')) {
                    body += indentBlock(renderDeclareActions(tokenId));
                }
            }
        } else {
            body += section('Actions');
            body += row(
                macroBtn('Initiative', initiativeButtonHref(tokenId, cid), 'Roll initiative and add it to the turn tracker.') +
                macroBtn('Surprise', '!gm1e-surprise|@{selected|token_id}|normal|?{Surprise on-the-spot modifier?|0}', 'Roll surprise in the API.') +
                macroBtn('Surprise Others', '!gm1e-surprise|@{selected|token_id}|others|?{Surprise Others on-the-spot modifier?|0}', 'Roll Surprise Others in the API.')
            );
        }

        body += hr();

        if (tokenId) {
            body += '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border-left:3px solid #aa2222;padding:2px 4px;margin:5px 0 2px 0;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;">' +
                btn(isAttackSectionOpen(tokenId) ? '-' : '+', '!gm1e-attacksection|' + tokenId, isAttackSectionOpen(tokenId) ? 'Collapse attacks.' : 'Expand attacks.') +
                '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;">Attacks</span>' +
                '</div>';
            if (isAttackSectionOpen(tokenId)) {
                attackButtons =
                    btnYellow('Set Modifiers', '!gm1e-modmenu|' + tokenId, SAFE_ATTACK_INFO) +
                    btn('Clear Modifiers', '!gm1e-modclearback|' + tokenId, 'Clear stored modifiers for this attacker token.');
                body += indentBlock(activeModifierDisplay(tokenId));
                body += indentBlock(buildWeapons(token, cid));
                body += indentedRow(
                    macroBtn('Pummel', '!pummel --start|' + tokenId + '|@{target|Choose pummeling target|token_id}') +
                    macroBtn('Grapple', '!grapple --start|' + tokenId) +
                    macroBtn('Overbear', '!overbear --start|' + tokenId + '|@{target|Choose overbearing target|token_id}', 'Choose an overbearing target.') +
                    macroBtn('Disarm', '!disarm --start|' + tokenId + '|@{target|Choose disarm target|token_id}', 'Choose a disarm target.') +
                    macroBtn('Grenade', '!grenade --start|' + tokenId + '|@{target|Choose target or impact point|token_id}', 'Choose target or impact point for a grenade-like missile.')
                );
                body += indentedRow(attackButtons);
            }
        } else {
            body += section('Attacks');
            body += buildWeapons(token, cid);
        }

        if (tokenId) {
            body += hr();
            body += '<div style="background:#111;background-color:#111;color:#fff;border-left:3px solid #aa2222;padding:2px 4px;margin:5px 0 2px 0;font-weight:bold;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;">' +
                btn(isSpellSectionOpen(tokenId, 'all') ? '-' : '+', '!gm1e-spellsection|' + tokenId + '|all', isSpellSectionOpen(tokenId, 'all') ? 'Collapse spells.' : 'Expand spells.') +
                '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;">Spells</span>' +

                    macroBtn('Gaze Check', '!gm1e-gazecheck|' + tokenId + '|?{Creature size|Large or larger,0|Man-sized,1|Small,2}|?{Situation|Completely surprised (2+ segments),9|Surprised,7|Viewing monster,5|Attacking normally,3|Avoiding gaze (-4 to hit),1}', 'Roll whether the selected character meets a creature gaze.') +
                    macroBtn('Fall Damage', '!gm1e-falldamage|' + tokenId + '|?{Fall distance in feet|10}', 'Roll fall damage and system shock survival. Magic armor save bonus is read from Armor Details.') +
                    btn('Jumping', '!gm1e-jump|' + tokenId, 'Open jumping confirmation page.') +
                    btn('Climb Walls', '!gm1e-climb|' + tokenId, 'Open unskilled climbing confirmation page.') +
                    btn('Item Saves', '!gm1e-itemsaves|' + tokenId, 'Open item saving throw buttons.')
                );

                body += indentedRow(
                    btn('Para/Poison/Death', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' ppd') +
                    btn('Petrify/Poly', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' pp') +
                    btn('Rods/Staves/Wands', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' rsw') +
                    btn('Breath', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' breath') +
                    btn('Spells', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' spell')
                );
            }
        } else {
            body += section('Ability Checks/Saves');
            body += row(
                macroBtn('Ability Check', '!gm1e-abilitycheck|@{selected|token_id}|?{Attribute|Strength,strength|Dexterity,dexterity|Constitution,constitution|Intelligence,intelligence|Wisdom,wisdom|Charisma,charisma}|?{Task Difficulty|Easy (3d6),3d6|Hard (4d6),4d6|Very Hard (5d6),5d6|Extremely Hard (6d6),6d6|Impossible (10d6),10d6}', 'Roll an ability check against selected token attributes.') +
                macroBtn('Gaze Check', '!gm1e-gazecheck|@{selected|token_id}|?{Creature size|Large or larger,0|Man-sized,1|Small,2}|?{Situation|Completely surprised (2+ segments),9|Surprised,7|Viewing monster,5|Attacking normally,3|Avoiding gaze (-4 to hit),1}', 'Roll whether the selected character meets a creature gaze.') +
                macroBtn('Fall Damage', '!gm1e-falldamage|@{selected|token_id}|?{Fall distance in feet|10}', 'Roll fall damage and system shock survival. Magic armor save bonus is read from Armor Details.') +
                btn('Jumping', '!gm1e-jump|@{selected|token_id}', 'Open jumping confirmation page.') +
                btn('Climb Walls', '!gm1e-climb|@{selected|token_id}', 'Open unskilled climbing confirmation page.') +
                btn('Item Saves', '!gm1e-itemsaves|@{selected|token_id}', 'Open item saving throw buttons.')
            );

            body += row(
                btn('Para/Poison/Death', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' ppd') +
                btn('Petrify/Poly', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' pp') +
                btn('Rods/Staves/Wands', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' rsw') +
                btn('Breath', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' breath') +
                btn('Spells', '!gm1e-save ' + cid + ' spell')
            );
        }

        body += hr();

        if (tokenId) {
            body += hr();

                btn(isExhaustionSectionOpen(tokenId) ? '-' : '+', '!gm1e-exhaustionsection|' + tokenId, isExhaustionSectionOpen(tokenId) ? 'Collapse exhaustion.' : 'Expand exhaustion.') +
                '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;">Exhaustion</span>' +
                '<span style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;text-transform:none;">' + exhaustionDisplay(getExhaustionLevel(cid)) + '</span>' +
                '</div>';
