        }

        if (mainResult && mainResult.length) {
            body += renderResultBlock(mainResult);

            if (!resultHasOwnClear(mainResult)) {
                body += row('<div style="text-align:right;">' + btn('Clear Result', '!gm1e-clearresult|' + tokenId) + '</div>');
            }
        }

        return box(body);
    }

    function buildCardByCid(cid) {
        var ch = getObj('character', cid);
        var token;
        var tokens;

        if (!ch) {
            return box(title('GM1E Error') + row(bad('Character not found.')));
        }

        tokens = findObjs({
            _type: 'graphic',
            represents: cid
        }) || [];

        if (tokens.length) {
            token = tokens[0];
            return buildCard(token);
        }

        token = {
            id: '',
            get: function (key) {
                if (key === 'represents') {
                    return cid;
                }

                if (key === 'name') {
                    return ch.get('name') || 'Unnamed';
                }

                return '';
            }
        };

        return buildCard(token);
    }

    function getSaveDef(saveKey) {
        var defs = {
            ppd: {
                label: 'Para/Poison/Death',
                attr: 'saveparalysispoisondeath'
            },
            pp: {
                label: 'Petrify/Polymorph',
                attr: 'savepetrificationpolymorph'
            },
            rsw: {
                label: 'Rods/Staves/Wands',
                attr: 'saverodsstaveswands'
            },
            breath: {
                label: 'Breath Weapon',
                attr: 'savebreathweapons'
            },
            spell: {
                label: 'Spells',
                attr: 'savespells'
            }
        };

        return defs[saveKey] || null;
    }

    function addToTurnTracker(tokenId, value) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var turnorder;
        var turns;
        var i;
        var found = false;
        var name;

        if (!token) {
            log(SCRIPT + ' tracker error: token not found for id ' + tokenId);
            return;
        }

        name = tokenName(token);

        turnorder = Campaign().get('turnorder');

        if (!turnorder || turnorder === '') {
            turns = [];
        } else {
            try {
                turns = JSON.parse(turnorder);
            } catch (e) {
                turns = [];
            }
        }

        /*
         * Prefer updating either an existing token entry or the custom fallback
         * entry created by this API. Roll20 has been inconsistent about showing
         * API-added graphic id entries in the turn tracker; the custom entry is
         * visible and reliable.
         */
        for (i = 0; i < turns.length; i++) {
            if (turns[i].id === tokenId || turns[i]._id === tokenId || turns[i].custom === name) {
                turns[i].id = '-1';
                turns[i].custom = name;
                turns[i].pr = String(value);
                found = true;
            }
        }

        if (!found) {
            turns.push({
                id: '-1',
                pr: String(value),
                custom: name
            });
        }

        Campaign().set('initiativepage', true);
        Campaign().set('turnorder', JSON.stringify(turns));

        /*
         * Second write catches Roll20 timing issues if the tracker was just opened.
         */
        setTimeout(function () {
            Campaign().set('initiativepage', true);
            Campaign().set('turnorder', JSON.stringify(turns));
        }, 100);
    }

    function getMaxMovementValue(cid) {
        return getAttrNumber(cid, [
            'movement_max',
            'movement_normal',
            'movement',
            'move',
            'base_move',
            'base_movement'
        ], NaN);
    }

    function getEncumbranceMoveValue(cid) {
        return getAttrNumber(cid, [
            'current_encumbrance_move',
            'encumbrance_move',
            'adjusted_speed',
            'movement_adjusted'
        ], NaN);
    }

    function getLoadNumber(cid, names) {
        return getAttrNumber(cid, names, NaN);
    }

    function normalizeEncumbranceState(value) {
        var text = String(value || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
        var lower = text.toLowerCase();
        var n = parseNumber(text);

        if (!text) {
            return '';
        }

        /*
         * Important: check Unencumbered before Encumbered because
         * "unencumbered" contains the word "encumbered".
         */
        if (lower.indexOf('unencumbered') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('normal') !== -1) {
            return 'Unencumbered';
        }

        if (lower.indexOf('very') !== -1 && lower.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 'Very Heavy';
        }

        if (lower.indexOf('encumbered') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('encumbr') !== -1) {
            return 'Encumbered';
        }

        if (lower.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 'Heavy';
        }

        /*
         * Numeric state fallback only. This is deliberately lower-priority than
         * the Speed and Movement text field because the sheet can store other
         * numeric state values that do not match the visible Current Encumbrance.
         *
         * 1 = Unencumbered
         * 2 = Heavy
         * 3 = Very Heavy
         * 4+ = Encumbered
         */
        if (!isNaN(n)) {
            if (n <= 1) {
                return 'Unencumbered';
            }

            if (n === 2) {
                return 'Heavy';
            }

            if (n === 3) {
                return 'Very Heavy';
            }

            return 'Encumbered';
        }

        return '';
    }

    function isTextEncumbranceValue(value) {
        var text = String(value || '').toLowerCase().replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');

        return text === 'unencumbered' ||
            text === 'normal' ||
            text === 'heavy' ||
            text === 'very heavy' ||
            text === 'very-heavy' ||
            text === 'very_heavy' ||
            text === 'encumbered';
    }

    function deriveEncumbranceFromSpeedAndMovementText(cid) {
        var attrs = getAttrsForChar(cid);
        var preferredNames = [
            'current_encumbrance_status',
            'current_encumbrance_text',
            'current_encumbrance_name',
            'current_encumbrance_display',
            'current_encumbrance_label',
            'speed_current_encumbrance',
            'movement_current_encumbrance'
        ];
        var i;
        var a;
        var name;
        var value;
        var normalized;

        /*
         * First read likely explicit Speed and Movement "Current Encumbrance"
         * text/display fields.
         */
        for (i = 0; i < preferredNames.length; i++) {
            value = getAttr(cid, preferredNames[i]);

            if (isTextEncumbranceValue(value)) {
                return normalizeEncumbranceState(value);
            }
        }

        /*
         * Then scan all row attributes for a literal text value. This catches
         * sheet-specific names without letting numeric carrying-capacity state
         * fields override the visible Speed and Movement value.
         */
        for (i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) {
            a = attrs[i];
            name = String(a.get('name') || '').toLowerCase();
            value = a.get('current');

            if (name.indexOf('encumbrance') !== -1 && isTextEncumbranceValue(value)) {
                normalized = normalizeEncumbranceState(value);

                if (normalized) {
                    return normalized;
                }
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function deriveEncumbranceFromNumericState(cid) {
        var names = [
            'current_encumbrance',
            'current_encumbrance_level',
            'encumbrance_level',
            'encumbrance_status',
            'gear_encumbrance'
        ];
        var i;
        var v;
        var label;

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            v = getAttr(cid, names[i]);

            if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') !== '') {
                /*
                 * Numeric only here; text has already been handled above.
                 */
                if (!isNaN(parseNumber(v)) && !isTextEncumbranceValue(v)) {
                    label = normalizeEncumbranceState(v);

                    if (label) {
                        return label;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return '';
    }

    function deriveEncumbranceFromLoad(cid) {
        var currentLoad = getLoadNumber(cid, [
            'current_load',
            'current_load_gp',
            'total_load',
            'total_load_gp',
            'total_encumbrance',
            'total_encumbrance_gp',
            'carried_weight',
            'weight_carried'
        ]);
        var normalLoad = getLoadNumber(cid, [
            'normal_load_adjusted',
            'normal_load',
            'unencumbered_load',
            'unencumbered_load_adjusted'
        ]);
        var heavyLoad = getLoadNumber(cid, [
            'heavy_load',
            'heavy_load_adjusted'
        ]);
        var veryHeavyLoad = getLoadNumber(cid, [
            'very_heavy_load',
            'very_heavy_load_adjusted',
            'veryheavy_load',
            'veryheavy_load_adjusted'
        ]);
        var maxLoad = getLoadNumber(cid, [
            'max_load',
            'maximum_load'
        ]);

        /*
         * Use this only if an actual carried-load attribute is available.
         * Do not use current_encumbrance here because this sheet can use that
         * as a state value, not carried gp.
         */
        if (isNaN(currentLoad)) {
            return '';
        }

        if (!isNaN(normalLoad) && currentLoad <= normalLoad) {
            return 'Unencumbered';
        }

        if (!isNaN(heavyLoad) && currentLoad <= heavyLoad) {
            return 'Heavy';
        }

        if (!isNaN(veryHeavyLoad) && currentLoad <= veryHeavyLoad) {
            return 'Very Heavy';
        }

        if (!isNaN(maxLoad) && currentLoad <= maxLoad) {
            return 'Encumbered';
        }

        if (!isNaN(veryHeavyLoad) && currentLoad > veryHeavyLoad) {
            return 'Encumbered';
        }

        return '';
    }

    function deriveEncumbranceFromMove(cid) {
        var currentMove = getEncumbranceMoveValue(cid);
        var normalMove = getAttrNumber(cid, [
            'movement_normal',
            'movement_max',
            'movement',
            'move',
            'base_move',
            'base_movement'
        ], NaN);

        if (isNaN(currentMove) || isNaN(normalMove) || normalMove <= 0) {
            return '';
        }

        if (currentMove >= normalMove) {
            return 'Unencumbered';
        }

        if (currentMove >= normalMove * 0.75) {
            return 'Heavy';
        }

        if (currentMove >= normalMove * 0.5) {
            return 'Very Heavy';
        }

        return 'Encumbered';
    }

    function getEncumbranceLabel(cid) {
        var speedText = deriveEncumbranceFromSpeedAndMovementText(cid);
        var loadLabel = deriveEncumbranceFromLoad(cid);
        var moveLabel = deriveEncumbranceFromMove(cid);
        var numericState = deriveEncumbranceFromNumericState(cid);

        /*
         * Priority order:
         * 1. Visible Speed and Movement Current Encumbrance text.
         * 2. Actual carried-load thresholds, if an actual carried-load field exists.
         * 3. Movement-derived fallback.
         * 4. Numeric state fallback.
         */
        if (speedText) {
            return speedText;
        }

        if (loadLabel) {
            return loadLabel;
        }

        if (moveLabel) {
            return moveLabel;
        }

        if (numericState) {
            return numericState;
        }

        return '';
    }

    function getEncumbrancePenalty(cid) {
        var label = getEncumbranceLabel(cid).toLowerCase();

        /*
         * Important: check Unencumbered before Encumbered because
         * "unencumbered" contains the word "encumbered".
         *
         * 1e initiative: lower is better, so penalties are added to the
         * initiative total. Display remains traditional: very heavy -2,
         * encumbered -3.
         */
        if (label.indexOf('unencumbered') !== -1 || label.indexOf('normal') !== -1) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (label.indexOf('very') !== -1 && label.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 2;
        }

        if (label.indexOf('encumbered') !== -1 || label.indexOf('encumbr') !== -1) {
            return 3;
        }

        if (label.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return 0;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    function encumbranceDisplayPenalty(appliedPenalty) {
        appliedPenalty = parseInt(appliedPenalty, 10) || 0;

        if (appliedPenalty <= 0) {
            return '+0';
        }

        return '-' + appliedPenalty;
    }

    function showInitiativeConfirmation(playerId, tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid;
        var name;
        var surpriseBonus;
        var dexInitAdj;
        var encPenalty;
        var exLevel;
        var exInitPenalty;
        var cond;
        var speed;
        var encLabel;
        var formulaParts = [];
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Initiative Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        cid = ch.id;
        name = tokenName(token);

        surpriseBonus = Math.abs(getAttrNumber(cid, ['surprisebonus'], 0));
        encPenalty = getEncumbrancePenalty(cid);
        exLevel = getExhaustionLevel(cid);
        exInitPenalty = exLevel > 0 && exLevel < 6 ? exLevel : 0;
        dexInitAdj = encPenalty > 0 ? 0 : -surpriseBonus;
        cond = initiativeConditionTotal(tokenId);
        speed = 0;
        encLabel = getEncumbranceLabel(cid);

        if (!encLabel) {
            encLabel = encPenalty > 0 ? 'Encumbered' : 'Unencumbered';
        }

        formulaParts.push('d10');

        if (dexInitAdj !== 0) {
            formulaParts.push(signed(dexInitAdj) + ' Dex/Surprise');
        }

        if (encPenalty !== 0) {
            formulaParts.push('+' + encPenalty + ' encumbrance');
        }

        if (exInitPenalty !== 0) {
            formulaParts.push('+' + exInitPenalty + ' exhaustion');
        }

        if (cond !== 0) {
            formulaParts.push(signed(cond) + ' declared/conditions');
        }

        out += title(name);
        out += section('Confirm Initiative');
        out += row('<b>Roll Formula:</b> ' + esc(formulaParts.join(' ')));
        out += row('<b>Encumbrance:</b> ' + pill(encLabel) + neutral(' applies +' + encPenalty + ' if penalized'));
        out += row('<b>Dex / Surprise Bonus Available:</b> ' + pill(signed(surpriseBonus)));
        out += row('<b>Dex / Surprise Initiative Adjustment:</b> ' + pill(signed(dexInitAdj)) + (encPenalty > 0 ? ' ' + bad('negated by encumbrance') : ''));
        if (exInitPenalty !== 0) {
            out += row('<b>Exhaustion:</b> ' + pill('-' + exInitPenalty) + neutral(' applied as +' + exInitPenalty + ' to initiative total'));
        }
        if (cond !== 0) {
            out += row('<b>Selected Initiative Options:</b> ' + pill(signed(-cond)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(initiativeConditionSummary(tokenId)) + '</span>' + neutral(' applied as ' + signed(cond) + ' to initiative total'));
        } else {
            out += row('<b>Selected Initiative Options:</b> <span style="color:#51d66b;font-weight:bold;">None</span>');
        }
        out += row('<b>Speed / Casting / Item Modifier:</b> ' + pill(signed(speed)));
        out += hr();
        out += row(
            btn('Roll Initiative', '!gm1e-init|' + tokenId + '|' + cond + '|' + speed, 'Roll d10 and add this result to the turn tracker.') +
            btn('Back to Character Sheet', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId)
        );

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(out));
    }

    function rollInitiative(playerId, tokenId, conditionMod, speedMod) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid;
        var name;
        var roll;
        var surpriseBonus;
        var dexInitAdj;
        var encPenalty;
        var exLevel;
        var exInitPenalty;
        var cond;
        var speed;
        var total;
        var currentMove;
        var maxMove;
        var encLabel;
        var movementText;
        var out;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Initiative Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        cid = ch.id;
        name = tokenName(token);

        surpriseBonus = Math.abs(getAttrNumber(cid, ['surprisebonus'], 0));
        encPenalty = getEncumbrancePenalty(cid);
        exLevel = getExhaustionLevel(cid);
        exInitPenalty = exLevel > 0 && exLevel < 6 ? exLevel : 0;

        /*
         * Dexterity/surprise bonus can only improve initiative by reducing the roll.
         * If the character is encumbered enough to impose an initiative penalty, the
         * dexterity/surprise bonus is negated instead of being added.
         */
        dexInitAdj = encPenalty > 0 ? 0 : -surpriseBonus;

        cond = toInt(conditionMod, 0);
        speed = toInt(speedMod, 0);

        currentMove = parseNumber(getAttr(cid, 'current_encumbrance_move'));
        maxMove = getMaxMovementValue(cid);
        encLabel = getEncumbranceLabel(cid);

        if (!encLabel) {
            encLabel = encPenalty > 0 ? 'Encumbered' : 'Unencumbered';
        }

        movementText = '';

        playDiceSound();

        roll = randomInteger(10);
        total = roll + dexInitAdj + encPenalty + exInitPenalty + cond + speed;

        addToTurnTracker(tokenId, total);

        out = '';
        out += title(name);
        out += section('Initiative');
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> d10 = ' + diePill(String(roll)));
        out += row('<b>Encumbrance:</b> ' + pill(encLabel) + neutral(movementText));
        out += row('<b>Dex / Surprise Bonus Available:</b> ' + pill(signed(surpriseBonus)));
        out += row('<b>Dex / Surprise Initiative Adjustment:</b> ' + pill(signed(dexInitAdj)) + (encPenalty > 0 ? ' ' + bad('negated by encumbrance') : ''));
        out += row('<b>Encumbrance Initiative Penalty:</b> ' + pill(encumbranceDisplayPenalty(encPenalty)) + neutral(' applied as +' + encPenalty + ' to initiative total'));
        if (exInitPenalty !== 0) {
            out += row('<b>Exhaustion Initiative Penalty:</b> ' + pill('-' + exInitPenalty) + neutral(' applied as +' + exInitPenalty + ' to initiative total'));
        }
        if (cond !== 0) {
            out += row('<b>Condition Modifiers:</b> ' + pill(signed(-cond)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(initiativeConditionSummary(tokenId)) + '</span>' + neutral(' applied as ' + signed(cond) + ' to initiative total'));
        }
        out += row('<b>Speed / Casting / Item Modifier:</b> ' + pill(signed(speed)));
        out += row('<div style="display:block;margin:4px 0;min-height:20px;"><span style="display:inline-block;width:42%;text-align:left;"><b>Initiative Total:</b></span><span style="display:inline-block;width:18%;text-align:center;">' + diePill(String(total)) + '</span><span style="display:inline-block;width:40%;">&nbsp;</span></div>');
        out += row(good('Added to turn tracker.'));
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(out));
    }


    function rollSimpleDice(expr) {
        var m, count, sides, total, rolls, i, r;

        expr = String(expr || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
        m = expr.match(/^(\d*)d(\d+)$/);

        if (!m) {
            return {
                total: toInt(expr, 0),
                detail: expr || '0'
            };
        }

        count = m[1] ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 1;
        sides = parseInt(m[2], 10);
        total = 0;
        rolls = [];

        for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            r = randomInteger(sides);
            rolls.push(r);
            total += r;
        }

        return {
            total: total,
            detail: count + 'd' + sides + ' [' + rolls.join(', ') + ']'
        };
    }



    var JUMP_LEVEL_BANDS = [
        { min: 1, max: 6, label: '1-6', standing: { die: 4, add: 1 }, running: { die: 4, add: 5 }, high: { die: 3, add: 0 } },
        { min: 7, max: 9, label: '7-9', standing: { die: 4, add: 2 }, running: { die: 4, add: 6 }, high: { die: 4, add: 0 } },
        { min: 10, max: 12, label: '10-12', standing: { die: 6, add: 2 }, running: { die: 6, add: 5 }, high: { die: 3, add: 1 } },
        { min: 13, max: 15, label: '13-15', standing: { die: 4, add: 3 }, running: { die: 4, add: 6 }, high: { die: 4, add: 1 } },
        { min: 16, max: 18, label: '16-18', standing: { die: 6, add: 4 }, running: { die: 6, add: 9 }, high: { die: 5, add: 0 } },
        { min: 19, max: 22, label: '19-22', standing: { die: 6, add: 5 }, running: { die: 6, add: 12 }, high: { die: 5, add: 1 } }
    ];

    function getJumpLevelBand(level) {
        var i;

        level = parseInt(level, 10) || 0;

        for (i = 0; i < JUMP_LEVEL_BANDS.length; i++) {
            if (level >= JUMP_LEVEL_BANDS[i].min && level <= JUMP_LEVEL_BANDS[i].max) {
                return JUMP_LEVEL_BANDS[i];
            }
        }

        if (level > 22) {
            return JUMP_LEVEL_BANDS[JUMP_LEVEL_BANDS.length - 1];
        }

        return null;
    }

    function raceJumpPenalty(race) {
        var r = String(race || '').toLowerCase();

        if (r.indexOf('halfling') !== -1) {
            return { broad: -1, high: 0, label: 'Halfling: -1 broad jump' };
        }

        if (r.indexOf('gnome') !== -1 || r.indexOf('dwarf') !== -1 || r.indexOf('dwarven') !== -1) {
            return { broad: -2, high: -1, label: 'Gnome/Dwarf: -2 broad jump, -1 high jump' };
        }

        return { broad: 0, high: 0, label: 'No racial jump penalty' };
    }

    function encumbranceJumpInfo(cid) {
        var penalty = getEncumbrancePenalty(cid);
        var label = getEncumbranceLabel(cid);
        var lower = String(label || '').toLowerCase();
        var jumpPenalty = 0;
        var noHigh = false;
        var cannotJump = false;
        var note;

        if (!label) {
            label = penalty > 0 ? 'Encumbered' : 'Normal';
            lower = String(label).toLowerCase();
        }

        /*
         * Check Unencumbered/Normal first because "unencumbered"
         * contains the word "encumbered".
         */
        if (lower.indexOf('unencumbered') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('normal') !== -1) {
            jumpPenalty = 0;
            note = 'Normal: no encumbrance jump penalty.';
        } else if (lower.indexOf('very') !== -1 && lower.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            jumpPenalty = -2;
            noHigh = true;
            note = 'Very Heavy: -2 ft; no high jump.';
        } else if (lower.indexOf('encumbered') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('max') !== -1 || penalty >= 3) {
            jumpPenalty = 0;
            cannotJump = true;
            note = 'Encumbered: cannot jump.';
        } else if (lower.indexOf('heavy') !== -1 || penalty === 1) {
            jumpPenalty = -1;
            note = 'Heavy: -1 ft.';
        } else {
            note = 'Normal: no encumbrance jump penalty.';
        }

        return {
            label: label,
            penalty: jumpPenalty,
            noHigh: noHigh,
            cannotJump: cannotJump,
            note: note
        };
    }

    function jumpFormulaRange(jumpFormula, strengthBonus, racePenalty, encPenalty, isHigh, encInfo) {
        var minVal;
        var maxVal;

        if (!jumpFormula) {
            return { min: 0, max: 0, text: 'not eligible' };
        }

        if (isHigh && encInfo.noHigh) {
            return { min: 0, max: 0, text: 'not allowed while very heavily encumbered' };
        }

        if (encInfo.cannotJump) {
            return { min: 0, max: 0, text: 'cannot jump while encumbered' };
        }

        minVal = 1 + jumpFormula.add + strengthBonus + racePenalty + encPenalty;
        maxVal = jumpFormula.die + jumpFormula.add + strengthBonus + racePenalty + encPenalty;

        if (isHigh) {
            minVal = Math.max(1, minVal);
            maxVal = Math.max(1, maxVal);
        } else {
            minVal = Math.max(2, minVal);
            maxVal = Math.max(2, maxVal);
        }

        return {
            min: minVal,
            max: maxVal,
            text: minVal + '-' + maxVal + ' ft'
        };
    }

    function jumpRollFormula(jumpFormula, strengthBonus, racePenalty, encPenalty, isHigh, encInfo) {
        var roll;
        var total;

        if (!jumpFormula || encInfo.cannotJump || (isHigh && encInfo.noHigh)) {
            return { allowed: false, roll: 0, total: 0, detail: 'not allowed' };
        }

        playDiceSound();
        roll = randomInteger(jumpFormula.die);
        total = roll + jumpFormula.add + strengthBonus + racePenalty + encPenalty;

        if (isHigh) {
            total = Math.max(1, total);
        } else {
            total = Math.max(2, total);
        }

        return {
            allowed: true,
            roll: roll,
            total: total,
            detail: '1d' + jumpFormula.die + ' ' + signed(jumpFormula.add) + ' base ' + signed(strengthBonus) + ' STR ' + signed(racePenalty) + ' race ' + signed(encPenalty) + ' encumbrance'
        };
    }

    function showJumpConfirmation(playerId, tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var level;
        var strengthBonus;
        var race;
        var raceInfo;
        var encInfo;
        var band;
        var standingRange;
        var runningRange;
        var highRange;
        var eligible;
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Jumping Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        level = getAttrNumber(cid, ['level', 'hitdice_total', 'hitdice'], 0);
        strengthBonus = getAttrNumber(cid, ['meleebonus'], 0);
        race = getAttr(cid, 'race') || '';
        raceInfo = raceJumpPenalty(race);
        encInfo = encumbranceJumpInfo(cid);
        band = getJumpLevelBand(level);
        eligible = !!band && !encInfo.cannotJump;

        if (band) {
            standingRange = jumpFormulaRange(band.standing, strengthBonus, raceInfo.broad, encInfo.penalty, false, encInfo);
            runningRange = jumpFormulaRange(band.running, strengthBonus, raceInfo.broad, encInfo.penalty, false, encInfo);
            highRange = jumpFormulaRange(band.high, strengthBonus, raceInfo.high, encInfo.penalty, true, encInfo);
        } else {
            standingRange = { text: 'not eligible' };
            runningRange = { text: 'not eligible' };
            highRange = { text: 'not eligible' };
        }

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' Jumping');
        out += section('Jumping Confirmation');
        out += row('<b>Level:</b> ' + pill(String(level)) + (band ? ' <span style="color:#ddd;">band ' + esc(band.label) + '</span>' : ' ' + bad('No jumping table band for this level.')));
        out += row('<b>Strength Bonus:</b> ' + pill(signed(strengthBonus)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">meleebonus</span>');
        out += row('<b>Race:</b> ' + pill(race || 'none') + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(raceInfo.label) + '</span>');
        out += row('<b>Encumbrance:</b> ' + pill(encInfo.label) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(encInfo.note) + '</span>');
        out += row('<b>Eligibility:</b> ' + (eligible ? good('Eligible to jump.') : bad(encInfo.cannotJump ? 'Not eligible: encumbered characters cannot jump.' : 'Not eligible: no valid jumping level band.')));

        out += section('Possible Jump Ranges');
        out += row('<b>Standing Broad Jump:</b> ' + pill(standingRange.text));
        out += row('<b>Running Broad Jump:</b> ' + pill(runningRange.text));
        out += row('<b>High Jump:</b> ' + pill(highRange.text));
        out += row(neutral('Modifiers are cumulative. Broad jumps cannot be reduced below 2 ft; high jumps cannot be reduced below 1 ft.'));

        out += hr();
        if (eligible) {
            out += row(
                btn('Roll Standing Jump', '!gm1e-jumproll|' + tokenId + '|standing') +
                btn('Roll Running Jump', '!gm1e-jumproll|' + tokenId + '|running') +
                btn('Roll High Jump', '!gm1e-jumproll|' + tokenId + '|high')
            );
        }
        out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(out));
    }

    function rollJump(playerId, tokenId, jumpType) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var level;
        var strengthBonus;
        var race;
        var raceInfo;
        var encInfo;
        var band;
        var formula;
        var racePenalty;
        var isHigh;
        var result;
        var label;
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Jumping Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        level = getAttrNumber(cid, ['level', 'hitdice_total', 'hitdice'], 0);
        strengthBonus = getAttrNumber(cid, ['meleebonus'], 0);
        race = getAttr(cid, 'race') || '';
        raceInfo = raceJumpPenalty(race);
        encInfo = encumbranceJumpInfo(cid);
        band = getJumpLevelBand(level);

        if (jumpType === 'running') {
            formula = band ? band.running : null;
            racePenalty = raceInfo.broad;
            isHigh = false;
            label = 'Running Broad Jump';
        } else if (jumpType === 'high') {
            formula = band ? band.high : null;
            racePenalty = raceInfo.high;
            isHigh = true;
            label = 'High Jump';
        } else {
            formula = band ? band.standing : null;
            racePenalty = raceInfo.broad;
            isHigh = false;
            label = 'Standing Broad Jump';
        }

        result = jumpRollFormula(formula, strengthBonus, racePenalty, encInfo.penalty, isHigh, encInfo);

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' Jumping');
        out += section(label);
        out += row('<b>Level:</b> ' + pill(String(level)) + (band ? ' <span style="color:#ddd;">band ' + esc(band.label) + '</span>' : ' ' + bad('No valid band.')));
        out += row('<b>Strength Bonus:</b> ' + pill(signed(strengthBonus)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">meleebonus</span>');
        out += row('<b>Race Modifier:</b> ' + pill(signed(racePenalty)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(raceInfo.label) + '</span>');
        out += row('<b>Encumbrance:</b> ' + pill(encInfo.label) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(encInfo.note) + '</span>');

        if (!result.allowed) {
            out += row(bad('Jump not allowed: ' + result.detail + '.'));
        } else {
            out += row('<b>Roll:</b> ' + diePill(String(result.roll)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(result.detail) + '</span>');
            out += row('<b>Jump Distance:</b> ' + resultPill(String(result.total) + ' ft', true));
        }

        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Jumping Menu', '!gm1e-jump|' + tokenId) + btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }


    var CLIMB_MODS = [
        { key: 'raceDwarf', label: 'Race: Dwarf', mod: -10, group: 'race' },
        { key: 'raceGnomeHalfling', label: 'Race: Gnome or Halfling', mod: -15, group: 'race' },
        { key: 'handholds', label: 'Abundant handholds', mod: 40 },
        { key: 'toprope', label: 'Braced feet with anchored top rope', mod: 55 },
        { key: 'inwardSlope', label: 'Surface slopes inward', mod: 25 },
        { key: 'armorBandedSplint', label: 'Armor: Banded or Splint', mod: -25, group: 'armor' },
        { key: 'armorPlate', label: 'Armor: Plate, any type', mod: -50, group: 'armor' },
        { key: 'armorScaleChain', label: 'Armor: Scale or Chain', mod: -15, group: 'armor' },
        { key: 'armorStuddedPadded', label: 'Armor: Studded or Padded Leather', mod: -5, group: 'armor' },
        { key: 'slickSlight', label: 'Surface: Slightly slick, wet, or crumbling', mod: -25, group: 'surface' },
        { key: 'slickSevere', label: 'Surface: Slick, icy, or slimy', mod: -40, group: 'surface' },
        { key: 'wounded', label: 'Wounded below 1/2 maximum HP', mod: -10 }
    ];

    function getClimbSession(tokenId) {
        var root = state.GM1E_CLIMB || {};
        var session = root[tokenId];

        if (!state.GM1E_CLIMB) {
            state.GM1E_CLIMB = {};
        }

        if (!session) {
            session = { mods: {} };
            state.GM1E_CLIMB[tokenId] = session;
        }

        if (!session.mods) {
            session.mods = {};
        }

        return session;
    }

    function setClimbMod(tokenId, key) {
        var session = getClimbSession(tokenId);
        var def = CLIMB_MODS.filter(function (m) { return m.key === key; })[0];
        var i;

        if (!def) {
            return;
        }

        if (def.group) {
            for (i = 0; i < CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
                if (CLIMB_MODS[i].group === def.group && CLIMB_MODS[i].key !== key) {
                    session.mods[CLIMB_MODS[i].key] = false;
                }
            }
        }

        session.mods[key] = !session.mods[key];
    }

    function clearClimbMods(tokenId) {
        state.GM1E_CLIMB = state.GM1E_CLIMB || {};
        state.GM1E_CLIMB[tokenId] = { mods: {} };
    }

    function climbTotal(session) {
        var total = 40;
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (session.mods[CLIMB_MODS[i].key]) {
                total += CLIMB_MODS[i].mod;
            }
        }

        if (total < 0) {
            total = 0;
        }

        if (total > 100) {
            total = 100;
        }

        return total;
    }

    function climbSummary(session) {
        var parts = [];
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (session.mods[CLIMB_MODS[i].key]) {
                parts.push(CLIMB_MODS[i].label + ' ' + signed(CLIMB_MODS[i].mod));
            }
        }

        return parts.length ? parts.join('; ') : 'None';
    }

    function renderClimbToggle(tokenId, session, def) {
        var active = !!session.mods[def.key];
        var label = (active ? 'Yes' : 'No') + ' ' + def.label + ' ' + signed(def.mod);

        if (active) {
            return btnOn(label, '!gm1e-climbtoggle|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key);
        }

        return btnOff(label, '!gm1e-climbtoggle|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key);
    }

    function renderClimbGroup(tokenId, session, titleText, keys) {
        var out = '';
        var i;
        var def;

        out += section(titleText);
        for (i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
            def = CLIMB_MODS.filter(function (m) { return m.key === keys[i]; })[0];
            if (def) {
                out += row(renderClimbToggle(tokenId, session, def));
            }
        }

        return out;
    }

    function showClimbConfirmation(playerId, tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var session = getClimbSession(tokenId);
        var target = climbTotal(session);
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Climb Walls Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' attempts an unskilled climb');
        out += section('Climb Walls Confirmation');
        out += row('<b>Base Chance:</b> ' + pill('40%'));
        out += row('<b>Current Target:</b> ' + pill(String(target) + '%'));
        out += row('<b>Active Modifiers:</b> ' + neutral(climbSummary(session)));
        out += row('<b>Eligibility:</b> ' + (target > 0 ? good('Eligible to attempt climb.') : bad('Chance reduced to 0%; not realistically climbable.')));

        out += renderClimbGroup(tokenId, session, 'Race Modifiers', ['raceDwarf', 'raceGnomeHalfling']);
        out += renderClimbGroup(tokenId, session, 'Helpful Conditions', ['handholds', 'toprope', 'inwardSlope']);
        out += renderClimbGroup(tokenId, session, 'Armor Modifiers', ['armorBandedSplint', 'armorPlate', 'armorScaleChain', 'armorStuddedPadded']);
        out += renderClimbGroup(tokenId, session, 'Surface / Wound Modifiers', ['slickSlight', 'slickSevere', 'wounded']);

        out += hr();
        out += row(
            btn('Roll Climb Walls', '!gm1e-climbroll|' + tokenId) +
            btn('Clear Climb Mods', '!gm1e-climbclear|' + tokenId) +
            btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId)
        );

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(out));
    }

    function rollClimbWalls(playerId, tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var session = getClimbSession(tokenId);
        var target = climbTotal(session);
        var roll;
        var success;
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Climb Walls Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        playDiceSound();
        roll = randomInteger(100);
        success = roll <= target;

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' attempts an unskilled climb');
        out += section('Climbing Roll');
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> ' + diePill(String(roll)) + '%');
        out += row('<b>Target:</b> ' + pill(String(target) + '%') + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">base 40% plus modifiers</span>');
        out += row('<b>Modifiers:</b> ' + neutral(climbSummary(session)));
        out += row(success ? good('SUCCESS') : bad('FAILURE'));
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Climb Walls Menu', '!gm1e-climb|' + tokenId) + btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }


    /*
     * Climb Walls v0.3.25 override:
     * Race, armor, and wounded-below-half are now read automatically
     * from the character sheet/token. Manual climb buttons no longer
     * show Yes/No text; green means active.
     */
    CLIMB_MODS = [
        { key: 'handholds', label: 'Abundant handholds', mod: 40 },
        { key: 'toprope', label: 'Braced feet with anchored top rope', mod: 55 },
        { key: 'inwardSlope', label: 'Surface slopes inward', mod: 25 },
        { key: 'slickSlight', label: 'Surface: Slightly slick, wet, or crumbling', mod: -25, group: 'surface' },
        { key: 'slickSevere', label: 'Surface: Slick, icy, or slimy', mod: -40, group: 'surface' }
    ];

    function getClimbSession(tokenId) {
        var root = state.GM1E_CLIMB || {};
        var session = root[tokenId];

        if (!state.GM1E_CLIMB) {
            state.GM1E_CLIMB = {};
        }

        if (!session) {
            session = { tokenId: tokenId, mods: {} };
            state.GM1E_CLIMB[tokenId] = session;
        }

        session.tokenId = tokenId;

        if (!session.mods) {
            session.mods = {};
        }

        return session;
    }

    function getHpPairForClimb(token, cid) {
        var names = ['hitpoints', 'hp', 'hp_current'];
        var i;
        var a;
        var current;
        var maxv;

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            a = findObjs({
                _type: 'attribute',
                _characterid: cid,
                name: names[i]
            }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];

            if (a) {
                current = parseNumber(a.get('current'));
                maxv = parseNumber(a.get('max'));

                if (!isNaN(current) && !isNaN(maxv) && maxv > 0) {
                    return { current: current, max: maxv, source: names[i] };
                }
            }
        }

        if (token) {
            current = parseNumber(token.get('bar1_value'));
            maxv = parseNumber(token.get('bar1_max'));

            if (!isNaN(current) && !isNaN(maxv) && maxv > 0) {
                return { current: current, max: maxv, source: 'token bar 1' };
            }
        }

        return { current: NaN, max: NaN, source: 'not found' };
    }

    function armorTextForClimb(cid) {
        var attrs = getAttrsForChar(cid);
        var preferred = [
            'armor_type',
            'armortype',
            'armor_name',
            'armorname',
            'current_armor',
            'currentarmor',
            'equipped_armor',
            'equippedarmor',
            'armor',
            'armorclass_armor_type',
            'armor_bulk',
            'current_armor_bulk'
        ];
        var i;
        var value;
        var a;
        var name;
        var pieces = [];

        for (i = 0; i < preferred.length; i++) {
            value = getAttr(cid, preferred[i]);
            if (value) {
                pieces.push(String(value));
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) {
            a = attrs[i];
            name = String(a.get('name') || '').toLowerCase();

            if (
                name.indexOf('armor') !== -1 &&
                (
                    name.indexOf('type') !== -1 ||
                    name.indexOf('name') !== -1 ||
                    name.indexOf('current') !== -1 ||
                    name.indexOf('equipped') !== -1 ||
                    name.indexOf('bulk') !== -1
                )
            ) {
                value = a.get('current');
                if (value) {
                    pieces.push(String(value));
                }
            }
        }

        return pieces.join(' ').toLowerCase();
    }

    function automaticClimbMods(tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var race = getAttr(cid, 'race') || '';
        var raceLower = String(race).toLowerCase();
        var armorText = armorTextForClimb(cid);
        var hp = getHpPairForClimb(token, cid);
        var mods = [];
        var armorApplied = false;

        if (raceLower.indexOf('dwarf') !== -1 || raceLower.indexOf('dwarven') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Race: Dwarf', mod: -10, source: race || 'race' });
        } else if (raceLower.indexOf('gnome') !== -1 || raceLower.indexOf('halfling') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Race: Gnome or Halfling', mod: -15, source: race || 'race' });
        } else {
            mods.push({ label: 'Race: ' + (race || 'Other'), mod: 0, source: race || 'race' });
        }

        if (armorText.indexOf('plate') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Armor: Plate, any type', mod: -50, source: armorText });
            armorApplied = true;
        } else if (armorText.indexOf('banded') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('splint') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Armor: Banded or Splint', mod: -25, source: armorText });
            armorApplied = true;
        } else if (armorText.indexOf('scale') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('chain') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Armor: Scale or Chain', mod: -15, source: armorText });
            armorApplied = true;
        } else if (armorText.indexOf('studded') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('padded') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Armor: Studded or Padded Leather', mod: -5, source: armorText });
            armorApplied = true;
        } else if (armorText.indexOf('leather') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('none') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('not bulky') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: armorText || 'armor' });
            armorApplied = true;
        }

        if (!armorApplied) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: armorText || 'not detected' });
        }

        if (!isNaN(hp.current) && !isNaN(hp.max) && hp.max > 0) {
            if (hp.current < (hp.max / 2)) {
                mods.push({ label: 'Wounded below 1/2 maximum HP', mod: -10, source: hp.current + '/' + hp.max + ' ' + hp.source });
            } else {
                mods.push({ label: 'HP: Not below 1/2 maximum', mod: 0, source: hp.current + '/' + hp.max + ' ' + hp.source });
            }
        } else {
            mods.push({ label: 'HP: not detected for wounded modifier', mod: 0, source: hp.source });
        }

        return mods;
    }

    function climbTotal(session) {
        var total = 40;
        var i;
        var autoMods = automaticClimbMods(session.tokenId);

        for (i = 0; i < autoMods.length; i++) {
            total += autoMods[i].mod;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (session.mods[CLIMB_MODS[i].key]) {
                total += CLIMB_MODS[i].mod;
            }
        }

        if (total < 0) {
            total = 0;
        }

        if (total > 100) {
            total = 100;
        }

        return total;
    }

    function climbSummary(session) {
        var parts = [];
        var i;
        var autoMods = automaticClimbMods(session.tokenId);

        for (i = 0; i < autoMods.length; i++) {
            if (autoMods[i].mod !== 0) {
                parts.push(autoMods[i].label + ' ' + signed(autoMods[i].mod));
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i < CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (session.mods[CLIMB_MODS[i].key]) {
                parts.push(CLIMB_MODS[i].label + ' ' + signed(CLIMB_MODS[i].mod));
            }
        }

        return parts.length ? parts.join('; ') : 'None';
    }

    function autoClimbRows(tokenId) {
        var mods = automaticClimbMods(tokenId);
        var out = '';
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < mods.length; i++) {
            out += row('<b>' + esc(mods[i].label) + ':</b> ' + pill(signed(mods[i].mod)) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(mods[i].source || '') + '</span>');
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderClimbToggle(tokenId, session, def) {
        var active = !!session.mods[def.key];
        var label = def.label + ' ' + signed(def.mod);

        if (active) {

        }

        return btnOff(label, '!gm1e-climbtoggle|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key);
    }

    /*
     * Climb Walls v0.3.26 override:
     * - Armor source output is condensed to the detected armor category.
     * - Encumbrance is automatic: Unencumbered +0, Heavy -10, Very Heavy -20,
     *   Encumbered is not eligible.
     * - All manual choices are grouped together as surface conditions/modifiers.
     * - Current speed/move is shown on the confirmation and public roll result.
     */
    CLIMB_MODS = [
        { key: 'handholds', label: 'Abundant handholds / ledges / brush / trees', mod: 40 },
        { key: 'toprope', label: 'Braced feet with anchored top rope', mod: 55 },
        { key: 'inwardSlope', label: 'Surface slopes inward', mod: 25 },
        { key: 'slickSlight', label: 'Slightly slippery / wet / crumbling', mod: -25, group: 'slickness' },
        { key: 'slickSevere', label: 'Slippery / icy / slimy', mod: -40, group: 'slickness' }
    ];

    function climbSpeedText(cid) {
        var move = readCurrentSheetMove(cid);

        if (move === undefined || move === null || String(move) === '' || String(move) === 'NaN') {
            move = getAttr(cid, 'movement') || getAttr(cid, 'move') || getAttr(cid, 'speed') || '12';
        }

        return String(move);
    }

    function climbEncumbranceMod(cid) {
        var label = getEncumbranceLabel(cid);
        var lower = String(label || '').toLowerCase();

        if (!label) {
            label = 'Unencumbered';
            lower = 'unencumbered';
        }

        if (lower.indexOf('unencumbered') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('normal') !== -1) {
            return { label: label, mod: 0, eligible: true, note: 'Unencumbered: +0%.' };
        }

        if (lower.indexOf('very') !== -1 && lower.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return { label: label, mod: -20, eligible: true, note: 'Very Heavy: -20%.' };
        }

        if (lower.indexOf('encumbered') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('encumbr') !== -1) {
            return { label: label, mod: 0, eligible: false, note: 'Encumbered: not eligible to climb.' };
        }

        if (lower.indexOf('heavy') !== -1) {
            return { label: label, mod: -10, eligible: true, note: 'Heavy: -10%.' };
        }

        return { label: label, mod: 0, eligible: true, note: 'No encumbrance penalty detected.' };
    }

    function getClimbSession(tokenId) {
        var root = state.GM1E_CLIMB || {};
        var session = root[tokenId];

        if (!state.GM1E_CLIMB) {
            state.GM1E_CLIMB = {};
        }

        if (!session) {
            session = { tokenId: tokenId, mods: {} };
            state.GM1E_CLIMB[tokenId] = session;
        }

        session.tokenId = tokenId;

        if (!session.mods) {
            session.mods = {};
        }

        return session;
    }

    function getHpPairForClimb(token, cid) {
        var names = ['hitpoints', 'hp', 'hp_current'];
        var i;
        var a;
        var current;
        var maxv;

        for (i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            a = findObjs({
                _type: 'attribute',
                _characterid: cid,
                name: names[i]
            }, { caseInsensitive: true })[0];

            if (a) {
                current = parseNumber(a.get('current'));
                maxv = parseNumber(a.get('max'));

                if (!isNaN(current) && !isNaN(maxv) && maxv > 0) {
                    return { current: current, max: maxv, source: names[i] };
                }
            }
        }

        if (token) {
            current = parseNumber(token.get('bar1_value'));
            maxv = parseNumber(token.get('bar1_max'));

            if (!isNaN(current) && !isNaN(maxv) && maxv > 0) {
                return { current: current, max: maxv, source: 'token bar 1' };
            }
        }

        return { current: NaN, max: NaN, source: 'not found' };
    }

    function armorTextForClimb(cid) {
        var attrs = getAttrsForChar(cid);
        var preferred = [
            'armor_type',
            'armortype',
            'armor_name',
            'armorname',
            'current_armor',
            'currentarmor',
            'equipped_armor',
            'equippedarmor',
            'armor',
            'armorclass_armor_type',
            'armor_bulk',
            'current_armor_bulk'
        ];
        var i;
        var value;
        var a;
        var name;
        var pieces = [];

        for (i = 0; i < preferred.length; i++) {
            value = getAttr(cid, preferred[i]);
            if (value) {
                pieces.push(String(value));
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) {
            a = attrs[i];
            name = String(a.get('name') || '').toLowerCase();

            if (
                name.indexOf('armor') !== -1 &&
                (
                    name.indexOf('type') !== -1 ||
                    name.indexOf('name') !== -1 ||
                    name.indexOf('current') !== -1 ||
                    name.indexOf('equipped') !== -1 ||
                    name.indexOf('bulk') !== -1
                )
            ) {
                value = a.get('current');
                if (value) {
                    pieces.push(String(value));
                }
            }
        }

        return pieces.join(' ').toLowerCase();
    }

    function detectedClimbArmor(cid) {
        var armorText = armorTextForClimb(cid);

        if (armorText.indexOf('plate') !== -1) {
            return { label: 'Armor: Plate, any type', mod: -50, source: 'plate' };
        }

        if (armorText.indexOf('banded') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('splint') !== -1) {
            return { label: 'Armor: Banded or Splint', mod: -25, source: armorText.indexOf('banded') !== -1 ? 'banded' : 'splint' };
        }

        if (armorText.indexOf('scale') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('chain') !== -1) {
            return { label: 'Armor: Scale or Chain', mod: -15, source: armorText.indexOf('scale') !== -1 ? 'scale' : 'chain' };
        }

        if (armorText.indexOf('studded') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('padded') !== -1) {
            return { label: 'Armor: Studded or Padded Leather', mod: -5, source: armorText.indexOf('studded') !== -1 ? 'studded leather' : 'padded leather' };
        }

        if (armorText.indexOf('leather') !== -1) {
            return { label: 'Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: 'leather' };
        }

        if (armorText.indexOf('none') !== -1 || armorText.indexOf('not bulky') !== -1 || !armorText) {
            return { label: 'Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: armorText ? 'none / not bulky' : 'not detected' };
        }

        return { label: 'Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: 'not detected' };
    }

    function automaticClimbMods(tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var race = getAttr(cid, 'race') || '';
        var raceLower = String(race).toLowerCase();
        var hp = getHpPairForClimb(token, cid);
        var enc = climbEncumbranceMod(cid);
        var armor = detectedClimbArmor(cid);
        var mods = [];

        if (raceLower.indexOf('dwarf') !== -1 || raceLower.indexOf('dwarven') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Race: Dwarf', mod: -10, source: race || 'race' });
        } else if (raceLower.indexOf('gnome') !== -1 || raceLower.indexOf('halfling') !== -1) {
            mods.push({ label: 'Race: Gnome or Halfling', mod: -15, source: race || 'race' });
        } else {
            mods.push({ label: 'Race: ' + (race || 'Other'), mod: 0, source: race || 'race' });
        }

        mods.push(armor);
        mods.push({ label: 'Encumbrance: ' + enc.label, mod: enc.mod, source: enc.note, eligible: enc.eligible });

        if (!isNaN(hp.current) && !isNaN(hp.max) && hp.max > 0) {
            if (hp.current < (hp.max / 2)) {
                mods.push({ label: 'Wounded below 1/2 maximum HP', mod: -10, source: hp.current + '/' + hp.max + ' ' + hp.source });
            } else {
                mods.push({ label: 'HP: Not below 1/2 maximum', mod: 0, source: hp.current + '/' + hp.max + ' ' + hp.source });
            }
        } else {
            mods.push({ label: 'HP: not detected for wounded modifier', mod: 0, source: hp.source });
        }

        return mods;
    }

    function climbEligible(session) {
        var mods = automaticClimbMods(session.tokenId);
        var i;

        for (i = 0; i < mods.length; i++) {
            if (mods[i].eligible === false) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    function climbTotal(session) {
        var total = 40;
        var i;
        var autoMods = automaticClimbMods(session.tokenId);

        if (!climbEligible(session)) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < autoMods.length; i++) {
            total += autoMods[i].mod;
        }

        for (i = 0; i < CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (session.mods[CLIMB_MODS[i].key]) {
                total += CLIMB_MODS[i].mod;
            }
        }

        if (total < 0) {
            total = 0;
        }

        if (total > 100) {
            total = 100;
        }

        return total;
    }

    function climbSummary(session) {
        var parts = [];
        var i;
        var autoMods = automaticClimbMods(session.tokenId);

        for (i = 0; i < autoMods.length; i++) {
            if (autoMods[i].eligible === false) {
                parts.push(autoMods[i].label + ' not eligible');
            } else if (autoMods[i].mod !== 0) {
                parts.push(autoMods[i].label + ' ' + signed(autoMods[i].mod));
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i < CLIMB_MODS.length; i++) {
            if (session.mods[CLIMB_MODS[i].key]) {
                parts.push(CLIMB_MODS[i].label + ' ' + signed(CLIMB_MODS[i].mod));
            }
        }

        return parts.length ? parts.join('; ') : 'None';
    }

    function autoClimbRows(tokenId) {
        var mods = automaticClimbMods(tokenId);
        var out = '';
        var i;
        var modText;

        for (i = 0; i < mods.length; i++) {
            modText = mods[i].eligible === false ? 'not eligible' : signed(mods[i].mod);
            out += row('<b>' + esc(mods[i].label) + ':</b> ' + pill(modText) + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(mods[i].source || '') + '</span>');
        }

        return out;
    }

    function renderClimbToggle(tokenId, session, def) {
        var active = !!session.mods[def.key];
        var label = def.label + ' ' + signed(def.mod);

        if (active) {
            return btnOn(label, '!gm1e-climbtoggle|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key);
        }

        return btnOff(label, '!gm1e-climbtoggle|' + tokenId + '|' + def.key);
    }

    function showClimbConfirmation(playerId, tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var session = getClimbSession(tokenId);
        var target = climbTotal(session);
        var eligible = climbEligible(session) && target > 0;
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Climb Walls Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' attempts an unskilled climb');
        out += section('Climb Walls Confirmation');
        out += row('<b>Base Chance:</b> ' + pill('40%'));
        out += row('<b>Speed:</b> ' + pill(climbSpeedText(cid)));
        out += row('<b>Current Target:</b> ' + pill(String(target) + '%'));
        out += row('<b>Active Modifiers:</b> ' + neutral(climbSummary(session)));
        out += row('<b>Eligibility:</b> ' + (eligible ? good('Eligible to attempt climb.') : bad(climbEligible(session) ? 'Chance reduced to 0%; not realistically climbable.' : 'Not eligible because current encumbrance prevents climbing.')));

        out += section('Climb Modifiers');
        out += autoClimbRows(tokenId);
        out += renderClimbGroup(tokenId, session, 'Surface Conditions', ['handholds', 'toprope', 'inwardSlope', 'slickSlight', 'slickSevere']);

        out += hr();
        out += row(
            btn('Roll Climb Walls', '!gm1e-climbroll|' + tokenId) +
            btn('Clear Climb Mods', '!gm1e-climbclear|' + tokenId) +
            btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId)
        );

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(out));
    }

    function rollClimbWalls(playerId, tokenId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var session = getClimbSession(tokenId);
        var target = climbTotal(session);
        var roll;
        var success;
        var out = '';

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Climb Walls Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        playDiceSound();
        roll = randomInteger(100);
        success = climbEligible(session) && roll <= target;

        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' attempts an unskilled climb');
        out += section('Climbing Roll');
        out += row('<b>Speed:</b> ' + pill(climbSpeedText(cid)));
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> ' + diePill(String(roll)) + '%');
        out += row('<b>Target:</b> ' + pill(String(target) + '%') + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">base 40% plus automatic and selected modifiers</span>');
        out += row('<b>Modifiers:</b> ' + neutral(climbSummary(session)));
        if (!climbEligible(session)) {
            out += row(bad('FAILURE: character is not eligible to climb at current encumbrance.'));
        } else {
            out += row(success ? good('SUCCESS') : bad('FAILURE'));
        }
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Climb Walls Menu', '!gm1e-climb|' + tokenId) + btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }


    /*
     * Climb Walls v0.3.27 override:
     * Armor detection now reads only Armor Details worn fields:
     * Armor 1/Armor 2 selected type + their In Use checkboxes.
     * No full character-attribute scan.
     */
    function armorDetailsClimbArmor(cid) {
        var rows = [
            { worn: 'armortype_worn', selected: 'armortype_select_all', hidden: 'armortype', label: 'Armor 1' },
            { worn: 'armortype2_worn', selected: 'armortype2_select_all', hidden: 'armortype2', label: 'Armor 2' }
        ];
        var i;
        var worn;
        var armorName;
        var lower;

        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            worn = String(getAttr(cid, rows[i].worn) || '');
            if (worn !== '1' && worn.toLowerCase() !== 'on' && worn.toLowerCase() !== 'true') {
                continue;
            }

            armorName = getAttr(cid, rows[i].selected) || getAttr(cid, rows[i].hidden) || '';
            lower = String(armorName || '').toLowerCase();

            if (!lower) {
                continue;
            }

            if (lower.indexOf('plate') !== -1) {
                return { label: 'Armor: Plate, any type', mod: -50, source: rows[i].label + ': ' + armorName };
            }

            if (lower.indexOf('banded') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('splint') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('splinted') !== -1) {
                return { label: 'Armor: Banded or Splint', mod: -25, source: rows[i].label + ': ' + armorName };
            }

            if (lower.indexOf('scale') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('chain') !== -1) {
                return { label: 'Armor: Scale or Chain', mod: -15, source: rows[i].label + ': ' + armorName };
            }

            if (lower.indexOf('studded') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('padded') !== -1) {
                return { label: 'Armor: Studded or Padded Leather', mod: -5, source: rows[i].label + ': ' + armorName };
            }

            if (lower.indexOf('leather') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('ring') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('none') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('non-armor') !== -1) {
                return { label: 'Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: rows[i].label + ': ' + armorName };
            }

            return { label: 'Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: rows[i].label + ': ' + armorName };
        }

        return { label: 'Armor: Leather or None', mod: 0, source: 'no Armor Details armor in use' };
    }

    function detectedClimbArmor(cid) {
        return armorDetailsClimbArmor(cid);
    }
