    function rollItemSave(playerId, tokenId, materialKey, damageKey, bonusValue) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var def = ITEM_SAVE_MATRIX[materialKey];
        var target, bonus, roll, total, success, out;

        if (!token || !def || def[damageKey] === undefined) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Item Save Error') + row(bad('Token, material, or damage type not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        target = toInt(def[damageKey], 0);
        bonus = toInt(bonusValue, 0);
        playDiceSound();
        roll = randomInteger(20);
        total = roll + bonus;
        success = target > 0 && total >= target;

        out = '';
        out += title(tokenName(token) + ' - Item Save');
        out += row('<b>Saves As:</b> ' + esc(def.label));
        out += row('<b>Damage Type:</b> ' + esc(ITEM_DAMAGE_LABELS[damageKey] || damageKey));
        if (def.note) {
            out += row(neutral(def.note));
        }
        if (target <= 0) {
            out += row(bad('No save allowed for this material against this damage type.'));
        } else {
            out += row('<b>Target:</b> ' + pill(String(target)) + ' or greater');
            out += row('<b>Roll:</b> d20 ' + diePill(String(roll)) + (bonus ? ' + bonus ' + pill(signed(bonus)) : '') + ' = ' + resultPill(String(total), success));
            out += row(success ? good('SUCCESS') : bad('FAILURE'));
        }
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Item Saves', '!gm1e-itemsaves|' + tokenId) + btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }

    function rollAbilityCheck(playerId, tokenId, attrName, diceExpr) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var labelMap = {
            strength: 'Strength',
            dexterity: 'Dexterity',
            constitution: 'Constitution',
            intelligence: 'Intelligence',
            wisdom: 'Wisdom',
            charisma: 'Charisma'
        };
        var safeAttr = String(attrName || 'strength').toLowerCase();
        var abilityScore, rolled, success, out;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Ability Check Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        if (!labelMap[safeAttr]) {
            safeAttr = 'strength';
        }

        abilityScore = getAttrNumber(cid, [safeAttr], 10);
        playDiceSound();
        rolled = rollSimpleDice(diceExpr || '3d6');
        success = rolled.total <= abilityScore;

        out = '';
        out += title('Ability Check');
        out += row('<b>Name:</b> ' + esc(tokenName(token)));
        out += row('<b>Attribute:</b> ' + esc(labelMap[safeAttr]) + ' ' + pill(String(abilityScore)));
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> ' + diePill(rolled.detail) + ' = ' + resultPill(String(rolled.total), success));
        out += row(success ? good('SUCCESS: roll is less than or equal to ability score.') : bad('FAILURE: roll exceeds ability score.'));
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }

    function rollGazeCheck(playerId, tokenId, sizeMod, situationTarget) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var roll, mod, target, total, metGaze, out;

        if (!token) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Gaze Check Error') + row(bad('Token not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        mod = toInt(sizeMod, 0);
        target = toInt(situationTarget, 5);
        playDiceSound();
        roll = randomInteger(10);
        total = roll + mod;
        metGaze = total <= target;

        out = '';
        out += title('Gaze Check');
        out += row('<b>Name:</b> ' + esc(tokenName(token)));
        out += row("<b>Question:</b> Did the character meet the creature\'s gaze?");
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> d10 ' + diePill(String(roll)) + ' + size modifier ' + pill(signed(mod)) + ' = ' + resultPill(String(total), metGaze));
        out += row('<b>Target:</b> ' + pill(String(target)));
        out += row(metGaze ? bad('GAZE MET.') : good('Gaze avoided. Failure means you avoided gaze.'));
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }


    function wornMagicArmorForFall(cid) {
        var rows = [
            { worn: 'armortype_worn', magic: 'armortype_magic', selected: 'armortype_select_all', hidden: 'armortype', label: 'Armor 1' },
            { worn: 'armortype2_worn', magic: 'armortype2_magic', selected: 'armortype2_select_all', hidden: 'armortype2', label: 'Armor 2' }
        ];
        var i;
        var worn;
        var magic;
        var bestMagic = 0;
        var bestLabel = 'None';
        var armorName;

        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            worn = String(getAttr(cid, rows[i].worn) || '').toLowerCase();

            if (worn !== '1' && worn !== 'on' && worn !== 'true') {
                continue;
            }

            magic = parseNumber(getAttr(cid, rows[i].magic));
            if (isNaN(magic) || magic < 0) {
                magic = 0;
            }

            armorName = getAttr(cid, rows[i].selected) || getAttr(cid, rows[i].hidden) || 'armor';

            if (magic > bestMagic) {
                bestMagic = magic;
                bestLabel = rows[i].label + ': ' + armorName + ' +' + magic;
            }
        }

        if (bestMagic > 4) {
            bestMagic = 4;
        }

        return {
            magic: bestMagic,
            saveBonus: bestMagic * 5,
            label: bestLabel
        };
    }

    function rollFallDamage(playerId, tokenId, distanceFt, armorBonus) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var distance, diceCount, i, r, rolls, total, shock, bonus, target, shockRoll, success, finalDamage, out, magicArmor;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Fall Damage Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        distance = toInt(distanceFt, 10);
        if (distance < 0) {
            distance = 0;
        }

        diceCount = Math.floor(distance / 10);
        if (diceCount < 1) {
            diceCount = 1;
        }

        if (diceCount > 20) {
            diceCount = 20;
        }

        magicArmor = wornMagicArmorForFall(cid);
        bonus = magicArmor.saveBonus;
        shock = getAttrNumber(cid, ['systemshock', 'system_shock', 'systemshocksurvival'], 0);
        target = shock + bonus;

        playDiceSound();

        rolls = [];
        total = 0;

        for (i = 0; i < diceCount; i++) {
            r = randomInteger(6);
            rolls.push(r);
            total += r;
        }

        shockRoll = randomInteger(100);
        success = shockRoll <= target;
        finalDamage = success ? Math.ceil(total / 2) : total;

        out = '';
        out += title('Fall Damage - ' + tokenName(token));
        out += row('<b>Distance:</b> ' + esc(String(distance)) + ' ft');
        out += row('<b>Full Damage:</b> ' + diePill(diceCount + 'd6 [' + rolls.join(', ') + ']') + ' = ' + pill(String(total)));
        out += section('System Shock Survival');
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> ' + diePill(String(shockRoll)) + '%');
        out += row('<b>Magic Armor:</b> ' + pill(magicArmor.magic ? '+' + magicArmor.magic : 'None') + ' <span style="color:#ddd;">' + esc(magicArmor.label) + '; system shock save bonus +' + esc(String(bonus)) + '%</span>');
        out += row('<b>Target:</b> ' + pill(String(target)) + '% <span style="color:#ddd;">system shock ' + esc(String(shock)) + ' + magic armor bonus ' + esc(String(bonus)) + '</span>');
        out += row(success ? good('SUCCESS: take half damage. No item save for armor is required.') : bad('FAILURE: take full damage and roll item save for armor.'));
        out += row('<b>Applied Damage:</b> ' + pill(String(finalDamage)));
        out += hr();
        if (success) {
            out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));
        } else {
            out += row(btn('Item Saves', '!gm1e-itemsaves|' + tokenId, 'Check item saves for armor or gear.') + btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));
        }

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }

    function rollSave(cid, saveKey) {
        var def = getSaveDef(saveKey);
        var ch = getObj('character', cid);
        var charName, raw, target, roll, modifiedRoll, exLevel, exPenalty, out;

        if (!def) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(title('Saving Throw Error') + row(bad('Unknown saving throw type.'))));
            return;
        }

        if (!ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(title('Saving Throw Error') + row(bad('Character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        charName = ch.get('name') || 'Unnamed';
        raw = getAttr(cid, def.attr);
        target = parseNumber(raw);

        if (isNaN(target)) {
            out = '';
            out += title(charName + ' - ' + def.label);
            out += row(bad('Save value not found for attribute: ' + def.attr));
            out += hr();
            out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-open ' + cid));
            sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(out));
            return;
        }

        playDiceSound();

        roll = randomInteger(20);
        exLevel = getExhaustionLevel(cid);
        exPenalty = exhaustionPenalty(exLevel);
        modifiedRoll = roll + exPenalty;

        out = '';
        out += title(charName);
        out += section('Saving Throw: ' + def.label);
        out += row('<b>Target:</b> ' + esc(String(target)));
        out += row('<b>Roll:</b> ' + diePill(String(roll)));
        if (exPenalty !== 0) {
            out += row('<b>Exhaustion Save Penalty:</b> ' + pill(signed(exPenalty)));
            out += row('<b>Modified Roll:</b> ' + resultPill(String(modifiedRoll), modifiedRoll >= target));
        }
        out += row(modifiedRoll >= target ? good('SUCCESS') : bad('FAILURE'));
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-open ' + cid));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(out));
    }


    function clampNumber(value, min, max) {
        value = parseInt(value, 10) || 0;
        if (value < min) {
            return min;
        }
        if (value > max) {
            return max;
        }
        return value;
    }

    function surpriseDiePill(roll, surprised) {
        return resultPill(String(roll), surprised);
    }

    function rollSurpriseApi(playerId, tokenId, mode, spotModValue) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var cid = ch ? ch.id : '';
        var name = token ? tokenName(token) : 'Unknown';
        var out = '';
        var chance;
        var die;
        var roll;
        var spotMod;
        var othersAdj;
        var finalChance;
        var surprised;
        var surpriseBonus;
        var dexInitAdj;
        var encPenalty;
        var encLabel;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(playerId) + box(title('Surprise Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        chance = getAttrNumber(cid, ['surprise'], 2);
        die = getAttrNumber(cid, ['surprise_die'], 6);
        if (die < 1) {
            die = 6;
        }

        spotMod = toInt(spotModValue, 0);
        othersAdj = getAttrNumber(cid, ['surprise_others_mod'], 0);
        surpriseBonus = Math.abs(getAttrNumber(cid, ['surprisebonus'], 0));
        encPenalty = getEncumbrancePenalty(cid);
        encLabel = getEncumbranceLabel(cid);

        if (!encLabel) {
            encLabel = encPenalty > 0 ? 'Encumbered' : 'Normal';
        }

        dexInitAdj = encPenalty > 0 ? 0 : -surpriseBonus;

        if (mode === 'others') {
            finalChance = clampNumber(chance + othersAdj + spotMod, 0, die);
        } else {
            finalChance = clampNumber(chance + spotMod, 0, die);
        }

        playDiceSound();
        roll = randomInteger(die);
        surprised = finalChance > 0 && roll <= finalChance;

        out += title(name);

        if (mode === 'others') {
            out += section('Surprise Others');
            out += row('<b>Base:</b> Surprise Others ' + pill('1-' + chance) + ' on ' + pill('1d' + die));
            out += row('<b>Roll:</b> d' + die + ' = ' + surpriseDiePill(roll, surprised));
            out += row('<b>Surprise Others Adj:</b> ' + pill(signed(othersAdj)));
            out += row('<b>On-the-spot Modifier:</b> ' + pill(signed(spotMod)));
            out += row('<b>Final Surprise Range:</b> ' + pill(finalChance > 0 ? '1-' + finalChance : 'none') + ' on ' + pill('1d' + die));
            out += row(surprised ? good('Opponent is surprised by this character.') : bad('Opponent is not surprised by this character.'));
        } else {
            out += section('Surprise');
            out += row('<b>Base:</b> Surprise Chance ' + pill('1-' + chance) + ' on ' + pill('1d' + die));
            out += row('<b>Roll:</b> d' + die + ' = ' + surpriseDiePill(roll, surprised));
            out += row('<b>On-the-spot Modifier:</b> ' + pill(signed(spotMod)));
            out += row('<b>Final Surprise Range:</b> ' + pill(finalChance > 0 ? '1-' + finalChance : 'none') + ' on ' + pill('1d' + die));
            out += row(surprised ? bad('Character is surprised.') : good('Character is not surprised.'));
        }

        out += section('Segment Adjustments');
        out += row('<b>Dex Adj:</b> ' + pill(signed(dexInitAdj)) + ' <b>Encum/Bulk:</b> ' + pill(encLabel) + ' ' + neutral(encPenalty > 0 ? 'Dex adjustment negated by encumbrance.' : 'None'));
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }

    function rollAction(tokenId, action) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var ch = charByToken(token);
        var name = token ? tokenName(token) : 'Unknown';
        var out = '';
        var roll;

        if (!token || !ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(title('GM1E Action Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        playDiceSound();

        out += title(name);

        if (action === 'initiative') {
            rollInitiative(tokenId, 0, 0);
            return;
        } else if (action === 'surprise') {
            rollSurpriseApi('gm', tokenId, 'normal', 0);
            return;
        } else if (action === 'senses') {
            roll = randomInteger(6);
            out += section('Senses');
            out += row('<b>d6:</b> ' + diePill(String(roll)));
        } else {
            out += section('Action');
            out += row(bad('Unknown action.'));
        }

        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-token|' + tokenId));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
    }

    function showNotes(cid) {
        var ch = getObj('character', cid);
        var charName, notes, out;

        if (!ch) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(title('Notes Error') + row(bad('Character not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        charName = ch.get('name') || 'Unnamed';
        notes = getAttr(cid, 'npc_notes');

        if (!notes) {
            notes = '<span style="color:#ffffff;">No notes found.</span>';
        }

        notes = String(notes);
        notes = notes.split('\r\n').join('\n');
        notes = notes.split('\r').join('\n');
        notes = notes.split('\n').join('<br>');

        out = '';
        out += title(charName + ' - Notes');
        out += '<div style="background:#000000;color:#ffffff;white-space:normal;padding:4px;border:1px solid #333;">' + notes + '</div>';
        out += hr();
        out += row(btn('Back to Main Menu', '!gm1e-open ' + cid));

        sendChat(SCRIPT, '/w gm ' + box(out));
    }

    function showTokenCardById(tokenId, playerId) {
        var token = tokenById(tokenId);
        var whisper = playerWhisperPrefix(playerId);

        if (!token) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, whisper + box(title('GM1E Error') + row(bad('Token not found.'))));
            return;
        }

        sendChat(SCRIPT, whisper + buildCard(token));
    }

    on('chat:message', function (msg) {
        var out, i, token, cid, ch, parts, saveKey;
        var attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, key, modSession, value, sizeKey;

        if (msg.type !== 'api') {
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-initconfirm|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            showInitiativeConfirmation(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-init|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            rollInitiative(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '0', parts[3] || '0');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-initmodsection|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            toggleInitiativeModifierSection(attackerTokenId);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-actionsection|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            toggleActionSection(attackerTokenId);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-savesection|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            toggleSaveSection(attackerTokenId);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }


        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-thiefsection|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            toggleThiefSection(attackerTokenId);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-thiefroll|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            rollThiefSkill(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '', parts[3] || '0');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-thiefclimb|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            showThiefClimbMenu(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-thiefclimbtoggle|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            setThiefClimbMod(parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '');
            showThiefClimbMenu(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-thiefclimbclear|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            clearThiefClimbMods(parts[1] || '');
            showThiefClimbMenu(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '');

        }

            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            rollThiefClimbWalls(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '10');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-climb|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            showClimbConfirmation(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-climbtoggle|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            setClimbMod(parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '');
            showClimbConfirmation(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-climbclear|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            clearClimbMods(parts[1] || '');
            showClimbConfirmation(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '');

            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            rollFallDamage(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '10', '0');

            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            showItemSaves(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '');
            return;

            showItemSaveMaterial(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '');
            return;

            rollItemSave(msg.playerid, parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '', parts[3] || '', parts[4] || '0');

            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);

            parts = msg.content.split('|');

            value = parts[2] || '0';

            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-save ') === 0) {

            toggleAttackSection(attackerTokenId);

        }

            toggleSpellRow(attackerTokenId, parts[2] || '', parts[3] || '');

        }

            toggleSpellRow(attackerTokenId, parts[2] || '', parts[3] || '');

            parts = msg.content.split(/\s+/);
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-customroll ') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split(/\s+/);

                out += row('<span style="color:#bbbbbb;">No character-sheet return token was available for this roll.</span>');
            }

            sendChat(SCRIPT, box(out));
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-spellcast|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            castSpellFromApi(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId, parts[2] || '', parts[3] || '');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modmenu|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modsection|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            key = parts[2] || '';

            toggleModSection(attackerTokenId, key);
            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modgroupclear|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            key = parts[2] || '';

            modSession = getModifierSession(attackerTokenId);

            if (key === 'spell') {
                clearModGroup(modSession, SPELL_MODS);
            } else {
                clearModGroup(modSession, ATTACK_MODS);
            }

            setModifierSession(modSession);
            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-exhaustionsection|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            toggleExhaustionSection(attackerTokenId);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-exhaustion|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            value = toInt(parts[2], 0);

            token = tokenById(attackerTokenId);
            ch = charByToken(token);

            if (!token || !ch) {
                sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(msg.playerid) + box(title('Exhaustion Error') + row(bad('Token or linked character not found.'))));
                return;
            }

            if (getExhaustionLevel(ch.id) === value && value !== 0) {
                value = 0;
            }

            setExhaustionLevel(ch.id, value);
            applyExhaustionSheetEffects(attackerTokenId, ch.id);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modtoggle|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            key = parts[2] || '';

            modSession = getModifierSession(attackerTokenId);
            modSession.mods[key] = !modSession.mods[key];
            setModifierSession(modSession);

            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modcover|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            key = parts[2] || 'none';

            modSession = getModifierSession(attackerTokenId);
            modSession.cover = key;
            setModifierSession(modSession);

            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modconceal|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            key = parts[2] || 'none';

            modSession = getModifierSession(attackerTokenId);
            modSession.concealment = key;
            setModifierSession(modSession);

            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modmanualtoggle|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            modSession = getModifierSession(attackerTokenId);
            modSession.useManualAttackBonus = !modSession.useManualAttackBonus;
            setModifierSession(modSession);

            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modmanual|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            value = toInt(parts[2], 0);

            modSession = getModifierSession(attackerTokenId);

            if (toInt(modSession.manualAttackBonus, 0) === value && value !== 0) {
                modSession.manualAttackBonus = 0;
            } else {
                modSession.manualAttackBonus = value;
            }

            modSession.useManualAttackBonus = modSession.manualAttackBonus !== 0;
            setModifierSession(modSession);

            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modclearback|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            clearModifierSession(attackerTokenId);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-modclear|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            clearModifierSession(attackerTokenId);
            renderModifierMenu(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-attacksetup|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackSetupMenu(parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '', parts[3] || '', msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-rangedmenu|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackSetupMenu(parts[1] || '', parts[2] || '', parts[3] || '', msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-firetoggle|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            rowId = parts[2] || '';
            targetTokenId = parts[3] || '';

            setFireIntoMelee(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, parts[4] === '1');
            attackSetupMenu(attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-quickattack|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            rowId = parts[2] || '';
            targetTokenId = parts[3] || '';

            rollAttack(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, parts[4] || 'short', parts[5] || '0');
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-clearresult|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';

            clearMainResult(attackerTokenId);
            showTokenCardById(attackerTokenId, msg.playerid);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content.indexOf('!gm1e-rolldamage|') === 0) {
            parts = msg.content.split('|');
            attackerTokenId = parts[1] || '';
            rowId = parts[2] || '';
            targetTokenId = parts[3] || '';
            sizeKey = parts[4] || 'sm';

            rollDamage(msg.playerid, attackerTokenId, rowId, targetTokenId, sizeKey);
            return;
        }

        if (msg.content !== '!gm1e') {
            return;
        }

        if (!msg.selected || !msg.selected.length) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(msg.playerid) + box(title('GM1E') + row(bad('Select at least one token.'))));
            return;
        }

        out = '';

        for (i = 0; i < msg.selected.length; i++) {
            if (msg.selected[i]._type !== 'graphic') {
                continue;
            }

            token = getObj('graphic', msg.selected[i]._id);

            if (!token) {
                continue;
            }

            out += buildCard(token);
        }

        if (!out) {
            sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(msg.playerid) + box(title('GM1E') + row(bad('Nothing valid selected.'))));
            return;
        }

        sendChat(SCRIPT, playerWhisperPrefix(msg.playerid) + out);
    });

    initState();
    log(SCRIPT + ' v' + VERSION + ' loaded. Command: !gm1e');
});
